body:
This is so much bigger than Gaza.

| | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=netanyahu_speech&n=1)
---
Peter,

A damning new ruling was handed down by the International Court of Justice last week that shreds the Israeli government’s long-standing defense of apartheid.
---
[ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=netanyahu_speech&n=2)
---
The ruling unequivocally declared the occupation unlawful, and accuses Israel of heaping human rights abuses onto the Palestinian people.

None of this should be surprising. For 10 long months now we’ve witnessed Israeli occupying forces gleefully posting videos of their war crimes on social media. **Finally we are piercing the veil on Israeli propaganda.

** But this ruling is notable for three reasons:

First, it comes on the back of another ICJ ruling earlier this year alleging genocide perpetrated against Gaza.

Second, this new ruling arises as Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Defense Minister Yoav Gallant are both facing potential arrest warrants for war crimes by the International Criminal Court.

Finally, **this ruling lands just days before Netanyahu himself lands in the United States to deliver a joint address to Congress**.

In a just world, Netanyahu would be denied entry – if not detained on sight – and held accountable for his crimes.

Instead, Netanyahu’s American friends came rushing to his defense, with multiple members of Congress issuing statements slamming the ICJ ruling as illegitimate.

**This is a shameful display of cowardice from our elected officials – and a thoroughly bipartisan one at that.** NO member of Congress should entertain Netanyahu while he presides over a genocide. And staging this state visit only amplifies their complicity in the fact Israel’s crimes are carried out with American bombs and American dollars they personally authorized.

**But ultimately, it is the White House that sets the tone for this relationship** , and under a Jill Stein administration Benjamin Netanyahu will NEVER be welcome.

**There is only ONE choice on the ballot for a majority of voters with a decades-long record of anti-war activism; only one with the credibility to stand up to empire, dismantle the American war machine, and forge a path forward for people, planet, and peace.

[After the shake-up in the Democratic race, millions of voters are closely assessing their choices for President and will not back any member of the Biden administration complicit in Israel’s genocide. I need your help to reach these voters. Will you donate $25, $50, $100 or more today?](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=netanyahu_speech&n=3)**
---
| [](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=netanyahu_speech&n=4 "DONATE NOW") [DONATE NOW](https://www.jillstein2024.com/donate?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=netanyahu_speech&n=4)
---
Netanyahu has no business in Congress. He belongs in the Hague. Help me deliver a mandate for peace and justice at the ballot box this November.

In solidarity and gratitude,

Jill

Team, we're intimately aware of the challenges we need to overcome to make sure our voices are heard in our elections -- because our partners on the ground have been facing down the opponents of voting rights here for years.
RUSH $25 or whatever you can right now to join the fight against voter suppression and to make every vote count in elections nationwide >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=072224_3&amount=25]
Voter Action Project Logo [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-weekly?refcode=072224_3&amount=25]
AP: Mississippi has a history of voter suppression. Many see signs of change as Black voters reengage [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=072224_3&amount=25]
There were a lot of reasons to be excited about last year's election results, Team, but what happened in Mississippi should give us all pause and show us why we need to fight in every state nationwide.
Mississippi has an egregious voting rights record and has the highest level of felony disenfranchisement in the country. A Jim Crow-era constitutional provision enables Mississippi to disenfranchise more than 10% of its total voting-age population and its disenfranchisement of Black voters exceeds 15% .
Mississippi has no early voting opportunities and a narrow set of qualifications for those seeking to vote absentee, meaning that the vast majority of ballots are cast on Election Day. This inaccessibility contributes to the state’s notoriously dismal voter turnout: In this year’s primary election, only 30% of those registered to vote turned out, the lowest rate since 2007.
On Election Day 2023 at least nine polling locations in the state’s most populous county — Hinds County, home of the city of Jackson — ran out of ballots multiple times throughout the day . The fight to extend polling hours became a confusing jumble of legal filings and contradicting orders all as voters waited in line -- and many left entirely due to the lack of ballots .
Also in Hinds County, opponents of voting rights in the state legislature have previously taken aim at Jackson and its over 80% Black population by creating a new court system with an unelected judge in a portion of Jackson and expanding the state-run Capitol Police force’s jurisdiction to cover the entire city rather than just a handful of government buildings.
Mississippi's playbook is clear: Disenfranchise, limit ballot access, obscure legal pathways for justice, rely on Jim Crow laws still on the books, and codify control for decades. Their endgame is power and control , not fairness or freedom.

**_Ten days after the attempted assassination of President Trump’s life, the Secret Service refuses to answer questions._**

❗ Friends -
To everyone who cares about electing Kamala Harris this November, please don’t click away from this important message.

Yesterday, President Joe Biden announced he was no longer seeking reelection. We are so grateful for his service to our country and all he has done for our gun safety movement.
Shortly after his announcement, he endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the new Democratic nominee for president.
GIFFORDS PAC then joined him in giving her our full endorsement.

Vice President Harris has worked with President Biden in every single one of his historic actions to make our country safer from gun violence.
She stood by his side as he signed the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ into law in 2022. Currently, she leads the federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention that President Biden established in 2023.

**There is no better candidate than Kamala Harris to be the next president of the United States, and we’re proud to endorse her.**
Now it’s up to us to raise the resources we need to support Vice President Harris and her historic campaign for president.

If everyone getting this email donated even $1, we'd have the resources we need to fuel Vice President Harris’ campaign and our own get out the vote efforts.
But 99% of people won't give today; they'll simply click away.
That’s why we need your help today.

subject: Thank You for Contacting AG for Congress!
body:
Dear Peter,

Thank you so much for signing up to volunteer with Ahmed "AG" Ghanim's campaign! Your support and dedication are crucial as we work towards creating a positive change in our community.

We have several volunteer opportunities available and would love for you to get involved. Please check out the events page here: www.mobilize.us/wearetheanswer .

We specifically need volunteers for the following:

Phone Banking - Mondays and Thursdays
Canvassing - Weekends

Your participation in these activities will make a significant impact on our campaign. If you have any questions or need further information, please feel free to contact me via email or phone at 248-275-3145.

Additionally, I will be calling you by Friday to discuss how you can get involved and answer any questions you might have.

Thank you once again for your support. Together, we can make a difference!

Best regards,

Mike Flores
AG for Congress Campaign

Phone: 248-275-3145

subject: Blago in the WSJ: Biden Gets the Chicago Treatment
body:
Biden appears to be the latest victim of Chicago-style kneecapping brought by his one-time partner-in-crime, Barack Obama, in a WSJ op-ed by Blagojevi

view in browser (https://mailchi.mp/bc2df7b940ca/exclusive-donald-trump-jr-draws-large-crowds-receives-lifetime-membership-10345381?e=1cb5fdae9e) | update preferences (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/profile?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=9449fb7266) | unsubscribe (https://illinoisreview.us14.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=811d47b3c0783e80274d515f7&id=1a5a561027&t=b&e=1cb5fdae9e&c=9449fb7266)

Dear Peter,

This is Scott Kaspar, General Counsel of Illinois Review. I spent much of last week with Editor-in-Chief Mark Vargas at the Republican National Convention in Milwaukee, Wisc., listening to incredible speeches by many of our fellow conservatives and patriots about America's best days ahead, and we look forward to sharing some of our insight with you this week.

But in the past 24 hours, we have been watching the events in DC play out in disbelief, likely as you and your families have too. The self-proclaimed "Party of Democracy" has done everything to upend democracy as the Democrat primary winner, Joseph Biden, has been sidelined and apparently sent back home to Delaware. It's a treatment that's all too familiar in Chicago, and who better to share his story of the ruthlessness of Chicago politics than former Illinois Gov. Rod Blagojevich (D).
Blagojevich in the Wall Street Journal: Biden Gets the Chicago Treatment (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/blagojevich-in-the-wall-street-journal-biden-gets-the-chicago-treatment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9449fb7266-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/blagojevich-in-the-wall-street-journal-biden-gets-the-chicago-treatment.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=9449fb7266-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D
Former President Barack Obama speaks in Athens, June 21, 2023. (Photo: Petros Giannakouris / Associated Press)

“In the old-school way of Chicago backroom politics, Mr. Obama was the conductor of the band that successfully orchestrated the removal of the presidential candidate chosen by more than 14 million Democratic primary voters—to be replaced by someone he and the party bosses choose instead. It’s classic ward-boss tactics.

I’ve known Mr. Obama since 1995. We both grew up in Chicago politics. We understand how it works—with the bosses over the people. Mr. Obama learned the lessons well. And what he just did to Mr. Biden is what political bosses have been doing in Chicago since the 1871 fire—selections masquerading as elections.”

body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-eugene [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-eugene]
The road to a Democratic majority in the House runs straight through Virginia. I’m proud to support strong VA Democrats who are running for U.S. House seats, and I hope you’ll join me by reading these emails and chipping in when you can. With your help, we can flip the House and keep Virginia blue!
Friends,
I’m proud to support Eugene Vindman’s campaign for U.S. Congress! Eugene is a dad, a Ukrainian immigrant, and an Army veteran with a track record of standing up to Trump and MAGA Republicans — even when it’s hard.
Today, he’s the Democratic nominee for Virginia’s 7th Congressional district, and he’s going to need our support to keep the district blue. Will you split a donation between me and Eugene Vindman right now to power our campaigns through November? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-eugene]
Eugene’s story truly embodies the American Dream — born in Soviet Ukraine to a Jewish family, Eugene and his family lived under an authoritarian regime during the height of the Cold War. After his mother died of cancer when he was three years old, his father packed up Eugene, his brothers, and his grandmother, and fled to the United States as refugees.
Eugene and his brothers attended public schools in Brooklyn and learned English, and once he graduated, Eugene joined the military to serve the country that had given him and his family so much.
Two decades of military service later, in 2019, Eugene and his brother Alex blew the whistle on President Trump’s attempted extortion of the Ukrainian President to investigate the Biden family.
The rest is history — Trump was impeached in the House, and acquitted by the Senate. And then two days later, Trump fired Eugene and Alex from their jobs in the White House.
By blowing the whistle, Eugene honored his commitment to protecting America, serving others, and defending our country’s values, no matter the consequences.
Now, Eugene is taking on a new mission with his Congressional campaign, working to protect our democracy, restore our freedoms, and ensure all our communities can thrive.
The fact is, many of our most fundamental rights are on the ballot this November, from a woman’s right to choose, to a student’s right to learn in a safe, high-quality public school, to a worker’s ability to enter the middle class, and a voter’s right to make their voice heard.
I have no doubt that while in Congress, Eugene will fight to protect and expand those rights. I’d be proud and honored to work alongside him in Congress, but it’s a tough election cycle, so we’re going to need your help along the way.
Please split a donation of any amount between our campaigns, and together we can help elect Eugene and flip the House blue on Election Day. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/tk-2024-eugene]
Thanks for your support — and for helping Virginia stay blue up and down the ballot this November.
-Tim Kaine

President Biden once again shows just how radically extreme he is...
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

The Abortion Lobby is still furious that the Supreme Court reversed _Roe v. Wade._

And they’re prepared to do anything and everything possible to seize back control of the Court.

In fact, _The Washington Post_ is reporting that the now lame duck Biden Administration is about to announce a major plan to DISMANTLE the Supreme Court as we know it and replace it with a pro-abortion pipe dream!

[](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-gjddlit-duchtdja-y/)
The Biden Administration’s schemes haven’t been fully disclosed yet, but from what’s been reported, the President, _who now has nothing left to lose,_ wants to:

**-_Impose Term Limits on Justices_ –** which is just an excuse so President Biden can kick Justices Clarence Thomas, Samuel Alito, and other Conservative powerhouses off the bench; and

**-_Force Justices to Follow a _So-Called_ “Code of Ethics_” –** which would be written by the Biden Administration to force justices to rule how the puppeteers in the Abortion Lobby want!
Of course, _The Washington Post_ is downplaying President Biden’s potential schemes as mere “changes.”

subject: I'm running to be the next President of the United States.

body:
It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement. | | |
---
Peter, I am running to be President of the United States. **It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden -- one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement.** And I am eager to run on the record of what Joe and I have accomplished together. body:
We’ve been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.

We've been told our whole lives to eat certain fruits, vegetables, and whole grains to stay in good health.
However, according to Dr. Steven Gundry — a world-renowned heart surgeon — many so called **" health foods" in the American diet contain a dangerous toxin, that could be expanding your waistline.**
**" This toxin causes micro-tears to form in your fragile intestinal-wall — allowing bacteria and waste products to seep into your body."** Says Dr. Gundry.
This harmful condition is best known as "leaky gut," and it's affecting millions of people nationwide. **Warning signs include weight gain, fatigue, digestive discomfort, stiff, achy joints, and even skin problems.**
Dr. Gundry explains, "**These side effects are often mistaken for normal signs of aging, because leaky gut usually develops over a matter of years, and sometimes even decades. But I can assure you, the damage caused by these so called "health foods" is far from normal."**
The good news is, this problem can be **easily fixed from your own home.**
"It's very simple, you just have to know which foods are actually healthy, and which contain this hidden toxin," he goes on to explain.
By simply eliminating this harmful toxin, Dr. Gundry has seen thousands of his own patients make swift recoveries. (In fact, he even lost 70lbs himself!)
Now, after years of research, Dr. Gundry has decided to release an informative video to the public — free and uninterrupted — showcasing exactly which foods you need to avoid.
"Good health is one of life's toughest obstacles," he explains. "So, if this video can help people achieve that, I'll be thrilled to hear I was of help."
The video has since gone viral, first being shared by users on Facebook, then being featured on news sites like ABC and CBS.
So far, the comments and feedback have been outstanding, with thousands of Americans feeling better than they have in decades.
[**Click here to watch the presentation:**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z9ii2837lv55l3p32oulo9sk6asr2plqbppmb2o8_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cth61o71cth2bs)
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z99hkijg4fr2bf8vscvulqgiu4i86o1sg2bvfgo0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cth61o71cth2bs)
[**Watch The Video**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zi98rhnitkus6bt760pnnshhpgrinlfbot89mpu0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cth61o71cth2bs)
Dr. Gundry also serves as the personal physician to many A-list celebrities.
Most notable of which include legendary self-help guru Tony Robbins, Oscar award winning actor Alan Arkin, Grammy award winning singer Usher, and countless fortune 500 executives.
Now, there is one thing Dr. Gundry asks from his viewers: "If watching this helps you take control of your weight back, fight unwanted cravings, increase your energy, ease gas and bloating, or find relief from stiff, achy joints," Dr. Gundry says... "Then please share this video with your friends and loved ones. Together, we can help as many people avoid these health issues as possible."
[**Click here to watch the presentation**](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z5hbb5m7p6rlv30br05vnvbhmaefnlr13mvl0l9g_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4cth61o71cth2bs)

| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn6ec42kvlrt6ikqqgqe7a3qcug9bskv3icmdme0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4ctj64ob4cph2bs)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zd0bg3652jqmjr60kckh4jsv1fjq5s0ar8b44m98_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4ctj64ob4cph2bs).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2znjt98vjfjs4jbavsirbsdbjoj3sftq20civ5kl0_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4ctj64ob4cph2bs)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zch0fthtoo1pnlp66htepbc1p5d27oi4lci82b5o_rp22sh2s8i6eoj4ctj64ob4cph2bs)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.

name: Hillsdale College via Restore Our Nation
subject: The Battle for Truth
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Restore Our Nation is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6aGLyq-7IhDSlSs-4ixE_Q~~/AARclAA~~~)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6aGLyq-7IhDSlSs-4ixE_Q~~/AARclAA~~~).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6aGLyq-7IhDSlSs-4ixE_Q~~/AARclAA~~~)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/6aGLyq-7IhDSlSs-4ixE_Q~~/AARclAA~~~)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
---
| |
---

Restore Our Nation
---

name: Hillsdale College via Conservative Broadcast
subject: The Battle for Truth
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Conservative Broadcast is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FETZ-Dh4hjDJ-lgDgbEqqw~~/AARclAA~)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FETZ-Dh4hjDJ-lgDgbEqqw~~/AARclAA~).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** —on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** —Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools—there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FETZ-Dh4hjDJ-lgDgbEqqw~~/AARclAA~)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://post.spmailtechnol.com/f/a/FETZ-Dh4hjDJ-lgDgbEqqw~~/AARclAA~)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.
---
| |
---

Conservative Broadcast

body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Conservative Liberty Wire is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4b4709e110674b01adb1e63ace58cb0d&_e=8bd_1mN43tWvgEnYLVqIuVSQ6aURgTb-KA-KeJyhU1MUzVjQAPJsUzA-TibTy9aiYcRNKumkXJKB28CA-KS6zKgZZdlNU-5c4DNRrZMdU0mJghKk67dfb2tNnCABdzZlBqkgxDm1yAYzSfVHhFr9H5q0EdaQigAoRChjSiA4L1C-61e394x0jUEM3-FCfIPGpKq3DOvqmQCvdVfma0M7z9IdFVNhZBfuk5DUtoBMzgGv4qr_AYk2XB05tL6lMTaBayTk_L6BQcPlCk1_Mc-eHqTGS-wfNkxKDUTpW6qKl7HHm1100N5KRESWw-3I0ltfVIiehqkD1lWvtz24jmvKnsfcInsq-4Jwq9UdKcEX4Gni0Bw7W8yXcBFTQjDJjXqdTKCiPGhW-d8752EZjHab2Q%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

## House Takes on Secret Service Director
The House Oversight Committee [aggressively questioned](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskMGK5CAUAL_G3Az6tFs8eFhYcutlb3sMRp_JW0wM6qSn_37oOc-5oCjq32N-eMp0rH_8jq6nMvvQ6cLZcFAc9KyH6BIioBrQSQPSaFB3PWxuUYsUxiqdTBTR4l2YZIPQ1hgrE-iBHAjQwoCSQoCQ483G5M3tFuOikwFgWmCkXur4v9DRN0z5VS6sYyj7kN3W-9mY-sVgYjD5JRz4bONa3pjB9Ldk6hQag6lhqNh5w3pRQB6pYuilcvw8MXSMPJRjrdgaT54yRr6hr3SsvNeP_XwLeqkvpiaKTP2WEqQWyqqhung-KWdqd8O0WHdP-Tuu_7zqcvAVAAD__4QEbBI) Secret Service Director Kimberly Cheatle on Monday for failing to prevent the attempted assassination of former President Donald Trump. Despite her opening statement in which she accepted "full responsibility" for the security lapses, Cheatle avoided responding to key questions, such as why no agents were placed on the roof where the shooter was perched. She called the assassination attempt the "most significant operational failure of the Secret Service in decades" but failed to provide a detailed timeline explaining in detail what happened. [Rep. Nancy Mace (R-S.C.)](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxsz7FuwyAURuGngY0IX3BwB4Yu3tK1o0Xgd7gVNhFGjvr2VTt3PtKRvs_bcgtceH98hA2-r3UJsfOJxSkyiuxiZfIrQDASfnA0OEvmamX2ZkAKmFZCciA33EeLQMnpEdGM0yTZkyarHZlBa9LDZXxLa3DjmNLdro5IWI3EvbbLV-W9Z6zlu55ol1g3WXzu_XkI8y5oFjT3jMyl_DZBc64bdrwOQbN101VPpLYQoQ7Ehq4OtJMjVOKG2GtTMSP0AkGzbD49X1wKH1cnrH5sgf-usv_vPz39BAAA__-T-F1b) accused Cheatle of being "full of s**t" and "completely dishonest." Cheatle faced [bipartisan calls to resign](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskDFvgzAQRn-N2Yzsw3Bh8NCFLV07ImOfw7UmjowLzb-v0rnbJ33Se9L7uM5Xx4nvt3e3ka0xz85XPmhGCZ0EM5sm2EgE1DVkNYJGA91gmtVewCxhiM5HXAyBHkYfw2VE9Ih6xL5hCwqMQui0UqB0248hOuz7EBYTEUAYRYFrLu1n5ntdKaZnPqi0Pm9Nsmutj110bwImAdN5nq374by_XgHTiy1gUvjaIGD64m2hkp7Sr-RqIrmTL1TlTuVgT7KW7-0hV3KF77em2PA4OSXeBxRG3TbH6c9b_69wWPgNAAD__zkhXr4), with Committee Chairman James Comer (R-Ky.), Rep. West Virginia and Iowa have emerged as [America's cheapest states](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskL1utDAQAJ_GdEbrtcHfFS6-hu7SpkTGXo6NzI_wCpS3jy516pFmpPl8js_IhbfXR1wpyLyPMQlfNHqNVqMbXZPDTIRkGwrGo_EObe-aJTwodT1MyWQLfUcR7JyziX3uHND0b2o4IKADj9YAIJi2e-Q5-q7LeXKzR1QOKLPsZ_u18yYLzeV7v-hs0742JSwiR1X2v8JB4XDfd5u2Kb2hwuGtVjiAVzgYVDjElU5OsWoDOi0UD6qiq0ShqmXXhS_SvLWLrKU5Qz5uLoVr75WD1xq5_Ebl7wVXwJ8AAAD___qzXM4) to live in for 2024, according to a new financial report compiled by CNBC. CNBC analyzed the most recent available data on consumer prices, housing affordability, and cost of home insurance to determine the 10 most affordable states in the country. Iowa's low cost of living and affordability were enough to place the Hawkeye State at No. 2, but high insurance premiums due to the increased risk of storms and tornadoes kept it from being No. 1. West Virginia's cost of living is 12% lower than the national average, helping the Mountain State capture the top spot. A four-bedroom house in Charleston costs about a quarter of the price of a similar home in Seattle. subject: Unmasking the Far-Left Agenda
body:
We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College

| | | [](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4511937911a14def8ce2a9d7d7e38fbe&_e=sq1aAfE3JCZ3ToV6Imupv71H234K3PUK4q2yE-SOeOX_6ysgFPohRJ5oD4jQM-NKY25ZYmJN7VoBpt9X7zR9vJ3d3PdGN7MCZwfZLA8Tu952OrWLg8EBI_FPw2cjZ0IykfJoj8CDjNJeX0JABBCk-pQ0odj6Bn3WvaGCPuFfyKt1xXZxhRQc49g4IoZDBeUrA4Ty6h2nqO11dlyVQ6R-ZRg3_1BBt2m7kkk9omXNYI_Qgxibho4yATe-iL2yHNVEtmwONK5NkpWHnZH_0QTo_oz6SWGbMLGpqxIkhqMCT327SpagPwM3vXjxSuTcZYRu1hzzMeFoGdrNBnUmbeH6S-cpz9U7_xQhXfyhJ0nngGGGSynPTR3OP4qI8CEc52KcwKJOT9Wd179HrxFnInQMyw%3D%3D)
---
| | Fellow American,

Over the last year, the agenda of the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, has become all too clear.

Together, these forces want to **circumvent the First Amendment, suppress conservative speech and political activity** , and push their own **false** and **dishonest** narrative about American history and about what's happening today.

More and more, stories that question the far-Left's narrative are dubiously "fact-checked" or censored outright, while conservative opponents of the Left are "de-platformed."

**We have never seen anything like what we are seeing today in America!**

The roots of our current crisis can be traced to the late 1960s when radicals who scorned America and its way of life began taking over our colleges and universities.

It took them several decades to cement their dominance over American higher education, but we are seeing the fruits of their labors today: we see it in the media, and we see it in Silicon Valley.

We are also seeing it in professional sports, in corporate America--much of which is now capitulating to far-Left demands--and increasingly in K-12 education.

**Liberty in America is under serious threat. As I travel around the country, worried citizens ask me if there is a way to meet this crisis. I never hesitate to say there is, despite how uphill the fight may seem.**

A vital part of the fight--and one in which Hillsdale College is uniquely able to lead--is to reach and teach additional millions of citizens with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty.

**You are making that fight possible by supporting our educational outreach efforts, such as _Imprimis_ , America's leading digest of liberty.**

Hillsdale launched _Imprimis_ over 50 years ago to promote limited government, free enterprise, individual rights, personal responsibility, and a strong national defense. Each issue covers a timely political, economic, or cultural issue from a constitutional perspective.

Today, with the far Left's dramatic escalation of its assault on free speech and informed patriotism, _Imprimis_ is more critical than ever.

Think of what we have seen in the last few years: unprecedented and unconstitutional lockdowns, lawless violence in our cities, and even the destruction of historical monuments.

On top of this, we are now seeing an escalation of the effort to shut off any debate about these issues--an effort to limit or curtail speech that is **simply** and **clearly un-American**.

There is a good reason that conservative radio and TV host Mark Levin says _Imprimis_ is the publication he most looks forward to reading each month.

You'll be pleased to know that its circulation has grown this year to more than 6.6 million. That's 6.6 million paper copies that are **mailed to homes and businesses** ten times per year.

Our research also shows that _Imprimis_ subscribers share their copy with two to three other people on average, giving _Imprimis_ even greater reach and influence.

And while a circulation of more than 6.6 million is undoubtedly impressive--_Imprimis_ has a greater circulation than the _Wall Street Journal_ and _The New York Times_ --we are determined to do more.

Since _Imprimis_ launched in 1972 with a circulation of about 1,000, **Hillsdale College has never charged for a subscription.**

**But the fact that we offer _Imprimis_ free of charge does not mean that producing and mailing _Imprimis_ is without cost. **

Even using non-profit postage rates, the price for printing and mailing each issue of _Imprimis_ to so many subscribers ten times a year is a significant financial undertaking.

**Our immediate goal is to increase the circulation of _Imprimis_ to over 7 million American households and businesses this year. To do so, we must address the question of production and mailing costs.**

Your generous support today will help us reach our _Imprimis_ goal and expand our other successful educational outreach efforts.

You know that education is liberty's surest defense--and that education is needed now more than ever!

That's why, in addition to _Imprimis_ , we are investing in our other educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. We're doing this through our **[Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4511937911a14def8ce2a9d7d7e38fbe&_e=sq1aAfE3JCZ3ToV6Imupv71H234K3PUK4q2yE-SOeOX_6ysgFPohRJ5oD4jQM-NKY25ZYmJN7VoBpt9X7zR9vJ3d3PdGN7MCZwfZLA8Tu952OrWLg8EBI_FPw2cjZ0IykfJoj8CDjNJeX0JABBCk-pQ0odj6Bn3WvaGCPuFfyKt1xXZxhRQc49g4IoZDBeUrA4Ty6h2nqO11dlyVQ6R-ZRg3_1BBt2m7kkk9omXNYI_Qgxibho4yATe-iL2yHNVEndd1L02YZa3AK7Nt2Cu3MNZ8r6l506f8YQA0GFlj0mveW7NHecg9ol9n4GCPpDwjtOp0AJtAPyBtdc8hH8iLUzFXVRIuJLq5-r1stYAppyXyxjcBM7PXB0GJkaohFMEDIevboUdxoOpHU9bX_43thg%3D%3D).**

These efforts include:

* **Educating millions of Americans, especially younger Americans, through free online courses** --on topics including the Constitution, American history, and free-market economics.

* **Providing hundreds of thousands of young Americans with free copies of the Declaration of Independence and Constitution** --Hillsdale has already distributed over 600,000 free copies of these founding documents, and we receive more requests every week.

* **Educating thousands of K-12 students** in Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 public and private schools--there are already more than 90 such schools across the country, each having a strong curricular component in American civics.

I hope you'll agree that after everything we've seen in the last few years, the need for _Imprimis_ and Hillsdale's other educational outreach efforts is undeniable.

Hillsdale is the only college in America equipped to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans about our nation's great heritage of liberty and about the need to defend freedom and limited government.

Almost unique among American colleges and universities, Hillsdale refuses to accept ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. This frees us from much burdensome and corrupting federal regulation.

**This independence from the government also means that our work is entirely dependent on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.**

[ Will you give generously to our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions** --which includes expanding the reach and influence of _Imprimis_](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4511937911a14def8ce2a9d7d7e38fbe&_e=sq1aAfE3JCZ3ToV6Imupv71H234K3PUK4q2yE-SOeOX_6ysgFPohRJ5oD4jQM-NKY25ZYmJN7VoBpt9X7zR9vJ3d3PdGN7MCZwfZLA8Tu952OrWLg8EBI_FPw2cjZ0IykfJoj8CDjNJeX0JABBCk-pQ0odj6Bn3WvaGCPuFfyKt1xXZxhRQc49g4IoZDBeUrA4Ty6h2nqO11dlyVQ6R-ZRg3_1BBt2m7kkk9omXNYI_Qgxibho4yATe-iL2yHNVEMypfhXaUZZgpuxLnYhk3eY7vmvYa0GJQOqT7dGsp87emfj2G7Is9AOZGt8ZhlRvX0f7Yokmp6k-vQaaPgyrB1wdhHB--aPckXgFZwmVs0zYLHKX6eS35aRCw79awCEUgl5UvVuBsfZgbwzua6lx_2g%3D%3D)?

If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on American principles and the American way of life, please show your support for Hillsdale College with a generous tax-deductible gift today.

I hope you will stand with us as we engage the far Left, along with its media and Big Tech allies, on the battlefield of education.

Warm regards,

Larry P. Arnn
President, Hillsdale College
Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

P.S. Liberty in America is under threat, and education is the only long-term solution. That's why we are greatly expanding our national educational outreach, such as _Imprimis_ , free online courses, K-12 curricula and support, and much more. And we need your help to do so! Please make a generous, tax-deductible gift in support of liberty and education at this secure link: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/defend-liberty](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4511937911a14def8ce2a9d7d7e38fbe&_e=sq1aAfE3JCZ3ToV6Imupv71H234K3PUK4q2yE-SOeOX_6ysgFPohRJ5oD4jQM-NKY25ZYmJN7VoBpt9X7zR9vJ3d3PdGN7MCZwfZLA8Tu952OrWLg8EBI_FPw2cjZ0IykfJoj8CDjNJeX0JABBCk-pQ0odj6Bn3WvaGCPuFfyKt1xXZxhRQc49g4IoZDBeUrA4Ty6h2nqO11dlyVQ6R-ZRg3_1BBt2m7kkk9omXNYI_Qgxibho4yATe-iL2yHNVEaZM0WFDGYhgwef6I60fltInA5mq761WgrWv99JN8emw4vcCt_8XxTcBJcgp6ex1qCyyPD_l1ocpARb-IqzJcbRECSzCSp8Lx8gwuLsGToJ0jlbUJuYi2MJ9N5HGls4SkxUqrCxteRycAxHPMOKVuVQ%3D%3D)**.

Thank you again for saving young people through education.

Fellow American,

# [The U.S. government poisoned alcohol during Prohibition.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh2p9d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
### [U.S. History](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh2p9d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh2p9d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)
| I t’s been dubbed the “noble experiment,” a name that came from then-President Herbert Hoover calling Prohibition “a great social and economic experiment, noble in motive and far-reaching in purpose.” In January 1920, the United States banned the manufacture, sale, and transportation of “intoxicating liquors,” a move made in the wake of temperance movements that sought moral and social reform throughout the 1800s — in spite of some failed attempts at similar regional programs around the country.
---
Despite the ban, the demand for alcohol remained high. Bootlegging — illegal production, smuggling, and selling of liquor — thrived. Illegitimate drinking spots known as speakeasies flourished, with approximately 30,000 of them existing in just New York City alone by decade’s end. As the defiance against liquor laws intensified, authorities managed to mitigate smuggling from other countries; the bootleggers, however, responded by stealing massive quantities of industrial alcohol — used in automotive fluids, paints, and medical supplies — and refining it to make it drinkable (it became the country’s top source of liquor). Then, the U.S. government tried to beat the rum-runners at their own game. [In 1926](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh2p9d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com), President Calvin Coolidge’s administration mandated that manufacturers add even more dangerous chemicals to their industrial products — substances such as gasoline, formaldehyde, and the easily lethal methanol — to dissuade the underground industries and their customers.
The consequences were immediate — and in many cases, fatal. Consumption of alcohol continued despite fear of the additives, and some estimates claim the chemical additions caused around [10,000 deaths in the U.S.](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh2p9d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) Public health officials, including New York medical examiner Charles Norris, lambasted the move. Eventually, the official end of the program came with the repeal of the 18th Amendment in December 1933, marking the end of Prohibition.
[](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh2p9d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com) | [](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh2p9d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com)

## Organized crime started because of Prohibition.
Before Prohibition, organized crime was mostly limited to small gangs who were involved in petty neighborhood extortion and loan-sharking. When the 1920 ban on alcohol went into effect, mobsters became the key players in the illicit alcohol trade, procuring, producing, and selling liquor illegally all over the U.S. Profits got so big, so fast, that these once small-time criminals and mafias learned to be more “organized” than ever, hiring lawyers, accountants, truckers, and more to help run their illicit businesses. They also started working with other criminal groups, effectively creating [underground syndicates](https://track.historyfacts.com/?&eih=kzm8nstj6prmj7bhz7sjvvnysq73bagh&__stmp=sh2p9d&__onlt=h&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com). Powerful crime families led by figures such as Charles “Lucky” Luciano and the notorious Al Capone emerged, making millions of dollars in the process. The enormous profits fueled the growth and expansion of organized crime, which continued even after the repeal of Prohibition.

clean_body: It’s been dubbed the “noble experiment,” a name that came from then-President Herbert Hoover calling Prohibition “a great social and economic experiment, noble in motive and far-reaching in purpose.” | I t’s been dubbed the “noble experiment,” a name that came from then-President Herbert Hoover calling Prohibition “a great social and economic experiment, noble in motive and far-reaching in purpose.” In January 1920, the United States banned the manufacture, sale, and transportation of “intoxicating liquors,” a move made in the wake of temperance movements that sought moral and social reform throughout the 1800s — in spite of some failed attempts at similar regional programs around the country. Despite the ban, the demand for alcohol remained high. Bootlegging — illegal production, smuggling, and selling of liquor — thrived. Illegitimate drinking spots known as speakeasies flourished, with approximately 30,000 of them existing in just New York City alone by decade’s end. As the defiance against liquor laws intensified, authorities managed to mitigate smuggling from other countries; the bootleggers, however, responded by stealing massive quantities of industrial alcohol — used in automotive fluids, paints, and medical supplies — and refining it to make it drinkable (it became the country’s top source of liquor). Then, the U.S. government tried to beat the rum-runners at their own game. , President Calvin Coolidge’s administration mandated that manufacturers add even more dangerous chemicals to their industrial products — substances such as gasoline, formaldehyde, and the easily lethal methanol — to dissuade the underground industries and their customers. The consequences were immediate — and in many cases, fatal. Consumption of alcohol continued despite fear of the additives, and some estimates claim the chemical additions caused around Public health officials, including New York medical examiner Charles Norris, lambasted the move. Eventually, the official end of the program came with the repeal of the 18th Amendment in December 1933, marking the end of Prohibition. | Thank you for supporting our advertisers! | By the Numbers | | Modern equivalent of how much Al Capone made each year during Prohibition $1.7 billion | | Year statewide Prohibition finally ended in Mississippi 1966 | Year statewide Prohibition finally ended in Mississippi 1966 | | Number of rum-only distilleries in NYC (named, winkingly, the Noble Experiment) 1 | | Average number of daily alcohol deliveries made by Congress’ own Prohibition-era bootlegger 25 | Average number of daily alcohol deliveries made by Congress’ own Prohibition-era bootlegger 25 | | | Did you know? ---|---|--- Organized crime started because of Prohibition. Before Prohibition, organized crime was mostly limited to small gangs who were involved in petty neighborhood extortion and loan-sharking. When the 1920 ban on alcohol went into effect, mobsters became the key players in the illicit alcohol trade, procuring, producing, and selling liquor illegally all over the U.S. Profits got so big, so fast, that these once small-time criminals and mafias learned to be more “organized” than ever, hiring lawyers, accountants, truckers, and more to help run their illicit businesses. They also started working with other criminal groups, effectively creating . Powerful crime families led by figures such as Charles “Lucky” Luciano and the notorious Al Capone emerged, making millions of dollars in the process. The enormous profits fueled the growth and expansion of organized crime, which continued even after the repeal of Prohibition. Turning Point USA is pleased to announce our newest contributor, Topher! After dedicating six years to the U.S. Air Force, Topher moved back to Mississippi to use his lyrical gift to create music. Growing up in Kilmichael, Mississippi, he was inspired by rappers that told authentic stories about growing up in troubled homes but making their own way through hard work and resilience. While contemporary rap is known to celebrate violence and gangster lifestyles, Topher's worldview was rooted in conservative all-American values, like liberty, equality, and individualism! He released his first album, “No Apologies” in 2021 after his December 2020 single “The Patriot” featuring fellow veteran, The Marine Rapper. “The Patriot'' reached number 1 on the Billboard Hip Hop Charts; however, two weeks afterwards, it was removed from all streaming services without explanation. Like most creatives, Topher turned to creating content on TikTok and other social media outlets to express his views and address the corrupt issues facing American culture. With a social media following of over 4 million followers, Topher continues to use his gift to fearlessly keep the conversation going and engage with millennials and Gen Zers who are reluctant to express their own conservative beliefs.

“I am thrilled to join Turning Point USA as a contributor, excited by the opportunity to leverage the organization's vast reach and strong values. Turning Point USA's extensive network and resources provide invaluable opportunities for networking, mentorship, and professional development. Aligning with such a well-respected organization strengthens my advocacy efforts. clean_body: Turning Point USA is pleased to announce our newest contributor, Topher! | Turning Point USA is pleased to announce our newest contributor, Topher! After dedicating six years to the U.S. Air Force, Topher moved back to Mississippi to use his lyrical gift to create music. Growing up in Kilmichael, Mississippi, he was inspired by rappers that told authentic stories about growing up in troubled homes but making their own way through hard work and resilience. While contemporary rap is known to celebrate violence and gangster lifestyles, Topher's worldview was rooted in conservative all-American values, like liberty, equality, and individualism! He released his first album, “No Apologies” in 2021 after his December 2020 single “The Patriot” featuring fellow veteran, The Marine Rapper. “The Patriot'' reached number 1 on the Billboard Hip Hop Charts; however, two weeks afterwards, it was removed from all streaming services without explanation. Like most creatives, Topher turned to creating content on TikTok and other social media outlets to express his views and address the corrupt issues facing American culture. With a social media following of over 4 million followers, Topher continues to use his gift to fearlessly keep the conversation going and engage with millennials and Gen Zers who are reluctant to express their own conservative beliefs. “I am thrilled to join Turning Point USA as a contributor, excited by the opportunity to leverage the organization's vast reach and strong values. Turning Point USA's extensive network and resources provide invaluable opportunities for networking, mentorship, and professional development. Aligning with such a well-respected organization strengthens my advocacy efforts. body:
This is it: the final countdown. The primary election for Kansas’ 3rd
congressional district is in 2 weeks on August 6.

Since I jumped in the race last year, I’ve attended over 2,000 events and
meetings. I’ve knocked on thousands of doors. I handed out 5,000 palm cards
when I walked both of the 4th of July parades in our District. I am nearly
out of yard signs because of the high demand.

The wonderful news is momentum is building! Voters are responding very
positively to my message of conservative, common-sense values.

This election is about YOU. Throughout my campaign, I have shown the kind
of representative I’ll be: someone who shows up, cares, works hard, and
listens to you.

We need $5,500 more to print more pamphlets, place more yard signs, and run
more ads in the final stretch.

| | July 23, 2024
Despite the vitriol of the leftist Politico-Media complex over a decade ago, the Tea Party was right on the issues, as those issues stand front and center on the national agenda today! We wanted to secure the border, shrink the Federal government, stop the deficit spending and money-printing, and reverse Obama's socialist agenda. I was a co-leader of the tea party movement in Connecticut - and proud of it. But my opponent in this primary, Mr. Goldstein and his team, curiously seem to think my efforts to launch the issues that remain at the top of today's national agenda are a negative. Let's school-up team Goldstein right here. The Tea Party emerged from Conservative and Libertarian activists' disgust with the bank bailouts in the '08 election cycle and President Obama's gouging of the national treasury of a trillion dollars within 30 days of his inauguration. Obama and the politico-media machine were stunned to see tens of thousands of average Americans flood the streets coast-to-coast to oppose his obvious Socialist national agenda. That machine kicked into high gear to smear middle America as extremists because we wanted the deficit spending stopped, the border secured, and the federal departments shrunk back to their original functionalities. When they can't contest the issues, they're guaranteed to call you names. In the face of endless smears, the tea party movement grew exponentially. You cannot back down and play into the false narrative deployed by the leftist machine - and the tea party forged ahead proclaiming its agenda: the primacy of the individual, limited constitutional government, balanced budgets, free-market capitalism, fair international trade, secure-border national sovereignty, and generally pushing our ruling political elite out of the micro-management of our lives. Sound familiar? To give traction to our agenda, we surged into the offices, and town halls, of our elected officials. First up was the global-warming-driven Cap & Trade bill. Our efforts were responsible for the bill dying in committee in July '09. We next surged into the '09 electoral process, the state and municipal elections, where conservative Republicans scored many unexpected wins across the country. Our issues were being forced onto the national agenda. They were resonating with the public, and Republican officials were taking them up, whether they wanted to or not. For six months we lobbied mightily against ObamaCare, but lost in the House by a couple votes, and the cornerstone of socialism was slid into place at literally a midnight vote on March 21, 2010. After massive wins for our issues in the 2010 and 2014 elections, our issues were largely adopted by Donald Trump, and blended into his highly effective America First campaign agenda in 2016. And they remain today at center stage, joined for years in now an open battle with the permanent self-interested federal government, as it continues to be fought out in electoral politics, in Congress, and the courts. But today's polling indicates we have brought a majority of the American public around to our cause. The 4th District congressional incumbent, Jim Himes, has placed himself with his votes on the wrong side of every one of these issues - issues I have made priorities in my campaign. I'm making the campaign a referendum on Mr. Himes' 16-year rule, because his record is profoundly vulnerable, and does not represent the interests of the citizens of the District. I entered this race early, in March '23 making it clear the only way to unseat Mr. Himes is to expose the "moderate" façade he so deceptively crafts in his media and local personal appearances. My taking the "hard-hitting lane" has been specifically recognized in local press articles [Here](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NVT9imQlVrWsKWJu5C3T7jmLF73zfTl4K3LiMBg0jXWZ-T4ff9m5Vg4705JSYNVIPxoNU_SsDHVAwHGYm9Fih2YQVh9t7EOSB9_qTMdex3zYn1o4cZGMxdG6KY0ds1ENH2UUVg1mzeuwQdg0aL2X_SzYv00djFDu2w9AlYVgEyKIFxMXiDPIH3BIQLy8TnWLB3ymK7RLJOPbvatoMsIxcCwj4xihPT6GnpvLPTA5hHnFwFPY4uxMVFv-6NXoxk79JoNdkcvWdro=&c=LK-QXjoi2mUdIQZx_yGxEmYRhQq6OdnRZX7H8bV25MW9ycjyR08Alg==&ch=AV13QySGa80PFeGYbSvTdnAgDWWLWIKB2CXgOAcOAAjGItRn-PtY2g==) and [Here](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NVT9imQlVrWsKWJu5C3T7jmLF73zfTl4K3LiMBg0jXWZ-T4ff9m5Vnbfb2d1P0cUmo-16GzcSkwpuUV0y8aodC4otWSbDOBv31CJWYszIYBuLtZu0lhzb4EfMe0JHNt3e0ieta8vtwGKko74A2G3gTwlQcSAuf_5neZ5xD7u1sUv1gxE1kYHAQ32p8qpLal3oTU2EVj2iD691Xphh5APO2-JFAzNBP1rWPflRNrrlg32gQggv7gSuO8T2KwI-nrdNdrGnhIWzXw=&c=LK-QXjoi2mUdIQZx_yGxEmYRhQq6OdnRZX7H8bV25MW9ycjyR08Alg==&ch=AV13QySGa80PFeGYbSvTdnAgDWWLWIKB2CXgOAcOAAjGItRn-PtY2g==). I also have a 15-year public record in CT-4 espousing our foundational Constitutional Conservative issues which remain at the heart of today's agenda - I do not waver from them. But my primary opponent, Mike Goldstein and his surrogate writer, Joe Bentivegna have positioned him as a another Moderate here- [Article](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NVT9imQlVrWsKWJu5C3T7jmLF73zfTl4K3LiMBg0jXWZ-T4ff9m5VpH-4xWEumHOnrlMslPqUrviS1s-gt_AlrC_-QKg_gLvIRUv-n1_gI2cK6jrbScButfh2l6Ri0wcs7UYQvy6h5tfFBC4xV3nq-OVxy-2TEwAiKD3kVYt2SaF436b6QfRUGLYgmDbopbrEQuDo4l3bLKBqL5L3ZX3eFyt3sms_AZ6A4O2Zwz6pbOf38DgrXxS8hGH2RH0X0O0J_Pi9PASl4JhrpID66pKk-462s-OhHWH&c=LK-QXjoi2mUdIQZx_yGxEmYRhQq6OdnRZX7H8bV25MW9ycjyR08Alg==&ch=AV13QySGa80PFeGYbSvTdnAgDWWLWIKB2CXgOAcOAAjGItRn-PtY2g==) and here [Article](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NVT9imQlVrWsKWJu5C3T7jmLF73zfTl4K3LiMBg0jXWZ-T4ff9m5Vnbfb2d1P0cU1eSV0GtT4-euPFVnBMbD1uzCNAz-8j6QDOkcCeiV0GahugIH5ZLJVHAfXCrwMZcQNkcW2Sp1XE1tuUVWdAK7_Uqc-8ZMSeqMdBjHq5H7a9k_KewWW60TI9VX6bOw-g52eW92-PjYnIeoxiUuiXPEfU2jGDSsut-O&c=LK-QXjoi2mUdIQZx_yGxEmYRhQq6OdnRZX7H8bV25MW9ycjyR08Alg==&ch=AV13QySGa80PFeGYbSvTdnAgDWWLWIKB2CXgOAcOAAjGItRn-PtY2g==). As I document in my [Perennial Democrat Trap](https://lk9rohfbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001NVT9imQlVrWsKWJu5C3T7jmLF73zfTl4K3LiMBg0jXWZ-T4ff9m5VpH-4xWEumHOO7WQ9VQQ_o9Dp_BQPs4KKTUtEK8t6iQnHxwlsOhE2uZvoA4tlu9r37P92100hbiyoxFn3-cQQfcqDBv6-hqz7pjZEr8bvHRPgEIH67vd14VG6yI0xQ7CzPrt-zA5fIzz85UtNgv6rkdkPjdZDRVwqkN44e4IqO6sOdMtzMFn48OA8iAQtBjs9FZ0MleE4gAa9sr2M6syTZ38WOvZZxnTpBWMl47fYUBxdMwwThqz3RIK29sca-u4x_KLzU-YPmlK&c=LK-QXjoi2mUdIQZx_yGxEmYRhQq6OdnRZX7H8bV25MW9ycjyR08Alg==&ch=AV13QySGa80PFeGYbSvTdnAgDWWLWIKB2CXgOAcOAAjGItRn-PtY2g==) article, they are already singing a favorite hymn from the Democrat playbook. Because the Tea Party was so effective and on-target, the Left labored hard in vain to ostracize us. And team Goldstein has now adopted their view - playing right along with the organized American Left. We can only imagine what would happen to them facing an amped-up leftist machine in a General... If you want to be sure the case will be unwaveringly prosecuted against Mr. Himes in November, I need your support, and would be honored with your vote in the August 13th Primary.

## **⚡ EVENT ALERT ⚡**
Join us, White House Climate Advisor Ali Zaidi, and key state environmental experts to discuss a once-in-a-generation opportunity for states, cities, and coalitions to cut climate pollution **this Thursday at 11:30 a.m. ET / 8:30 a.m. PT.** [ RSVP NOW ](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2710564/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| Hi,

This week, the Biden-Harris administration announced **$4.3 billion** in Climate Pollution Reduction Implementation Grants to select states, cities, and coalitions.

That means millions of federal dollars are about to go to states like Pennsylvania, Nebraska, Utah, New Jersey, and Michigan to implement programs that will reduce pollution in key sectors and propel clean energy industries forward, while supporting impacted communities and providing critical workforce opportunities.

These grants are a slingshot into the more equitable clean energy future we all want and deserve, which is why **we're excited to talk with White House Climate Advisor Ali Zaidi all about them this Thursday, July 25, at 11:30 a.m. ET / 8:30 a.m. PT.**[**Will you join us?**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2710565/87SdQ4wZ) |
---
[SAVE YOUR SPOT](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2710566/87SdQ4wZ)
---
---
| We'll also be joined by experts from awarded states, including Michigan State Chief Climate and Energy Strategist Kara Cook and Acting Secretary of the Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection Jessica Shirley, who will share insights about what these grants mean for their states, how residents will benefit, what the next steps are, and more.

[**Don't miss this opportunity to learn more about what all this money will fund and how these state and local climate plans can help communities thrive.**](https://actnow.evergreenaction.com/s/2710567/87SdQ4wZ)

And bring your questions!

See you online,
