| **ABOUT NELLA**
**New Mexico is Nella Domenici’s home. She was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of her childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas and Monroe with her seven siblings, and her parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. Nella began her education at Our Lady of Fatima, where she learned the values she holds today. Nella is a proud third-generation New Mexican, devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. Nella’s family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and she and her husband Pat enjoy their family home in New Mexico that they have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like most New Mexicans, Nella Domenici understands the importance of hard work. She waited tables to help pay for her undergraduate degree from Georgetown University, and worked her way through night school at Georgetown Law while holding down a full time job. She then graduated from Harvard Business School as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while 9 months pregnant.

Nella began her career at the bottom and worked her way up through the complex finance world, eventually serving as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In her career, Nella advised, invested in, grew, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. The industries she has worked in are vast and include areas such as health care, AI, food service, lodging, commercial real estate, mortgage lending, and consumer products. These companies have ranged from small family-owned businesses, to rapidly growing venture backed enterprises, to a Fortune 200 company. Several of these have been headquartered in New Mexico. Collectively, the companies Nella has been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.

Like her father and mother, Nella has been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those without access to quality healthcare or education. **

** Good Morning Republicans,
------------------------------------------------------------
Philippians 2:5 You must have the same attitude that Christ Jesus had.
Every day the information and narrative of the presidential election changes drastically almost to the point you can't keep up. I receive updates from the RNC/Trump Team pretty much daily and I wanted to share with you. We have some exciting news to share and next week I will outline the amazing connections that have transpired over the last 2-3 weeks.

------------------------------------------------------------
The Worst Is Waiting In The Wings
* For 39 months straight since Kamala Harris became Biden’s border czar (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf870776e142e6b615f89989e2abf333969685839f7d73debb109e1f35f7a0270d589288277897a760b3ed68&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) , monthly encounters (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf8707761507c4f5b35dd34e4b59c5d3c9a4f0b7052196ffc75993e8a7f656a2d82209e90b76ef3296a31e50&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) surpassed even the highest (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf870776c3451bc23036bcdbf3e83fd82f5044e57f544b64ee1900136ac24a99d454c4d98a09b5c28186b112&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) month under the last administration
+ During the past year alone, Border Czar Kamala Harris has failed to talk (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf87077611c89aa0ca947f097fa72891a8ee95f8b0c6cbe4ecc7e3ae62c50d96187e49653f393327cc043096&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) with Border Patrol Chief Jason Owens.
o The same goes for retired Border Patrol Chief Raul Ortiz who disclosed back in March that he never “had one conversation” with the Border Czar during the two years he held the position under the Biden Administration.
+ Meanwhile, in just the last month, 1,359 pounds of deadly (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf8707769616ceb8b008eb214b1ea50759ebb45c99851d15dbb3dca45f28450fdab161fbecb9f57032b09904&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) fentanyl was seized at the southern border, with much more getting through.
o Criminals are continuing to flood across the border, with Border Patrol arresting illegal immigrants accused of homicide (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf870776713a515658dcf30f165ef91726caaed2130c682d866cb97fde77cd2d9ee13f21bcd8ed7ead23eba7&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) , rape (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf87077685c0aa027ce6e9e4c4f90cb8056d8125c2021c7b42e8f86e7c5f7f64726fd085003bf5b61836070a&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) , assault (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf8707761dd7b862f8816e829b919292e029a2aaec7a343dd8e86b2e9e3a75317b296fd3142058e1833f0865&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) , drug trafficking (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf870776093596a9d17d5f46a9446173f66545e7c2e6a1ef7c7bda6d1be39db98f18bab56f4842c847732258&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) , and human smuggling (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf870776aa72228e6869db5fd70bd65f652cbee0f6f4136ea0e8c834404a20e1fa511b9f58752e45999e1452&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) , all within the past month.
+ It was her job to oversee the border bloodbath of rapes, murder, and deadly drug trafficking.
+ Despite Biden and Harris’ promise of a "fair and humane immigration system (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf870776b2fafc0b0547ec852744739aaf83842da7d6f588f2c5d322e0a392739df31052225eb781c397cc15&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) ," their open border policies aren't compassionate; they are deadly.
+ Border Czar Kamala Harris has only visited the border once as vice president – traveling to a politically friendly district (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf87077665451cedb2267aea1d95db8a3d14a076dc434a1f97acfe3ca3b75f04500f5f3d1b2184ca52f94055&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) rather than the epicenter of the crisis.
+ If she can’t lead the charge on the border, how can she lead our Country?
* Kamala Harris has a track record of supporting radical policies throughout her career.
+ Harris failed to prosecute criminals to the fullest extent of the law.
+ Harris has expressed support (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf8707767b5dd08c9bc39981c229db96e5e84a49dddd2f248cc6cf0d1acf785f56c4c1bad7a9b20835a07c0a&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) for sanctuary cities, and said “we need to probably think about starting from scratch (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf8707769cee3f01d4a7edcdfbf4fdc42da3bcc21bd4860bc26d17dd111b07d79c2657a98fe25e415b2d48f7&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) ” when referring to ICE.
+ Harris encouraged people to donate to the Minnesota Freedom Fund (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf8707761fd6a159c46061d2c06f0699619fff4d7c2e513a8a4628ec6230cefa075c629632e4d0a8627c3783&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) , which bailed now-convicted rapists, assaulters, and murderers out of jail.
+ She supports defunding the police, decriminalizing illegal immigration, and opposing the death penalty for even the most gruesome cop-killers.
+ Kamala Harris has been an apologist for Black Lives Matter violence, radical race-baiting policies, and DEI wokeism.
* Kamala Harris has a history of praising radical government-controlled health care plans.
+ Harris thinks supporting Bernie Sanders’ Medicare For All plan would be the “right thing to do” (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf870776284e4782f6ce9c38e34ab61f5204b6498b3037bab8925d569dbb056e384c49eddd2234e84aabe517&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365) and considers health care coverage to be “a right.” (https://click.campaigns.rnchq.com/?qs=1b1ee25bbf8707767c688902799523ae1ec00af437bdfe4cd015280cbfb34a89a4df96d51eb556c753e94f26a5596beb&utm_source=Nebraska+Republican+Party&utm_campaign=0fafaddaaf-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_1_2_2024_7_59_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_72fdf24cb0-0fafaddaaf-21732365)

body:
Your daily rundown of REAL news for REAL Coloradans.
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
| | Hello there,
We are living in truly unprecedented times. With President Joe Biden out of the presidential race and now seemingly missing in action, and Kamala Harris as the presumptive Democratic Party nominee, many of us are yearning for the stability of precedented times. The political landscape is shifting rapidly, and it's more important than ever to stay engaged and vigilant about the issues that matter most to our families and communities.
I want to take a moment to announce a critical initiative. As Kevin Lundberg eloquently stated, "We must insist that girls only compete against girls in their sports programs and tell parents if their child is experiencing any gender confusion in a public school." This is why Protect Kids Colorado ([ProtectKidsColorado.org]()) is collecting signatures for these two vital citizen initiatives, and they only have until the end of this month to get this all wrapped up.
Their efforts are crucial in this cause. Protect Kids Colorado needs all hands on deck to gather the necessary signatures and ensure these initiatives make it to the November ballot. Together, they can make a significant impact and protect the rights and well-being of our children.
Thank you, Protect Kids Colorado, for your dedication and commitment to this cause. Let's work together to bring about the change we wish to see.
This is the Mountain Minute for Tuesday, July 23, 2024.
In Freedom,

Heidi Ganahl
---
|
---
| | **TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
---
**[Lundberg: Help us protect kids in Colorado, sign in support of our ballot initiatives](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
_We only have nine days left to collect all the signatures we need to put on the ballot the initiatives that will help protect kids and families from the transgender ideology that is sweeping through our public schools._
_I have been in the fight to protect our families and children for many years. Last year, I made a documentary, ArtClubMovie.com, about the transgender ideology that is working its way into our public schools here in Colorado. Just this year, the legislature passed and the governor signed a bill into law that requires all public schools, including charter schools, to use any non-legal name that a student adopts. This is a not so subtle way of forcing all public schools to engage in pushing the transgender ideology onto our kids._
_In my 16 years in the Colorado Legislature, I saw this coming, but now it has arrived: the schools are actively promoting transgenderism and most often hiding it from parents (see ArtClubMovie.com). This is why I helped start Protect Kids Colorado and now we have two initiatives to give the people of Colorado the opportunity to stand up and stop this dangerous trend._
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Air Force Academy: Dorm remodel could cost almost $600 million](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [MILITARY.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Air Force Academy's Sijan Hall dormitory, built in 1968, needs a $597 million remodel to update heating, electrical, plumbing, and fire protection systems, as well as window walls, bathrooms, cadet rooms, and workspaces.
* The remodel is expected to occur in five phases, but funding challenges exist, as the dorms don't qualify for certain Department of Defense funds and must rely on the Air Force’s Facilities Sustainment, Restoration, and Modernization program, which has a significant backlog.
* Col. Amy Glisson emphasized the importance of updating the dorm to compete for talent with top universities, while broader issues of substandard barracks across the Department of Defense are also being addressed by lawmakers.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Rep. Boebert: ‘I’m asking Joe Biden to provide the American people with proof of life’](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* U.S. Rep. Lauren Boebert demanded proof of President Joe Biden's existence in three separate Twitter/X posts, questioning his absence from public view and citing concerns about his health.
* Boebert's demands were fueled by rumors and reports, including a tweet from Charlie Kirk suggesting an emergency situation involving Biden in Las Vegas and his subsequent return to the East Coast.
* Despite a letter from President Biden's physician confirming he is performing his presidential duties, Boebert continued to insist that a doctor's note is not sufficient proof of life.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Annexation of 3,200 acres into Colorado Springs could be decided Tuesday](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [COLORADO POLITICS ](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)
* The Colorado Springs City Council will vote on a 3,200-acre annexation request by La Plata Communities to develop Amara, a master-planned community with up to 9,500 homes and 2 million square feet of commercial space.
* The proposed annexation has sparked debate over water availability, public safety concerns, and whether it logically extends Colorado Springs' boundaries, given its current separation from the city by state land.
* Proponents argue Amara will provide much-needed housing and support population growth, while opponents worry about the financial and logistical impacts on Colorado Springs Utilities and the neighboring city of Fountain.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)**
|
---
**[Smrz: Is the support by Colorado Gov. Jared Polis of Ukraine war funding an indicator he is eyeing the DNC presidential ticket?](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.)** [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.), COMMENTARY
_The United States’ continued funding of the Ukraine-Russia war is set to be a key issue in the 2024 presidential race, raising questions about whether Colorado Gov. Jared Polis is positioning himself for a spot on the Democratic National Convention’s presidential ticket._
_Following President Biden’s withdrawal from the race, and endorsement of Vice President Kamala Harris, the Democratic Party initially unified in support of her. However, Harris’ path to the nomination remains uncertain. Concerns about her electability create uncertainty about her candidacy._

# Stand With Patti Hewitt

| Peter,
We have to play smart, not dirty.

**Buddy Carter has been a thorn in the side of our community for too long.** His reputation as a "good ol' boy" politician who prioritizes profits over people has hurt us all. From keeping other pharmacies out of Pooler to voting against essential environmental protections, Carter's actions show **he doesn’t care about our well-being.**
He’s known for his connections to Big Pharma and his disregard for the people he represents. Carter’s decision to vote against certifying the 2020 election results and his support for policies that harm Coastal Georgia are unacceptable.**It’s time for a leader who truly cares.**
**Patti Hewitt is ready to protect our democracy and fight for Coastal Georgians.** She’s committed to ensuring women's rights, improving our schools, and expanding healthcare access.
* [**Donate $10, $25, $50,**](https://pattiforgeorgia.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=8b4d0ba6402550309dbd7c06a&id=85a526d95f&e=0f456155ff) or whatever you can to support Patti Hewitt’s campaign. Patti’s grassroots campaign relies on people like you. Every contribution counts.

* **Spread the word** to your friends and family about Patti Hewitt.

Stand with Patti Hewitt today and let’s take control of our future!

---

_They sought to vilify and demonize us – to RUIN us personally, professionally, and financially. They’re even seeking to**JAIL** us as completely innocent men!_

---
**_“Rudy Giuliani Could Lose Homes After Judge's Ruling”_** [Source: _Newsweek_]

---
_The** _HOPE_** that I felt when seeing President Trump take the stage in 2016, is the very same hope I *still* feel today despite all the witch hunts and phony charges that Crooked Joe and his Deep State goons have brought against President Trump and me._
---
Why? Because just like President Trump, generous patriots like _YOU_ have shown me what it will take to defeat Crooked Joe and the Left’s Third-World _regime_. **We NEVER,_EVER_ SURRENDER to it!**

Team,

I wanted to make sure you know personally: **I’m running for Congress in Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District and I am so thankful you joined our team.**

**[I’d like to tell you my story, and ask you to chip in to my campaign for a better future for Wisconsin and our country.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89382630/487130613/265882037?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&source=kl_em_welcome&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZWIxMDEwNC1mNDQ4LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uW-hhNCUmiaEb3Vx6dJeNdFmkJfll-G6KgUmoM59d84=)**

I grew up in northeast Wisconsin, in a working class family where too often, **we struggled.**

As a kid, I would never have dreamed of running for office – though I always wanted to serve my community. I’ve been practicing medicine for years, **focusing on women’s health and reproductive care, while working particularly in underserved communities.**

But today, I’m not practicing in the Green Bay area, where I grew up and where I live. **Thanks first to the harsh restrictions on abortion care in Wisconsin that were passed in 1849 – before women could even vote – and then to the threat of retaliation after I helped overturn those restrictions,** I travel to Minnesota every month, and also travel to Arizona to deliver babies and care for patients.

Those long commutes have given me plenty of time to think about where we’re at as a state, and as a country. I’ve spent a lot of time talking with my neighbors, fellow doctors, and folks all across our community about the challenges we’re facing. **Our healthcare system is in crisis. Doctors and nurses are leaving the field in droves. There’s confusion about how we can care for our patients under new restrictions that are a direct result of _Dobbs_.** And it all goes back to the division that too many politicians have sown in recent years.

[**I’m running for office to do something about it.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89382631/487130615/358074747?amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&source=kl_em_welcome&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIyNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkZWIxMDEwNC1mNDQ4LWVmMTEtODZjMy02MDQ1YmRkOWUwOTYiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=uW-hhNCUmiaEb3Vx6dJeNdFmkJfll-G6KgUmoM59d84=)

We have a real opportunity to flip this open seat, put an end to the divisiveness, and pass policies that help families in northeast Wisconsin – and every corner of the country. From expanding rural broadband access to implementing a social safety net that catches struggling families, we’ve got a lot of work to do. It won’t be easy. But most things worth doing aren’t easy.

Team, I wanted to make sure you know personally: I’m running for Congress in Wisconsin’s 8th Congressional District and I am so thankful you joined our team. = I grew up in northeast Wisconsin, in a working class family where too often, we struggled. As a kid, I would never have dreamed of running for office – though I always wanted to serve my community. I’ve been practicing medicine for years, focusing on women’s health and reproductive care, while working particularly in underserved communities. But today, I’m not practicing in the Green Bay area, where I grew up and where I live. Thanks first to the harsh restrictions on abortion care in Wisconsin that were passed in 1849 – before women could even vote – and then to the threat of retaliation after I helped overturn those restrictions, I travel to Minnesota every month, and also travel to Arizona to deliver babies and care for patients. Those long commutes have given me plenty of time to think about where we’re at as a state, and as a country. I’ve spent a lot of time talking with my neighbors, fellow doctors, and folks all across our community about the challenges we’re facing. Our healthcare system is in crisis. Doctors and nurses are leaving the field in droves. There’s confusion about how we can care for our patients under new restrictions that are a direct result of Dobbs. And it all goes back to the division that too many politicians have sown in recent years. = We have a real opportunity to flip this open seat, put an end to the divisiveness, and pass policies that help families in northeast Wisconsin – and every corner of the country. If every Democrat and everyone who wants to defeat Trump and elect Democrats this fall gave $7 today, we'd have the resources we need to win _big_ in November.Unfortunately, not everyone gives. So we need Democrats who understand the stakes of this moment -- and this election -- to chip in today.
There is no organization better positioned to move resources where they need to go, when they need to arrive than the DNC. That is what we do. But we can’t do it without the support of committed Democrats like you.If keeping Trump out of the White House and electing Democrats at all levels this fall is worth $7 to you, please take a minute to secure our success by making a donation. Thank you.

name: Dana Criswell
subject: The Importance of the Electoral College
body:
In just a few months we will elect a president and vice president. An often misunderstood part of that election is the Electoral College. Established by the Founding Fathers in the Constitution, the Electoral College has played a crucial role in American democracy since its inception. Its importance lies in balancing the interests of different states, safeguarding against potential abuses of power, and ensuring a stable and representative government.

In just a few months we will elect a president and vice president. An often misunderstood part of that election is the Electoral College. Established by the Founding Fathers in the Constitution, the Electoral College has played a crucial role in American democracy since its inception. Its importance lies in balancing the interests of different states, safeguarding against potential abuses of power, and ensuring a stable and representative government.
**1\. Balancing State Interests**
One of the primary reasons the Electoral College was created was to balance the interests of both large and small states. In a direct popular vote system, candidates might focus solely on populous urban areas to secure the majority of votes, neglecting less populated rural states. The Electoral College ensures that candidates must pay attention to a broad coalition of states, including those with smaller populations. This system requires presidential candidates to campaign across the country, addressing diverse regional concerns and interests. As a result, it promotes a more inclusive approach to governance and prevents the dominance of any single region over national politics.
**2\. Protecting Minority Interests**
The Founding Fathers were concerned about the potential tyranny of the majority, where the rights and interests of minority groups could be overlooked or suppressed by the will of the majority. The Electoral College mitigates this risk by requiring a candidate to win electoral votes from various states, not just a simple majority of the national popular vote. This system encourages candidates to build broad-based support across different regions and demographic groups, ensuring that minority interests are considered and addressed. It helps maintain a more balanced and representative democracy by encouraging coalition-building and cross-regional alliances.
**3\. Preventing the Concentration of Power**
The Electoral College also serves as a safeguard against the concentration of power. In a direct popular vote system, it is conceivable that a charismatic leader could mobilize a large, fervent base of support concentrated in a few populous areas, potentially leading to unchecked power. The Electoral College disperses the voting power across states, making it more difficult for any single faction to dominate the electoral process. By requiring candidates to win electoral votes from a variety of states, the system promotes a more measured and deliberate approach to campaigning and governance.
**4\. Enhancing Political Stability**
Another important aspect of the Electoral College is its contribution to political stability. By providing a clear and decisive method for electing the president, the system helps prevent prolonged electoral disputes and uncertainty. The winner-takes-all approach used by most states in awarding electoral votes typically results in a clear winner, even in closely contested elections. This reduces the likelihood of drawn-out legal battles and challenges to election results, contributing to a smoother and more orderly transition of power.
**5\. Historical Significance and Constitutional Foundation**
The Electoral College is deeply rooted in American history and the constitutional framework established by the Founding Fathers. It reflects their intent to create a federal system that balances the powers of the national and state governments. While the system has faced criticism and calls for reform, it remains a fundamental part of the constitutional design that has shaped American democracy for over two centuries.
The Electoral College is an essential component of the United States' electoral system, designed to balance state interests, protect minority rights, prevent the concentration of power, and enhance political stability. While it may seem complex and controversial, its underlying principles reflect a commitment to a balanced and representative democracy. By requiring presidential candidates to build broad-based support across diverse regions and populations, the Electoral College continues to play a vital role in ensuring that the president represents the interests of the entire nation.

[**A MESSAGE FROM TULSI GABBARD ->** ](http://links.justandfreegop.com/u/click?_t=8ca5ef3d31cc43bcb1fbe6968d953911&_m=11bea9ed547b4971863bb87d147abfca&_e=0mrYIeuxdMvf626b-32KK7UfX6yvN7gHTHH1NxGb0kJ4WP-X8Zk--Zgs6KgMsbBUqrBafgQ7129MFdIgLIOy2Gq5h3BpctLUNOw0rvpuoj_b7oR40Rt3utguo77_NT_nihz7Wi0h9u11pvSaWuFdACpPaG7czk_ZF-c3-7NEUcoq9Efyfbpe-kQzdAs4Xo582_kFexgrICF6sU9F__Uizh5-IO9xNcAvqv_SvDie3DrpUA15UeY87w-vwv-YB9cN3b69iWaz9DK4GV_6j4g1u6vzp-uOl9YCqOWDiA6y-Ej39X9MSHp7W8kR2OXYwmZbQheuM5KdEnA5qPlu93Dx-vjw-j98FQjjnPwKxkQnPwdu2dVNaHIr8TETnRN-kLxf8zSwI_y_7YbD2jBIbakM0w%3D%3D)

I knew I had to help, Fellow Conservative.
_
I was in Montana recently to rally support for Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy as he campaigns to unseat Jon Tester._

When I found out Navy SEAL Tim Sheehy was running for Senate in Montana, I knew I needed to help this decorated warfighter and true patriot defeat the Washington establishment incumbent, Jon Tester.

subject: A historic moment and the case for your support
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ELISSA SLOTKIN FOR MICHIGAN
body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1679%2E135344%2EGuNR-P)

Friend --
We are emerging from an unprecedented moment in our nation’s history, and a historic turning point that we will look back on for decades to come. In this day and age, that means if you're anything like us, your inbox is filled with requests from political campaigns and organizations asking for donations.
With your permission, I’d appreciate the chance to make the case for why a donation to my campaign for U.S. Senate is one of the most strategic contributions you can make at this moment.
Let me start with what you probably already instinctively know: Michigan is going to be a critical state for the 2024 campaign — and this weekend’s news only solidified that.
But you were probably already sold on the importance of Michigan. So, aside from the fact that control of the U.S. Senate is at stake (!), what about my race? Why donate to my campaign?
This is one of the rare open Senate races without an incumbent running. That means we have A LOT of introducing of me to do across the state. We are running TV ads all across the state, but it’s important we continue to do the work of reaching voters all the way through Election Day.
Reaching those folks takes resources, and that's not something I can do without you.
Add the fact that this is going to be one of the most expensive races in the country — not just with candidate spending, but outside spending too.
And I'll close with the news that in all of my elections, I have historically done better than Democrats usually do in the "redder" areas of the state. That means I am finding and pulling voters other races couldn't, and that is good for everyone up and down the ballot on Election Day.
So yes, this race is kind of a unicorn. It's a unique situation where control of the White House and Congress is on the line, most voters don't know the candidates yet, and because our race is the top of the ticket in the state, our campaign will likely impact the presidential.
[**That's why I am asking for your support: Can I count on you to make a contribution to my campaign for U.S. Senate today? I would not ask if it were not so important.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240723-1-900&t=2&akid=1679%2E135344%2EGuNR-P)

If you’ve followed election coverage over the last year or so, the pundits might lead you to believe something new is happening.
Despite high disapproval for President Joe Biden in red states like Kentucky and Mississippi, Democrats outperformed their party’s presidential margin in statewide races by double digits. And after Republican-dominated legislatures passed extreme abortion bans in red states like Kansas and Ohio, voters delivered huge wins for reproductive rights and democracy.
But the truth is, this isn’t all that new. While pundits and insiders increasingly divide us into columns of red and blue based on their one-dimensional view of politics, voters continue to confound their expectations in election after election.
Missouri is a great example. While our state has shifted solidly red in presidential preferences since 2012, Democrats have won a half-dozen statewide campaigns, even as recently as 2018. And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters.
**Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets.**
I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%.
We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri.
That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — _except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there._
Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party.
**[I’m proud to support Lucas Kunce in his race against Josh Hawley and I hope you’ll join me by adding a donation of $10 or whatever you’re able to today. Multiple polls have already confirmed that this will be a tight race, so your early support could be what helps Lucas tip the scales.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/60282?refcode=em20240723-7153&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7153%2E614464%2EH5HN-R)**

---
**Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable.**
Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war.
And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood.
From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans.
**Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen.**
Approval polling from _Morning Consult_ shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the _“worst mistake I ever made.”_
Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — _“So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!”_
**Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it.** The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race.

Just as we saw in elections across the country — both last year and in the last decade — pundits and presidential politics won’t be deciding the result of every race in 2024. Voters will be.
**That’s why I’m confident that Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley.**
And with so much at stake in this election — reproductive freedom, health care access, and even our democracy — this race must be a priority.
That’s why I’m asking you today, Peter:

And when Missouri politicians have adopted extreme positions on issues such as abortion, workers’ rights or health care, they’ve often seen their out-of-touch agendas soundly rejected by voters. Just like voters in states where we’ve seen big wins for Democrats and pro-freedom initiatives in the past year, hundreds of thousands of voters in Missouri are still splitting their tickets. I know this more than most because I’ve lived it. I won a race for Missouri Secretary of State. And in 2016, Missouri’s last Senate race to take place during a presidential election, I fell just 2.8% short of defeating a longtime Republican incumbent for U.S. Senate. And I outperformed the Democratic presidential ticket’s margin by more than 16%. We proved that in races where well-funded candidates can set themselves apart and make it clear to voters that they’ll fight for them in office, Democrats can win in Missouri. That’s what we’re seeing in Missouri’s current U.S. Senate race, as my friend Lucas Kunce takes on incumbent Josh Hawley. Much like my race in 2016, 2024 pits a labor-backed veteran against a politician — except my opponent never tried to overthrow the government violently just to get his name out there. Now up for reelection in 2024, Hawley faces Lucas, a Marine veteran and antitrust advocate who’s broken fundraising records, rallied Missouri’s election-winning labor movement behind him and built a reputation as a different kind of Democrat who speaks truth to power, regardless of party. If you've stored your info with ActBlue Express, we'll process your contribution instantly: Now let’s talk about why Josh Hawley is so vulnerable. Hawley famously popped popcorn in his dorm room to gleefully watch the invasion of Iraq and then claimed a decade later to have opposed the war. And since he’s represented Missouri in the U.S. Senate, he’s also become known as a desperately anti-union scab who is self-consciously obsessed with manhood. From blocking defense nominations to voting against health care for veterans exposed to burn pits, Hawley has put his personal politics ahead of national security and the needs of military families. And he’s used his office to build a family business dedicated to restricting abortion access nationwide as his allies in Jefferson City enacted one of the nation’s most extreme abortion bans. Now with five years under Hawley’s belt in the U.S. Senate, Missourians don’t like what they’ve seen. Approval polling from Morning Consult shows that Hawley has the lowest approval of any GOP senator running for reelection in 2024, lower than Sens. Ted Cruz of Texas and Rick Scott of Florida. And even his mentor, Missouri’s former U.S. Sen. John Danforth, has called backing Hawley the “worst mistake I ever made.” Donald Trump recently commented on Hawley’s race too — “So interesting that the Democrats are looking hard at the Senate races in both Missouri and Texas. Josh and Ted must be very careful, stranger things have happened!!!” Hawley is vulnerable, and everyone knows it. The proof is in his rapidly changing election-season rhetoric, Republicans in Washington fretting about their draconian abortion bans across the country, and Hawley’s billionaire allies launching a new pro-Hawley super PAC right after Lucas entered the race. Just as we saw in elections across the country — both last year and in the last decade — pundits and presidential politics won’t be deciding the result of every race in 2024. Voters will be. That’s why I’m confident that Lucas Kunce can defeat Josh Hawley. And with so much at stake in this election — reproductive freedom, health care access, and even our democracy — this race must be a priority. I laughed. I cried. I cheered. Kamala Harris is our new Democratic Presidential Nominee.
Within the party, Democrats have demonstrated the peaceful transfer of power. We have honored the old and lifted up the new. As the endorsements rolled in, the fundraising poured in. The delegates pledged votes, assuring that this would not be an open and chaotic convention.
And then Joe Biden called into the campaign headquarters to speak to Kamala. I cried. Were these tears of relief, after all of the tensions of the past three weeks?
Or were these tears of relief for the tensions of several generations?
Kamala Harris was born in 1964. A woman of color was not guaranteed the right to vote in all 50 states until the Civil Rights Act of 1965 - passed under the leadership of another Democratic President who stepped aside, Lyndon Baines Johnson.
As a person of South Asian descent, her mother would have had a much more difficult task of immigrating to this country were she to attempt to do so now, as opposed to when she came here to study at university and then found work. I'll refrain from listing all of the ethnic slurs casually flung at immigrants from India.
What Harris has accomplished as a woman of mixed race is extraordinary. Stunning, really.
And here she is, ready and very well prepared to command our nation and provide executive leadership. Kamala Harris is ready to wrestle the hearts and minds of voters away from Donald Trump. "I know his type," she declared, recounting his career as a sex offender, a fraud, and a cheat. [Huffpost says Trump is trying to avoid](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/747c8f07-1d9a-425f-8f0b-0145fcf7f9c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) or change the rules for the next presidential debate. So much for confidence in one's message or presentation.
Yesterday Harris spoke of the past and of the future. Trump wants to take us back several decades in his plot to implement Project 2025 and "Make America Great Again." He wants to deprive women of rights that another heroic woman Presidential Nominee designated "human rights."
Harris and the Democratic Party envision a future in which we build up the middle class, and support equal justice for all, not just for some.
It took less than 24 hours for the press to again launch into its paralysis by analysis. The NY Times had an op-ed this morning: ["Is it a mistake to go all in for Harris," ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/568358e4-89e7-4873-8619-dab8a87cc024?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)by Douthat, French, Goldberg, and Polgreen. Just stop. I can't. Too soon. Let me laugh and cry for a few more days. I need catharsis.
Those of us working on down ballot campaigns, such as the race for Congress in NY-21, paused, laughed, cried, cheered, and then got back to work. For context, NY-21 is the 15 county district in upstate New York where I am the Democrat running against Elise Stefanik. The district spans over 15,000 square miles. I drive a whole lot these days.
The people of Lowville (Lewis County) and Rome (Oneida County) have had devastating storms. Businesses, homes, schools, churches - many are gone. Some will repair. Others will need to start all over. Curiously missing from the scene while I delivered water, helped arrange shuttles to shelters, and talked to people about steps to take when (really, at this point, "if") FEMA funding comes through was the current Representative for the district. Rome is new in NY-21, after redistricting. It would have been a great chance for people to meet their new Congresswoman. Oh well. She was in Milwaukee. The whole time? The RNC has adjourned, but they're still doing cleanup in Lowville and Rome, you know.
I've had the honor of being at a few events, such as the Doo Dah Parade in Ilion (Herkimer County), and attending the E-Town Parade in Elizabethtown (Essex County). I went to the Washington County Democrats Picnic, in the middle of farm country in Granville. Tonight I'm at the Mohawks Baseball Game in Amsterdam. Tomorrow I'm doing drive time radio at 8:05 am with WVMT with Kurt Wright. That's a Vermont station, but they have a big audience in Plattsburgh (Clinton County). Saturday I'm back in Rome for what I hope will be a courageous [Honor America Days Parade. ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/9c827c87-3c64-4989-8772-8b149f2c4d83?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
What I'm hearing from voters is that they are ready to get on with it. Enough high-level talk. Let's solve some of these issues. They need universal broadband access so they can, whenever possible, work from home, like much of the rest of the United States can. Moreover, they need the assurance that if they are in a car accident on one of the county roads, they can call for help. Personally, I would like good cell phone and broadband so I can just get from Point A to Point B with GPS. Just when I get lost, I look and realize I have no reception whatsoever.
The voters need sensible immigration policies. Sure, there are people who have bought into Trump's lie that thousands of members of Al Quaeda are pouring over the Northern border. Not true. [The numbers:](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/383c6e2a-e421-4a31-adf4-7190438fcd38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) at the Northern border, Trump expelled 400,000 people. Biden expelled 2 million. But many people in NY-21 realize that we need some type of workable policy for immigration. For example, the people in the agriculture, healthcare, and hospitality industries need border policies that are paired with a temporary work visa. Our hotels and restaurants are simply not making it on local talent alone. We need migrants.
The voters want to know more about Project 2025. They are terrified that the destruction of the EPA poses an existential threat to the rivers and lakes and forests of the Adirondacks.
They want to know about Dobbs and abortion bans. They need assurance that their daughters and grandaughters have access to proper health care, including contraception and hormonal therapies.
Most importantly, they want a representative who shows up when there is a problem, such as in Lowville or Rome. And they want someone who [doesn't lie, or take credit for appropriations to the district that they voted against. ](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/94ddd7ab-72c8-47cc-8a0b-29c20c15e7d0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Celebrate that we, for a few hours (which can seem like a year in political news) have, for the most part, a semblance of unity around the nomination of Harris. But don't take your eyes off of the downballot races.
Kamala Harris and her running mate will need a Congress they can work with. We need a House and a Senate that can pass legislation to preserve our current form of government.
The counties and cities and towns will need local Democratic infrastructure that can support and implement policies on the ground.
Get involved with a campaign. [Send money](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/e43088e1-aa55-4126-a5d7-dd5805b3dd2a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Even a little bit helps to put gas in the car so I can show up and talk to voters. (I guess I was naive. I had no idea there was $82 million floating around that could be sent to a campaign in a single day. Staggering.)
Write postcards. Send letters to the editor (super important in rural communities). Contact the campaign to make phone calls. Talk up the campaign online so others can do the same.
We're Democrats. We can do this.
_If we haven 't met yet, I am Paula Collins, the Democratic and Working Families Party Candidate for New York's 21st Congressional District. Your comments are invaluable to me. Please let me hear from you. Remember that you can always visit my website at www.paulacollinsforcongress.com or by sending me a text at 315-230-3920. _

subject: The Patriotic Roadmap I Wrote for You
body:
It’s a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives—for the better. | | | [](http://links.makingamericathegreatest.com/u/click?_t=79fa4a3daf024a0a886c5b498ff32e32&_m=e34c8a8674f34be19ea2f74f7a7d05a3&_e=5r0cg-gdk3pZHoYK6VI25luy-RRN97nc9_AF2pMKzxqUrtDuKpSZOX92C0tCuFroYqc00MWIo0f_Aw9Ud_pVznUQBVXNS0NYHiPRThihr2AercJWfwEOzi9y1d1SkKnAxo_8N9PH0KuCElqDpr61x7gf8bnzB26GPtgEf18Z-_xXJbm8Cd-7Y4tlL1Umdw4SH0VzDkxHLR_t2D_PAf5AhLDmFQl5ARKreCIkXILAxTd-7kj0D2dzy-kbzb0kyF4HEH5lNGVV4IRpk4tDsofv5qn5cfxm9j1N3RIE6zll2OfqMr7k1lqCD8a9z2ft4vGM)

The last few days have been wild, team —
President Joe Biden has withdrawn from the presidential race and has endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to take his place.
In the few remaining months left in the cycle, we need to come together and stand against bigotry and hatred. **Vice President Harris will need all the help she can get to secure the presidency and save our democracy from extremism.**
She’s our best shot at pushing this country forward, so we’re calling on our network of over 2 million young voters to make her election a reality.
The fight for our future is officially ON. We only have 104 days until Election Day, with early voting starting in some places as soon as _September_.
And in this race between a champion for democracy and the rule of law and an orange convicted felon, **_the choice couldn’t be more clear._**

#
Peter,

My name is Lila Rose, and I'm the founder and president of Live Action.

I'm reaching out with an urgent and heartfelt request. This month, Live Action is partnering with pro-life pregnancy resource centers nationwide to provide onesies for mothers and babies in need. Will you join us for our first-ever onesie drive?

This month only, a gift of $60 will provide three custom "Wonderfully Made" onesies to three moms and their babies at risk of abortion. These onesies are more than just clothing--they are symbols of hope and reminders that every child is a precious gift, beautifully and wonderfully made. [ ](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b81e5b2b4a4642acbf864817515382dc&_e=7j4YYMFR3EOxJ0oT7ahs8111fcQ9IznixknHZbNzWpMRhqPWljRLqVfegJyrl0oQpYeFgb5fXdEcUKdazpWaDywbtr--ieygOLieYFJzFeKrH7H17pHC3hHD1WKbx6ZDc-Bq-uFe2J3M5H7_wuS5DRJ3nWuHnTEgVFn7ueFXrf2iDzaAmCWw6pa5AqLco8Di4TzIaPFPmLrNzLAymjm4J8roob22S4grIMhhQtxPw6zp2BaYagc0ld7zqFOoz5bpYWGa33CHXKGlsbYVevQIjeiVarbW_i-BqEoakY-4mKQYw9W__n67-fnHNvQkLD_v1i77muqU-ISQWz1RhZA9BcOSWtzO58o9b6h8uleyG18%3D)
Onesies are a basic necessity for every baby. More than that, they symbolize the love and care each new life needs to thrive--a tangible representation of personal connection and love for both mother and baby. For mothers facing unplanned pregnancies or struggling with financial difficulties, having the basics provided can make all the difference in helping them feel supported.

Every baby is a gift that deserves to be cherished and provided for, and every mother deserves to know her baby is treasured not just by her but also by her community.

Abortion providers like Planned Parenthood rely on women feeling isolated by their unplanned pregnancies. Together, we can show these courageous women they are supported and loved by a community that values every life.

To make this possible, you can donate $60 to send custom onesies to three moms and babies in need. Click here to donate: **[https://give.liveaction.org/send-a-onesie-today/](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b81e5b2b4a4642acbf864817515382dc&_e=7j4YYMFR3EOxJ0oT7ahs8111fcQ9IznixknHZbNzWpMRhqPWljRLqVfegJyrl0oQpYeFgb5fXdEcUKdazpWaDywbtr--ieygOLieYFJzFeKrH7H17pHC3hHD1WKbx6ZDc-Bq-uFe2J3M5H7_wuS5DRJ3nWuHnTEgVFn7ueFXrf1FFkqh7aKY8K1n3bMh61jW5rCidltJg5QjmW9BRuVZiqRuH9L1dO71TmHgkz7ZJer_ymBUJCC1LmCCzeykloJiY2T87PI9qN-hJ7wPNgT9-ERlkDxBvwA40M8FSOihfuOd5rPTzKdZGiYtJNYCcf3CfHSDhfgBWElNzGbvCHOVukrwXo3QamnRKE7WcW7OHu8%3D)**

If you can, please share this email with friends and family who might also want to help or share our campaign on social media to raise awareness.

Thank you for stepping up to support mothers and their precious children. With your help, we can make a profound difference in these families' lives.

For Life,

Lila Rose
**President and Founder**
Live Action

_P.S. Remember, this campaign only runs until the end of the month! Please act now to[**provide a onesie to a baby in need.**](http://links.bestamericanow.com/u/click?_t=f6e78b69acbb4291bd75bc93fae35a62&_m=b81e5b2b4a4642acbf864817515382dc&_e=7j4YYMFR3EOxJ0oT7ahs8111fcQ9IznixknHZbNzWpMRhqPWljRLqVfegJyrl0oQpYeFgb5fXdEcUKdazpWaDywbtr--ieygOLieYFJzFeKrH7H17pHC3hHD1WKbx6ZDc-Bq-uFe2J3M5H7_wuS5DRJ3nWuHnTEgVFn7ueFXrf1FFkqh7aKY8K1n3bMh61jW5rCidltJg5QjmW9BRuVZilHBgoteZKPhfqe5TXgfX9LK-xPo3vM5bS3YQ3NyEDLzgEhrQ1zICP3mLvJuox6RgfsDBPiypvkYxy_bjK-HUJMPafsU22fk5iTAoR7fbkPwSVGRA8eudRiTgGfCkbhWWxT_iSek7tLXRx6l5w2TA8o%3D) Your gift will be a beacon of hope and a powerful affirmation of life. Thank you!_

We've been working on voter registration since we were founded in 2020, folks.
Amidst a global pandemic, we came together to advocate for mail-in ballots, register new voters, and educate everyone on how easy mail-in voting was. We succeeded beyond our wildest expectations.
So we stepped it up for 2022. Our focus was on eligible non-voters in Nevada, a key state for voter access, and helped drive tens of thousands of disengaged citizens to register to vote and participate in our elections with many key statewide races on the ballot, including Governor, Senator, Secretary of State, and Attorney General.
With our democracy and our right to vote threatened again , we have no choice but to respond and push harder. If the president can step aside for the sake of our country, the least we can do is honor that sacrifice by driving pro-democracy voters to the polls.
Our voter registration work has succeeded $3 at a time. Will you keep it going with $24 today to help register 8 more new voters? Dear Friend,
I'm excited to share an insightful eBook from the Hoover Institution, "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism." This work explores the deep-seated debates around free-market capitalism and its alternatives, and you can get your
free copy at this link.
In the eBook, Russell Roberts challenges the common view that capitalism is based on greed and results in inequality. He argues that free-market competition leads to innovation and better outcomes for consumers and workers.

Ayaan Hirsi Ali, drawing from her experiences growing up in socialist Somalia, illustrates how capitalism can enhance personal freedom and improve living standards. Her powerful narrative shows how economic systems shape individual lives.
This eBook is part of the Human Prosperity Project, which offers scholarly analyses of various economic systems and their impacts on prosperity and well-being.
This eBook provides a balanced perspective on why capitalism might be the more humane and effective choice in a time of growing traction for socialist ideas.

Click here to request your free copy of "Personal Freedom and the Moral Case for Capitalism."

Best regards,
Greg Stamps

Greg Stamps | Online Development
Hoover Institution | Stanford University

With its eminent scholars and world-renowned Library and Archives, the Hoover Institution is a non-partisan, data-driven policy research organization that seeks to improve the human condition by advancing ideas that promote economic
prosperity, national security, and democratic governance. Over more than one hundred years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world.

| | Dear Peter,

Your ballot for the August primary election should have arrived over the weekend - it is time to Get Out The Vote for our great Republican candidates across the state.

We have strong Republicans running for county offices, legislative seats, Congress, US Senate and important statewide offices like Governor and Attorney General - **voting for the citizen initiatives and President will be on your November general election ballot.**

During our April State Convention, nearly 2,000 elected delegates representing all 39 counties voted on endorsements for statewide and congressional offices - below is the list of endorsements you can use to help fill out your ballot. **Make sure to return your ballot by Tuesday, August 6th.**

body:

---
| |
---
| Good morning Friend,

We are kicking off our fall Speaker Series with none other than Mississippi’s State Auditor, Shad White, for an exclusive discussion on some of the most pressing issues facing our state, on September 19th at the Country Club of Jackson.
---
| [ ](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=99d532c4cc&e=5703353baa)
---
_Click above to purchase your tickets!_
| **Why You Should Attend:**
1. **Discover "The Mississippi Swindle":** Shad White will share insights from his new book, uncovering shocking stories of financial mismanagement and corruption in Mississippi. This is a must-read for anyone passionate about transparency and accountability in our state.
2. **Addressing K-12 Administrative Waste:** Our education system is plagued with inefficiencies. Shad will break down where the waste is happening and how we can redirect those resources to benefit our students and teachers directly.
3. **The Role of DEI in Public Universities:** Dive into a critical analysis of Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion programs in our public universities. How are these initiatives affecting academic standards and campus culture?

This event isn’t just about listening—it’s about engaging in meaningful dialogue and finding solutions. Whether you're a concerned parent, an educator, or simply someone who cares about the future of Mississippi, your voice matters. **RSVP[here](https://mspolicy.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=60d4052c66b6745831ccdf7c8&id=cbfd057dad&e=5703353baa) **to reserve your spot and join us for this important conversation.

As always, I am looking forward to seeing you there!
---
| |
---
Warmest wishes,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

body:
I just returned from Milwaukee, WI over the weekend and I am proud to be giving you my report on the two weeks at the RNC.
| | | | [](https://ghwh6lbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wOH4-NHghU2JD-LOwxD-DVYTVsMfCTzBD7y7vZC1cgPpWo2hTYT8Yo5dkGOPEspABOuss1518wasOGfWsdnArTU7oX9AHgZmwpM8hf5iY-S_-IZNEq2iclznLbsBVEDvRP6XjmiejCk29kXSszpTQxFjKEOcW0q-Hs9jPmmmTNWHMfCEPBPURnTGE03eoherEK4_w4kQZDw=&c=McFx4_3FU1NHONVzhxGUzIHhy0js_hTNpELqYtMCiE1GFokzJ35vRQ==&ch=yUbrLC6Bn-ivyMWhM28vFMaJONTeuW40ITWZ1qCW6894yi1iLk28iw==)
---
Friend, I just returned from Milwaukee, WI and as promised here is my full report on the 2024 Republican National Committee Meeting and the 2024 Republican National Convention:
Week One: The RNC Summer Meeting was incredible! During the meeting, we received updates on election integrity efforts, Trump Force 47 outreach plans, fundraising, and more.
The RNC and its sister organizations raised over 200 Million dollars in the last quarter since Chairman Whatley and Co-Chair Lara Trump took over and the party merged operations with the Trump Campaign.
Since the unification of the Trump Campaign and the National Committee, staffing has seen the biggest change. The RNC has eliminated a lot of unneeded positions in the organization all while consolidating roles under specific talented individuals. This has led to increased efficiency and lower operating costs at the national committee.
On the election integrity front, we have already recruited over 50,000 poll watchers and workers, over halfway to the party's goal of 100,000 election integrity workers being on the ground in November.
If you wish to join that effort please click [here.](https://ghwh6lbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wOH4-NHghU2JD-LOwxD-DVYTVsMfCTzBD7y7vZC1cgPpWo2hTYT8YoMbSSYoNIu8DaaJXTkEvCqQc9lGJj-E8Q_-9QnlAUP7DheXj6YmDTbCNGfcy4qk7XRJnqhMR5qFuUyXB78Tfg-hmyjjyxaQXSx0lBh57Vq6mTKTo9Qwqu0=&c=McFx4_3FU1NHONVzhxGUzIHhy0js_hTNpELqYtMCiE1GFokzJ35vRQ==&ch=yUbrLC6Bn-ivyMWhM28vFMaJONTeuW40ITWZ1qCW6894yi1iLk28iw==)
During the meeting it was again expressed to us the importance of voting early and "Swamping The Vote" the new and improved Bank Your Vote program that was launched by Chairwoman McDaniel last year.
I had the honor of speaking with both the Chair and Co-Chair about the status of the Youth Advisory Council and they both assured me that we will see action at the council very soon with a complete restructure starting in the coming weeks.
The RNC also amended the rules proposal that they submitted to the national convention to not change the term length of the National Committee Members. The original proposal which was widely opposed by the grassroots was to lengthen the term of the committee members to be through the inauguration of the new president in January. Meaning that incoming members would have begun their term in January instead of at the conclusion of the convention in a presidential year.
The amended rules were passed by the committee and later adopted by the convention, ensuring that the new RNC members took office at gavel down of the convention on the 18th.
Week Two: The 2024 Republican National Convention went off without a hitch, and I am proud to report that our delegation, no matter our differences, voted unanimously to support President Trump as our nominee after Nikki Haley unbound her delegates.
It is also important to note that the national committee adopted the new Republican Party Platform, a commitment to limited government, state's rights, and dedicated to the forgotten men and women of our great country.
As previously mentioned, the convention adopted the recommended rules changes from the National Committee meeting and remained unified in the mission to Make America Great Again!
President Trump was stronger than ever even in the wake of the assassination attempt that took place on July 13th. Security was tighter than I have ever seen it. I have attended over 25 events with President Trump both as Candidate, President, and now Former President, and I have never seen a presence like I did at the RNC. Neither the inauguration in 2017, nor the State of the Union in 2018 had as large of a presence as the convention.
The energy in the room on Thursday when President Trump accepted the nomination was off the charts. Between Hulk Hogan, Kid Rock, and Dana White, we were on our feet, and ready to welcome the next President to the stage.
It was the greatest honor of my life to represent Colorado's 7th District as a delegate at the convention and I am eternally grateful for the support that has been shown to me over the years as I have worked to ensure my generation has a seat at the table.
---
---
| In Closing: As we move forward into the coming weeks and months, I want to remind you that the race is nowhere near done. We have a lot of work to do, and we must be all in for President Trump and our down-ballot races, or we will fail in our mission to Make America Great Once Again.
As a member of the RNC's Youth Advisory Council, I would be honored to speak to your group, organization, youth group, or students about the importance of saving our great country. If you would like me to come speak at an event please click this link: [https://www.westonimer.net/book-online ](https://ghwh6lbbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001wOH4-NHghU2JD-LOwxD-DVYTVsMfCTzBD7y7vZC1cgPpWo2hTYT8YoMbSSYoNIu8RDIDRjiKimHTduIL5Z8P-lmmtGaFliahY8sqm1_VwZ8POKB8A5VewyCQXrhvc8v37z6Bp5la8Ghul465z8Ll0ifsyq6RpBa6IW95i4fVhIM=&c=McFx4_3FU1NHONVzhxGUzIHhy0js_hTNpELqYtMCiE1GFokzJ35vRQ==&ch=yUbrLC6Bn-ivyMWhM28vFMaJONTeuW40ITWZ1qCW6894yi1iLk28iw==)to schedule a time or contact me at the information below.
Again, I thank you for your continued support and I look forward to seeing you very soon!
Best,

name: Emily Hall
subject: Would you commit to pray for a missionary?
body:
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/vs2fgilWNG

At the top of every missionary's list when asked how to help is
the need for prayer
http://paracom.paramountcommunication.com/p/os2fgilWNG

Dear
Fellow Believer,

There are
so many challenges that missionaries face today:

Language.
Culture. Customs. Finances. Housing. Visas. Homesickness.

But at
the top of every missionary's list when asked how to help is the
need for prayer.

"Please
pray for us!" is the plea of missionaries all over the world.

That's
because they recognize it is only through God's power that they
can overcome the obstacles they face and break through darkness
with the light of the gospel.

Praying
for missionaries is one of the best things we can do-not just for
their sakes, but for ours. When we pray for missionaries, our
thoughts are focused on the spiritual needs of people groups all
over the world, and our hearts are aligned with God's desire to
give them abundant life.

I'm
hoping that by doing so, it will ignite a desire to make it an
ongoing habit.

If you
can spare a few moments each day for one week to lift up the
needs of men and women who are bringing the gospel to unreached
areas, we would be so grateful!

For the
next seven days, we'll send you an email telling you about
specific missionaries to pray for and the ministry they are
doing. Will you help in this way?

If so, go
here to start receiving prayer requests in your inbox for the
next seven days:
https://welcome.imb.org/pray_for_missionary_lp.html

On behalf
of the missionaries that you will be praying for this week, thank
you! Your prayers are more valuable than you might realize!

God bless
you,

Emily
Hall
Prayer
Content Specialist
IMB
Prayer Office

body:
Would you believe it if I told you that the presidential debate with Joe Biden and Donald Trump took place less than a month ago?| | | [](http://links.johnkasich.com/u/click?_t=6a3b28686d0a4d77958e12349305a4fe&_m=f348a422581a4f7bac41f3bcaf9d3269&_e=B0CGMhNYC_yLXFl6clQ_2juWSCSf6sYl6wTQ9lr_X-BP48D9AayX9Cdq5gQ8USOGlnCotFL5Cs8AsuTb68vJ_sGKG8gdqQHvXuMm06PvqySiMpLvAKfjNbEGl64Ps9sExySa9E4rxmS_qbYIPw7XXXtDvMHiJqSzkWE9ju_dUlPyTH3j215BPJctLGKhvi0sWYLzbgqq7WmnYYE0oGO1rQ%3D%3D)
---
Peter, Would you believe it if I told you that the presidential debate with Joe Biden and Donald Trump took place less than a month ago?

I don't know about you, but it feels like we've lived an entire lifetime of history and politics in these few short weeks. We’ve had to absorb a decade’s worth of drama, from the debate fallout, an assassination attempt, the Republican convention and now President Biden’s withdrawal from the election. American democracy is most healthy when we have a vibrant two-party system, and the recent events have highlighted the importance of having strong, capable leadership from both sides.

For some time, Americans had been frustrated about the rematch of Biden/Trump. Then rumors about Biden's declining health were confirmed with his debate performance. It sent shockwaves to even his most stalwart supporters that triggered a lot of anxiety and concern. I have often been critical about how insular Biden's team is and I believe their unwillingness to allow for the President to hear outside opinions is part of the reason it took him so long to come to what for most of us seemed to be an inevitable conclusion.

Now that his withdrawal has been announced, we should pause for a moment to acknowledge the human side of this decision. No matter how hard we fight against it, time moves forward, and it's never easy to watch someone in decline.

I'll leave it to historians to judge President Biden's legacy, but you've frequently heard me talk about how courage is contagious (I even wrote a book about it!) - what Joe Biden did by voluntarily laying down power is an act modeled by our very first president, George Washington, when he refused to serve a third term as president. The great American tradition of our leaders peacefully passing off power to others is part of the reason January 6th was such a big deal.

Let me also acknowledge that, viewed in its entirety, the Republicans had a very good convention and accomplished their goal of unifying the party. There may be those of us who are not happy with where the party is these days, but there is no doubt that they appeared unified.

The first part of Trump's remarks in Milwaukee were effective, and since most Americans get their news these days in small, curated clips, they likely won't ever see second half of his speech that was rambling and concerning. He certainly missed an opportunity to put an exclamation mark on what otherwise was a successful convention.

So, given all we’ve lived through just in the past few weeks, what's ahead for America in the months leading up to the election?

First and foremost, the Democrats will need to decide about who their candidate is and who their running mate will be. It seems that many are coalescing around Vice President Harris, but we may not know for sure until the Democratic convention that runs August 19-22.

Next - the challenge before Democrats is to do their best to pull off a successful convention and come out of Chicago as unified as the Republicans are right now. That's a tall order, but if there was ever a moment for unity, this is it.

Our democracy thrives when we have a vibrant two-party system that can present American voter with a choice about which direction they want to go for the next four years.

While the Republicans are still saddled with a candidate who, thanks to Biden's withdrawal, is now the oldest American ever to run for the presidency, the Democrats have a historic opportunity to elevate leaders who represent a younger generation of Americans. And don't forget about the potential to elect the first female to the presidency if the Democrats select Kamala Harris.

With all the turmoil and drama in recent days, it’s easy to lose hope or faith amid the chaos. But I encourage you to reflect about how these can also be exciting times to walk a different path forward in the ongoing experiment that is America. While I wish our civic discourse was more respectful and hopeful, I am encouraged to see that so many people who are participating in the process and fighting for their beliefs.

Let's all work together to keep it civil and listen to each other more. I truly believe that our best days are ahead. Thank you for all that you're doing to help! -John

There may be those of us who are not happy with where the party is these days, but there is no doubt that they appeared unified. The first part of Trump's remarks in Milwaukee were effective, and since most Americans get their news these days in small, curated clips, they likely won't ever see second half of his speech that was rambling and concerning. He certainly missed an opportunity to put an exclamation mark on what otherwise was a successful convention. So, given all we’ve lived through just in the past few weeks, what's ahead for America in the months leading up to the election? First and foremost, the Democrats will need to decide about who their candidate is and who their running mate will be. It seems that many are coalescing around Vice President Harris, but we may not know for sure until the Democratic convention that runs August 19-22. Next - the challenge before Democrats is to do their best to pull off a successful convention and come out of Chicago as unified as the Republicans are right now. That's a tall order, but if there was ever a moment for unity, this is it. Our democracy thrives when we have a vibrant two-party system that can present American voter with a choice about which direction they want to go for the next four years. While the Republicans are still saddled with a candidate who, thanks to Biden's withdrawal, is now the oldest American ever to run for the presidency, the Democrats have a historic opportunity to elevate leaders who represent a younger generation of Americans. And don't forget about the potential to elect the first female to the presidency if the Democrats select Kamala Harris. With all the turmoil and drama in recent days, it’s easy to lose hope or faith amid the chaos. But I encourage you to reflect about how these can also be exciting times to walk a different path forward in the ongoing experiment that is America. While I wish our civic discourse was more respectful and hopeful, I am encouraged to see that so many people who are participating in the process and fighting for their beliefs. Let's all work together to keep it civil and listen to each other more. I truly believe that our best days are ahead. Thank you for all that you're doing to help! -John | | | Get the Latest Updates: | | | | | ---|---|--- | | Paid for by Kasich for America, not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee. www.JohnKasich.com

A Rally-Gone-Wrong and the RNC | Latino Vote Episode 49
| Chuck and Mike reflect on the shocking **assassination attempt on Donald Trump** at a rally in Butler, Pennsylvania; and its impact on the 2024 election. Additionally, they cover the highlights and plenty low-lights at the Republican National Convention; **focusing on the RNC convention's messaging and the strategic implications of JD Vance as Trump's VP pick**.

Now they're preparing to spend tens of millions against me, to shut me up. To stop me from putting a magnifying glass on everything.

**_I didn't come to play though._**

Just days after the attempted assassination of President Trump’s life, the Secret Service refuses to answer questions |
[ ](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=9b6bf0c0f968410896b6808a1f74a5b7&_e=yp6FQ5cnHmlI5l1BhPzx0pYSYGpEXLYoZ8e4zqd2-son9R6utwZACMmCXdnKNa1jUkmNF2S2_8Fu8xyoTDaMUeB2TZng1e5QwSTKGGzNOnc4isGZpJS6GFkprm2bIMyrI15h_xDQKNaBmT95ZfeuHZk9aPVabyunJN112k_QCmLzZ-UMlCt3WptbQN2EPDzF40jt8JH3v0aRvkQ8x5-yBmZsloEfGWkBlK3PN2b7ODuYazECsWqmyU3JAOIVDQiTZh_VJs8TActZ43_kC7nm8EhfvmVPtJ-GnFFRc-gDTeUoLvL3lR8rbHJPpG1gU4wTgGVQOTPOAKI4AUazi--EegMlQc6s-pQaDgqLe5kV6YNy5ja3UKXD-TaOcNRpfFoM)
---
The American people deserve answers, Peter.

**_Just days after the attempted assassination of President Trump’s life, the Secret Service refuses to answer questions._**

_**First**_ – the Secret Service Director’s opening statements were leaked to several Democrat-run publications.

_**Then**_ – the Secret Service Director was subpoenaed by Congress and failed to answer even the simplest of “yes” and “no” questions on if they failed.

_**Now**_ – a protective government agency, that is not supposed to be political, is dragging its feet about generating a report on how the Secret Service did not live up to its “no fail” mission.

**_It is complete and utter bull****, and I made sure to tell that to Director Cheatle._**

With the election only 100 or so days out, this is unacceptable.

**_The American people deserve answers, and we deserve them now!_**

Derek -

Vice President Kamala Harris announced she’s running to earn and win the
Democratic nomination for president and defeat Donald Trump, and President
Biden is calling on all of us to support her campaign.

important than ever to get involved. This Saturday, July 27, marks 100
days until the election and we are having a huge grassroots Weekend of
Action to show our support for Kamala Harris and Democrats up and down the
ticket. [ https://www.mobilize.us/2024pavictory/?end_date=2024-07-29T03%3A59%3A59.999Z&event_type=1&per_page=25&start_date=2024-07-27T04%3A00%3A00.000Z&tag_ids=20547?refcode=em20240723-2-9236 ]Click here to sign up today!

for the people. With Vice President Harris as our nominee, Democrats will
defeat Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans this November.

But we need your help. The road to the White House runs through
Pennsylvania and we need all hands on deck to make sure we deliver the
Keystone State for Kamala Harris.

Can we count on you to join us this weekend?

| [](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72809?t=6&akid=15718%2E878179%2E9TdPWi) Folks, let me say this: **President Joe Biden is one of the most accomplished and consequential leaders in American history.**

President Biden rescued the nation from a once-in-a-century global pandemic, lowered costs for working people and seniors and brought the economy roaring back from the brink of recession.

Together with House Democrats, the Biden-Harris administration passed historic legislation to fix our nation’s crumbling roads and bridges, worked to combat the climate crisis, brought manufacturing jobs home, capped the cost of insulin at $35 per month and delivered bipartisan gun safety for the first time in three decades.

The D in Democrat stands for deliver. America is a better place today because President Joe Biden has led us with intellect, grace and dignity.

**We are forever grateful for President Biden’s legacy, and now, we MUST defend it from extreme MAGA Republicans.**

| | **Watch My New TV Ad: 'Translator'!**
* * *
My latest TV ad is a simple message to illegal immigrants. The party's over. Pack your bags. You're getting the hell outta here.
