| | **Team Eigel is Traveling the State! Join Us!**
* * *
I have tremendous news: The surge we are experiencing is very real. I am traveling across the entire state visiting with thousands of Missourians, and every single one of our events is packed with enthusiastic conservatives eager to put in the work to help us win on August 6th!

My message of a bold, conservative Missouri where we eliminate personal property tax and income tax, deport illegals, and ban foreign countries from buying our land is resonating. Republican voters are ready for the reckoning!

In just the last few days, we have hosted events in [St. James](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=486bfbdbdf&e=c00a6982d2), [Lebanon](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=f087ecb776&e=c00a6982d2), [Ozark](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=9bd92a5bf5&e=c00a6982d2), [Reeds Spring](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=49b7671ea0&e=c00a6982d2), [Bolivar](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=3a9aa3f3ef&e=c00a6982d2), [Nevada](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=888e33e91a&e=c00a6982d2), [Harrisonville](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=3b859da812&e=c00a6982d2), [St. Joseph](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=58b54588f1&e=c00a6982d2), and [Cape Girardeau](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=f3ae5574a9&e=c00a6982d2). In the next few days, I will be in [Washington](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=2cbb826051&e=c00a6982d2), [Sikeston](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=9688172a76&e=c00a6982d2), [Kennett](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=c7dd640e33&e=c00a6982d2), [Ironton](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=45a041c465&e=c00a6982d2), [Farmington](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=8fb0d432ea&e=c00a6982d2), Pilot Grove, Jefferson City, and a town near you! Stay up to date and get more details about these and future events at [this link](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=a3aab85ed9&e=c00a6982d2).
---
| | **Mike Kehoe Dodges Debate and Fundraises with the Biden Campaign**
* * *
Let me get this straight. Mike Kehoe cannot attend the only statewide televised Missouri governor debate tomorrow, because he has a fundraiser or something. He DOES have time, this week, for a big video presentation at a black tie ball alongside the Biden Campaign, crazy defund the police Congresswoman Cori Bush, and other Democrat politicians. Liberals pal around with liberals.
---
|
---
**Mike Kehoe appears on flyer alongside Biden's MO campaign manager and Cori Bush**
| | **Mike Kehoe Calls My Plan to Detain and Deport Illegals "Foolish" and "not Practical"**
* * *
At the RNC Convention, patriots rallied around President Trump's immigration plan and his calls for "mass deportation now." I support it 100%, but my opponent, Mike Kehoe, called deportation "foolish" and "not practical." Kehoe sounds like a Democrat.

>From the [Springfield Daily Citizen](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=41cf5d359a&e=c00a6982d2): "Kehoe said as he travels the state, it does not take long for voters to bring up the issue of illegal immigration - but he says it is foolish to think ([as his competitor Eigel urges](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=22ca60e3a1&e=c00a6982d2)) that the state could round up an estimated 77,000 people in Missouri who are without proper documentation."
---
|
---
| | **Tax Hike Mike Kehoe is Trying to Run from His Liberal Democrat Record; Here are the Facts.**
* * *
❌ 2013: Kung Pao Kehoe voted 4x to sell Missouri land to foreign countries like China. He took $8500 in campaign contributions in 4 separate checks from the Chinese-owned company who bought our land.
❌ 2013: Mike Kehoe's 2013 vote on the "Missouri Non-Discrimination Act" (MONA) would have allowed the erasure of traditional marriage, biological men in women's restrooms and facilities, and the violation of MIssourians' 1st amendment rights and religious beliefs.
❌ 2014: Tax Hike Mike authored the largest tax increase in Missouri history, a sales tax increase which would have cost taxpayers almost $8 billion.
❌ 2015: Tax Hike Mike voted to pass a 3.5 cent per gallon diesel tax increase which would have hurt MO farmers.
❌ 2018: Tax Hike Mike campaigned for Proposition D, which would have raised gas taxes 10 cents per gallon.
❌ 2021: Tax Hike Mike supports a 12.5 cent gas tax hike, which was signed into law despite the voters rejecting gas tax increases at the ballot box multiple times previously.

Check out Mike Kehoe's liberal record [here](https://billeigel.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=00ef1c295ae4331d7c1e52945&id=f819ee72e8&e=c00a6982d2).

| | Fellow American, I've played in lots of double-headers. And that's exactly what you and I have on our hands here. A one-on-one matchup with Adam Schiff on November 5th. **[**Can I count on your contribution of $6 to help defeat Adam Schiff today?**](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4b2214c089bf4155b137fb38c7b69d98&_e=LWVU8gZKPKmoSFSOMbNWLjRINDGehCafNqwZLgil4wD7K-wpoI8UqZ98CKl7B0ulU9WQr77nXanYvJAWVcQQtK-wciMIpo4L68f7fe7Bjll7Z65mmYsogzAxdshZgpckLaQ3aF6Sjof4mMG6_bYG04cXOVQ6qYkRPlfBXqn7OJ8jy0uHTZfHakewj6-YCpFGpJ7T1Hb_aup1MkQYhRFOpwx-dznTtBeUSFhAhiJWEcaJfiYYx4DaAE31z2JNNsJs20VIMCYkoLynfytxf1-1p9Uiielx7AWjNler2XjkdC_6_UQ5vSzSe0mtpVKO_-uwkvMAR90Ho3lbDv_vAFdgWFy1AoDTHxS_0j4kxR0rMqfb43wfUBpntspQPgsBZ4VDhKc8LVDIiVVsTd-LzMpeOg%3D%3D)** You see, Adam Schiff's enablers in the corporate media are already spreading the lie that this race is over. They're saying you and I don't have a chance (just like they did when I entered the race back in October). They're saying that Adam Schiff notched a double victory by advancing to the General Election and drawing me as his opponent. In other words, they're ready, willing and able to cut California voters entirely out of the picture again. My response to Schiff's allies saying they'd rather face me: **_Be careful what you wish for._** I'd liken this to my playing days when a cocky opposing pitcher throws a 94mph fastball right over the plate. I'll tell you, the ball would look as big as a grapefruit before I'd smash it over the fence and touch all the bases on the way home. And look how far we've already made it. I'm in first place in the primary and gaining momentum headed towards the November election. Look, I'm not saying this will be easy. Quite the opposite. It's going to be a nonstop, 58-county fight between now and November 5th. **[That said, I must ask: will you rush a contribution to my senate campaign today?](http://links.theusapatriots.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=4b2214c089bf4155b137fb38c7b69d98&_e=LWVU8gZKPKmoSFSOMbNWLjRINDGehCafNqwZLgil4wD7K-wpoI8UqZ98CKl7B0ulU9WQr77nXanYvJAWVcQQtK-wciMIpo4L68f7fe7Bjll7Z65mmYsogzAxdshZgpckLaQ3aF6Sjof4mMG6_bYG04cXOVQ6qYkRPlfBXqn7OJ8jy0uHTZfHakewj6-YCpFGpJ7T1Hb_aup1MkQYhRFOpwx-dznTtBeUSFhAhiJWEcaJfiYYx4DaAE31z2JNNsJscImhZy0AdhkRfO0vUw0KgxPzOeHlckExBhj81_maP0biwa7eb9i-EgSw7n9WQxakg2SNJBhjd1N2zjQDkO8yqErZNM7j9tXAknSrYKDAXj5YT3tmlP99KI9_7NuAo9KIK6gNoA2okMhrwwOHF4CmMA%3D%3D) ** This is going to be an expensive fight. Hiring staff, recruiting and training volunteers, equipping them with the very best technology to identify our voter and secure their vote by November 5th. There's no time to lose. In closing, I can't help but think how Adam Schiff and his team of high-priced DC consultants thought they were being savvy in trying to make sure I became their opponent in General Election. Reports are they even spent money running ads promoting me. But what they've really done is awaken a sleeping giant here. Remember, before it became a wasteland of crime, homelessness, and sky-high taxes, California was a land of dreamers, a land of opportunity. It was a place where a scrawny little kid could start as a bat boy for his heroes, work hard, win a World Series, and land on a Topps baseball card. California can be that place again. America can be that place again. And it starts with throwing out political liars and connivers like Adam Schiff and reclaiming our freedom roots. Time is the most important factor. Thank you!

subject: Don’t let them “cancel” American history
body:

---
| [ ](http://trk.libertyledger._c2M9MDA1ODVOMDI0Mkw5VERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW5vdGVjYXJkc19wcmVtaXVtJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFFLUxMTzUyMDI1In0/RQDzAdQrSwBdAtD6bSuFaQ) Friend of Liberty, I have a special gift for you--a set of unique notecards featuring pictures of the "Liberty Walk" statues found on the Hillsdale College campus. These beautiful cards include _George Washington_ and _Thomas Jefferson_ ... _Abraham Lincoln_ and _Frederick Douglass_ ... _Winston Churchill_ , _Margaret Thatcher_ , and _Ronald Reagan_. _All of these statues stand proudly on Hillsdale 's Michigan campus_--one of the only institutions of higher learning that refuses EVERY PENNY of government funding, even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. You can view the cards at this secure link: [https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/get-your-liberty-walk-notecards](http://trk.libertyledger._c2M9MDA1ODVOMDI0Mkw5VERPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPW5vdGVjYXJkc19wcmVtaXVtJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFFLUxMTzUyMDI1In0/QzbXxEe7ewWYs6uW4_kh7g) Let the cards serve as a reminder to you of the vigilance and commitment needed to defend liberty--especially right now, a critical time for our country. **Sadly, several polls and events around the country show that increasing numbers of young Americans are being drawn to socialism and other ideas destructive of liberty. ** And the unrest in communities nationwide, where statues of our Founding Fathers are being vandalized or torn down, is another symptom of this underlying disease. What explains this development? As an educator and president of Hillsdale, I've been thinking about this for a long time. Here's one primary reason... For decades, the "progressive" leftist academics who became dominant in most of America's colleges and universities after the 1960s have been teaching a **biased** and **distorted** view of American history. _The New York Times '_ "1619 Project" is a prime example. According to the "1619 Project," the key to understanding America is not freedom, but slavery--and the Project's main goal is to inject this false teaching into the curricula of America's K-12 schools. Imagine young minds in classrooms all over American learning this. Does it make you as concerned as it does me? And given this trend in American education, is it any wonder that our young people feel less of a patriotic attachment to our nation and are increasingly attracted--out of ignorance--to failed ideas such as socialism, ideas that are destructive of liberty? Another sign of the "progressive" Left's influence is the continuing attempt to erase our American heritage by destroying monuments, renaming schools and streets, and censoring works of literature in the name of "political correctness." The Left knows that it cannot remake society according to its ever-evolving idea of "progress" until it has "canceled" patriotism and hallowed out the idea that we should be grateful for our blessings to the great men and women of the past--many of whom are depicted on the cards I'd like to send you. **This is why we are engaging the Left on the battlefield of education ... and why your generous support is needed right away. ** After all, those on the Left are extremely well-funded, thanks to liberal billionaires like George Soros and his ilk. **With the support of citizens like you --citizens who understand the importance of education to liberty--we are ramping up its outreach efforts on behalf of liberty, especially to our nation's youth.** It is even more urgent that we do so in the face of efforts such as _ The New York Times_' "1619 Project" that undermine patriotism and lead to an increased pull toward socialism. Hillsdale is the only educational institution in America that is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens of all ages, from coast to coast, about America's great heritage of liberty. **Your generous support today will... **
* **Expand** the circulation of _Imprimis_ , Hillsdale's digest of liberty, to reach millions more Americans (you can also receive a free subscription of _Imprimis_ ...for life).

* **Send** millions of pocket-size copies of America's founding documents to schools across America, and to members of our armed forces, who have sworn to defend the Constitution.

* **Increase** the number of citizens (especially younger Americans) enrolling in Hillsdale's free online courses such as "Constitution 101" and "The Great American Story: A Land of Hope."

* **Launch** and support more and more Hillsdale-affiliated classical K-12 charter schools nationwide, returning excellence to American K-12 education and impacting thousands of our youngest citizens.

One other thing you should be aware of... As I mentioned, to maintain our independence, we do all of this liberty-defending work while refusing EVERY PENNY of government funding--even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants and loans. NOT. ONE. PENNY. So, your support is even more crucial to ensuring that future generations of Americans will be educated in American civics and prepared to defend freedom. **With a gift of $17.76 or more today to support educational outreach efforts that reach and teach millions, Hillsdale will send you a special notecard set featuring the statues on our "Liberty Walk." As you read this, some 400,000 innocent Palestinians are desperately fleeing Khan Younis--a designated safe zone--as Israel plans to resume indiscriminate bombing. Meanwhile, in the last 24 hours [Israeli bombing killed 70 more Palestinian civilians in Khan Younis](https://substack.com/redirect/4ffea3fa-b64c-4462-bfad-e4dd9c08f745?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and this is probably the first you heard about it.
This Wednesday Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will address a joint session of U.S. Congress. This will be Netanyahu's fourth time addressing Congress (1996, 2011, 2015), and this invitation comes from both Republicans and Democrats. This invite could not come at a better time for Netanyahu. He's desperate. Polling shows more than [72% of Israelis want him out of office](https://substack.com/redirect/fead81d7-8103-4d24-ac14-48d0fd0d980f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The ICJ has ruled that Israel's occupation and settlements are illegal under international law. The UN has concluded that "Israel is committing extermination" of Palestinians. And to top it off, the ICC is on the cusp of issuing arrest warrants for Netanyahu for war crimes.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5cce30ba-ac3d-4274-9455-d86814e8ea5b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: World News
Undoubtedly, Netanyahu will spend his remarks focused on protecting himself and justifying his horrific bombing of Palestinian civilians. His remarks will undermine peace and justice by spewing misinformation and disinformation about his policies and the Palestinian people. This article arms you with the accurate information needed to debunk his hate and calls for more violence and war. Netanyahu's lies will span at least five areas--don't fall for his hate campaign. **Let 's Address This.**
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=2550223&post_id=146904274&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTQ2OTA0Mjc0LCJpYXQiOjE3MjE3NTQwNzAsImV4cCI6MTcyNDM0NjA3MCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTI1NTAyMjMiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.k-Vmy8Mj9QCLqXztQOC1olTxX6JHQjZ_A8BtJEt-bgE)
### **1\. Lies about the origins of Israel 's siege on Gaza**
Netanyahu will claim all was well on 10/6, and Hamas attacked Israel without warning or cause--other than their hatred of Jewish people. As [I've written before](https://substack.com/redirect/8f77946e-6ae9-40ac-859f-e98121ee722e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), we cannot understand 10/7 unless we first recognize the ground reality leading up to 10/7. Netanyahu will ignore those ground realities.
For example, Netanyahu will ignore Israel's 57 year illegal military occupation of Palestinian territories for the illegal act it is. He will ignore that Hamas is not an ancient organization, but having been [established only in 1987](https://substack.com/redirect/91152059-da7b-49a9-83e4-a7a95ab778fb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), it is a _reaction_ to more than then 20 years of illegal occupation and land grab. And he will ignore Israel's 700,000 illegal settlements as the violation of international human rights law that they are, as repeatedly affirmed by the United Nations, the United States, and now by the [International Court of Justice](https://substack.com/redirect/bed08d3d-b8f1-48af-9ceb-114fe55ef8ca?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
Netanyahu will __ ignore that two decades of Israel's land, air, and sea blockades on Gaza left people desperate and distressed, and [violates international human rights law](https://substack.com/redirect/99599f18-88ea-4506-abca-3a24054b488e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). He will ignore that some 9500 Palestinians are [indefinitely detained in Israeli prison](https://substack.com/redirect/070d9998-9dc7-40ca-96bb-95506494f864?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) in what is known as _administrative detention_ , many without charge or opportunity for release. And he will ignore that as you read this, up to 1000 Palestinian children are indefinitely detained in Israeli prison, again without charge, under so-called _administrative detention_. Are these innocent people not hostages, too?
Likewise, Netanyahu will ignore that in the year prior to 10/7 the Israeli military [killed at least 240 Palestinian civilians in the West Bank](https://substack.com/redirect/d0882074-2c50-4337-a8e2-87f5383aeb76?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--a death toll that included 47 children--and in fact was the deadliest year in recent history for Palestinian civilians.
Finally, Netanyahu will ignore that [he deliberately propped up Hamas for years](https://substack.com/redirect/17a0f4b9-f3aa-4982-a223-c0bfd2074668?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) with the specific goal to undermine Palestinian statehood, regional security, and empowerment of the people of Palestine.
In short, Netanyahu will attempt to paint Hamas' war crime attack on civilians on 10/7 as a spontaneous attack out of the blue--without any of the above history of Israeli war crimes. Don't let him get away with that false narrative.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/5d06d040-acea-43b2-b9ef-b6367eee1464?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

### **2\. Lies about his policies during this siege on Gaza**
Netanyahu will claim Israel is the "most moral Army in the world," and will lie about his policies in Gaza. He will ignore [South Africa's documented ICJ lawsuit accusing Israel of genocide](https://substack.com/redirect/af754edd-5cfd-4a02-876d-fca169f214e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), proving intent with the very words of Israeli leadership seeking full and total destruction of Gaza and replacement of Palestinians. He will ignore the ICC's detailed accusations against him and his Defense Minister, Gallant, for indiscriminately bombing civilians in Palestine. He will ignore that the New York Times and NBC have [documented more than 200 instances where the Israeli military forced Palestinians into a confirmed "safe zone," only to bomb that very safe zone](https://substack.com/redirect/af754edd-5cfd-4a02-876d-fca169f214e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), killing thousands of innocent civilians. And he will attempt to make the bombings of civilians, journalists, aid workers, and children seem like they were honest mistakes.
They were not honest mistakes. They were deliberate war crimes, and it is critical we do not fall for this continued gaslighting.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d5cf36d3-6a8e-4a69-9aca-2f0cc7abb937?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Credit: Ayman via MSNBC
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..iqNpF-U56vyg2WqsRJLE621rWnrrnVXGEr2V3M13Wzo?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=146904274)
### **3\. Lies about the International Criminal Court (ICC)**
Netanyahu will claim the ICC is making an equivalence between Israel and Hamas--a meritless claim the ICC has already thoroughly debunked. But meanwhile, Netanyahu will ignore that [Israel has illegally spied on the ICC for the past nine years](https://substack.com/redirect/2aaf88d6-d1e5-4aea-bdce-8f2e7da06861?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and aggressively attempted to bribe and intimidate the previous and current ICC Prosecutor. Netanyahu will claim the ICC has no jurisdiction over Israel, ignoring that [Palestine has been a member state of the ICC since April 1, 2015](https://substack.com/redirect/4dd301a9-47db-4654-b120-6236cb45c4de?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Therefore, the ICC has jurisdiction over war crimes committed in Palestine--which Israel has committed.
The ICC, like the ICJ, is working in accordance with the rules of international human rights law, and their authority must be respected if we truly claim "no one is above the law."
### **4\. Lies about how this conflict can be resolved**
Netanyahu will claim "all that needs to happen for this war to end is for Hamas to release the hostages." But we know this is false, as even the current offer President Biden announced is one Netanyahu himself rejected less than an hour later--specifically because Netanyahu wants to continue to bomb Gaza indiscriminately.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/43ad65de-1707-4443-b32a-a44b3056a159?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
CNN likewise [reported](https://substack.com/redirect/3115f28d-b61b-4cc4-8a89-d2982f5929e8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "_Less than an hour after Biden detailed the Israeli proposal, Netanyahu 's office insisted Israel would not end the war until Hamas is defeated and all its goals are achieved_." Moreover, the very families of hostages are now openly accusing Netanyahu of giving up on the hostages, unless it can benefit him personally. "Netanyahu won't agree to hostage release deal unless it polls well for him, [Israeli families say they were told](https://substack.com/redirect/67d64dcd-c2d9-4b02-afbd-5d5407da6d0b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), adding, "The Israeli government made a conscious and deliberate decision to sacrifice the hostages," the Hostage Family Forum said." In fact, Netanyahu has had the audacity to [demand ceasefire while also demanding the right to continue to bomb Palestinians](https://substack.com/redirect/3025d1f0-e9af-4f6d-ac05-81074da59e45?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
This conflict will truly resolve with a permanent and lasting ceasefire, an unconditional release of all hostages from both sides, an end to Israel's military occupation of Palestine, an end to Israel's illegal settlements in Palestine, an end to Israel's illegal blockade of Gaza, a sovereign Palestinian state, a prosecution of all war crimes in front of the ICC, and a rebuilding of Gaza and the West Bank.

### **5\. Lies about his critics**
Netanyahu will likely lean heavily into claiming criticism of him, of the Israeli government, and of how Israel has conducted its bombing of Gaza is all rooted in antisemitism. While antisemitism must never be tolerated, condemning war crimes is not antisemitism--it is pro justice.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2ac768e9-b8cf-4ca9-90e9-2c44527c0d3b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It should shock the conscience that in addition to banning journalists altogether, the [Israeli government has killed more than 108 journalists and media workers](https://substack.com/redirect/0d61138d-590a-47a7-955f-a9907b8dd04f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) reporting from inside Gaza. Indeed, it is no wonder [that numerous Jewish organizations](https://substack.com/redirect/45e0d69e-2915-4a06-9cea-ff3ba748137e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) are loudly condemning Netanyahu's injustices, rejecting the claims of antisemitism, and demanding justice for Palestine.
## **In Conclusion**
This is not an exhaustive list, but I'd be surprised if Netanyahu does not at least touch on all five of these at some point, among others, during his July 24 address. Vice President Kamala Harris has a key opportunity to distance herself from her predecessor's abysmal policy on Palestine. She can stop arming Israel to bomb Palestinians, stop excusing Israeli war crimes, and start enforcing the binding UN Security Council resolution mandating complete ceasefire and release of all hostages.
Pay close attention to which members of Congress boycott Netanyahu's speech, and which members attend. Those who attend send a message that war crimes are not a deal breaker. Indeed, it is a shame that American political leadership has made a bipartisan commitment to invite a credibly accused war criminal to address a joint session of Congress. Doing so does nothing to benefit the American people, further harms Palestinians, and does not make Israel any safer. One thing is for sure, however, that this invitation has emphatically debunked the claim that the United States is committed to an international rules based order.
And that reality is devastating for the prospect of international peace and justice.

Dear Peter,
We are thrilled to announce a major victory in our campaign for true democracy! The North Carolina Board of Elections has officially certified the We The People party, giving Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and Nicole Shanahan _certified ballot access in this critical swing state_.
This marks our second battleground state—following Michigan—where Kennedy’s ballot access has been officially secured. The board's decision is a testament to the hard work of our dedicated volunteers who collected nearly double the required signatures.
**Second Legal Win Against Democratic Lawyers**
In addition to securing ballot access in North Carolina, we’ve also achieved our second legal victory against the DNC's frivolous challenges. Following our triumph in Hawaii in April, we have maintained a perfect record in defeating the DNC’s attempts to block our progress.
**Our Growing Electoral Presence**
Our campaign is gaining unstoppable momentum:
* **Certified Ballot Access:** 10 states (California, Delaware, Hawaii, Michigan, Minnesota, New Mexico, North Carolina, Oklahoma, South Carolina, and Utah)
* **Signatures Submitted:** 14 states (Alaska, Colorado, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Nebraska, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Tennessee, Texas, and Washington)
* **Signatures Collected:** 4 states (Florida, Idaho, Iowa, and New Hampshire)
* **Total Electoral Votes Secured:** 390 electoral votes, representing 73% of the 538 total electoral votes nationwide.

**Your Support is Crucial**
These victories prove that we are on the right path, but we need your continued support to keep this momentum going.
The DNC has launched an unprecedented multi-million dollar campaign to stop us, but with your help, we can overcome every obstacle.

The American people deserve answers, Peter.

**_Just days after the attempted assassination of President Trump’s life, the Secret Service refuses to answer questions._**

_**First**_ – the Secret Service Director’s opening statements were leaked to several Democrat-run publications.

_**Then**_ – the Secret Service Director was subpoenaed by Congress and failed to answer even the simplest of “yes” and “no” questions on if they failed.

_**Now**_ – a protective government agency, that is not supposed to be political, is dragging its feet about generating a report on how the Secret Service did not live up to its “no fail” mission.

**_It is complete and utter bull****, and I made sure to tell that to Director Cheatle._**

With the election only 100 or so days out, this is unacceptable.

**_The American people deserve answers, and we deserve them now!_**

We thought you may be interested to read this BREAKING news from Illinois Review, the largest conservative media source in Illinois, and the only source that has been shared by President Donald Trump.
U.S. Secret Service Boss Resigns Amid Bipartisan Uproar, Weeks After Trump Assassination Attempt (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2024/07/u-s-secret-service-boss-resigns-amid-bipartisan-uproar-weeks-after-trump-assassination-attempt.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=f237650565-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D)

U.S. Secret Service Director Kimberly Cheatle testifies before the House Oversight and Accountability Committee on Monday. (Rod Lamkey / Associated Press)
On Tuesday, U.S. Secret Service Director Kimberly Cheatle resigned according to the White House – nearly two weeks after an assassination attempt almost killed former President Donald Trump during a campaign rally in Pennsylvania that killed one man and critically injured two others.

On Monday, Cheatle appeared before the House Oversight and Accountability Committee, where both Republican and Democratic members grilled her and criticized her inability to answer questions surrounding the assassination attempt of the 45th President. During the hearing, the embattled Secret Service boss admitted failure and took responsibility, telling the committee,

“The Secret Service’s solemn mission is to protect our nation’s leaders. On July 13th, we failed. As the Director of the United States Secret Service, I take full responsibility for any security lapse.”

body:
#

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-slotkin.iB5u51&refcode=em240723-2-full&refcode2=2667.734936.Lvc65F&t=1&akid=2667%2E734936%2ELvc65F)
---
Peter -
While I know our campaign has sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place, and why your support is so important in our success.
The truth is, we all know America is going through something right now. We seem to be living from crisis to crisis. But there are certain things that should be really simple:
Like living a middle-class life in the state that invented the middle class.
Like making things in America so that we’re in control of our own economic security.
Like protecting our children from the things that are truly harming them.
And preserving our rights and our democracy so that our kids can live their version of the American dream.
I’m running for Senate because I believe that we need a new generation of leaders that thinks differently, works harder, and never forgets that we are public servants.
But my decision to run for Senate is also deeply personal to me, and it's related to what motivated me to first run for the House in 2018.
It's about my mom. She was diagnosed with stage IV ovarian cancer in 2009 — and didn't have health insurance at the time. She had let it lapse after the insurance companies had gouged her for years because she happened to have a pre-existing condition. She passed away in 2011, but that experience — of desperately trying to get her care at the same moment we were filling out bankruptcy paperwork — motivated me to run then, and keeps me motivated to fight now. I remember the exact moment that I decided to enter public office: when the then-GOP controlled House of Representatives, the body I now serve in, voted to repeal those protections for people with pre-existing conditions.
Six years later, the Republican leaders, fueled by the extreme wing of the party, are continuing the march to repeal things that the average Americans want. They want to privatize Social Security and Medicare, repeal drug price protections like allowing Medicare to negotiate, then there’s the rights they’re obsessed with repealing: a woman’s right to choose, voting rights, and any possible gun safety legislation.
By winning this Senate seat, we’ll help ensure that Democrats retain the (slight!) majority and can pass legislation that expands access to healthcare. Not the obsession with taking things away.
To be upfront:**Winning this race is going to take a lot of resources. A crazy amount. And we have to do it without raising a single dollar from corporate PACs.**
Donations this November – when we’re in the home stretch – are important. But donations now are even more important, because they allow us to map out a strategic plan and make decisions about when and how we reach voters.
[**That is why I would love it if you would consider donating $10 or whatever you can to my campaign and Ruben Gallego today.**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-slotkin.iB5u51&refcode=em240723-2-full&t=2&akid=2667%2E734936%2ELvc65F)
[CONTRIBUTE NOW](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-em-slotkin.iB5u51&refcode=em240723-2-full&t=3&akid=2667%2E734936%2ELvc65F)
Thank you,
Elissa

Fellow American,

This is not good. You probably don't know who I am, but my name's Kurt. I'm a fundraising manager for Kari Lake. I just got an earful from my boss because we're not living up to Kari's or our team's expectations.

Listen, we're trying everything we can, but apparently, it's just not enough. Honestly, before this email, we were completely out of ideas. **This is our last hope, otherwise, I don 't think we're going to survive another team meeting. **

**Kari Lake works like nobody else. There 's not a single person here in Arizona who can match the energy and commitment she has to this race, and that's why I'm doing everything I can to make up lost ground right now. **

**The best thing I can think of is, to be honest with you right now. According to our statistics, only about 20 out of every 100 people we send emails to read them. Of the people who open our emails, only about 5% make a contribution to help out.**

Kari has written a lot of emails lately, and I want to make sure we're doing everything we can to help her meet her fundraising goals. According to our team, we need to raise $10,000 by the end of the night to meet today's fundraising goal and make up for lost ground from the last few days.

This race is so important, and every minute Kari spends trying to meet her fundraising deadline is another minute she can't spend on the campaign trail, closing the gap with Ruben Gallego and making sure we save Arizona and America.

_If there 's anything you can contribute--$5, $10, $25, or even $50--it all makes a tremendous difference._

| | Fellow Conservative, **God Bless Donald J. Trump.**

That's how I opened my speech at the 2024 Republican National Convention on Tuesday evening - and I thanked God for protecting him. **You can read my recap below or watch my speech here: [https://secure.winred.com/ted-cruz/convention-speech](http://trk.tedcruz._dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1FLUhvdXNlRmlsZSZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Q3J1el9Db252ZW50aW9uLVNwZWVjaF8yMDI0MDcxOSZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPUVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUNvbnZlbnRpb24tU3BlZWNoJnV0bV9hZ2VuY3k9UEcmYW1vdW50PTQ5JnJlY3VycmluZz10cnVlIn0/J-GEOkOgs_nN9gx8liIxUA)**

_Together, we lifted up in prayer all of our leaders, the family of fallen firefighter and patriot Corey Comperatore, and those injured at the rally last Saturday in Butler, Pennsylvania._

Then, I moved on to highlight for those in attendance and those watching at home what's at stake in this historic presidential election - focused on the disastrous Biden Border Crisis.

As I said on Tuesday evening, we are facing an INVASION at our southern border.

A staggering 11.5 million people have crossed our border illegally under Joe Biden.

And every single day now Americans are dying - murders, rapes, and horrific assaults are being perpetrated across our country at the hands of illegal immigrants.

**These are not just news stories or statistics. These are our mothers and fathers, our brothers and sisters, our children and grandchildren.**

_These are empty chairs at dinner tables that will never be filled again_.

Joe Biden and the Democrats cynically decided they wanted votes from illegal immigrants more than they wanted to protect American citizens. The good news is we can fix this mess.
_It 's just one big reason why we need to elect Donald J. Trump and send him back to the White House on November 5th! _

I worked with President Trump to secure the border during his first term, and we achieved the lowest rate of illegal immigration in 45 years. Now it's time to do it again.

**Together, we 'll lead the fight to _secure the border again_ , _enforce our laws_ , _protect our children_ , and _restore our future_. **

Thank you so much, as always, for being part of Team Cruz.

Let's get fired up to get the job done and **WIN BIG** in Texas this fall!

For Liberty,

Ted Cruz

> As the public becomes more familiar with the plans laid out in Project 2025, Trump is doing everything he can to distance himself from it, but the proof is in the pudding. The radical agenda is _hand-crafted_ by Donald Trump loyalists — including more than 140 former Trump administration officials and at least SIX of his former Cabinet Secretaries, who have either authored or advised on Project 2025.
> Don’t be fooled: If Trump regains control of the White House, he will use Project 2025 as a roadmap to wreak havoc on every aspect of American life.
> And while Project 2025 contains PLENTY of disturbing details on how to gut climate protections, this isn’t _just_ about rolling back climate progress. It’s a direct threat to everything we hold dear — personal freedoms, democracy, and bedrock social programs that millions rely on are all at stake.
> **Here’s a glimpse of what we’re up against if we don't act NOW to stop it:**
> * **🌍 Climate Crisis Worsened:** Project 2025 would gut the Environmental Protection Agency and roll back restrictions on oil drilling. They want to let Republican state officials, who often side with Big Polluters, take over more of the regulation (_read: deregulate everything_). And they’d stop states from adopting stricter car pollution standards like California’s. This would give Big Oil executives and fossil fuel corporations free rein to exploit and endanger our communities.
>
>
> * **🗳️ Democracy Undermined:** Project 2025 aims to dismantle democratic institutions, gut democratic checks and balances on presidential power, and suppress voting rights. A functioning democracy is KEY to climate progress because, without it, the only people with power are the wealthy and influential, who prioritize profit over the planet. Democracy ensures that every voice is heard and that policies reflect the will of the people, not just a privileged few.
>
>
> * **🚫 Reproductive Rights Rolled Back:** National abortion restrictions, elimination of contraceptive access, and limitations on reproductive health care are at the core of this dangerous agenda.
>

> **No matter what happens at the top of the ticket, climate champions and democracy defenders are needed in every office and at every level of government to build a strong firewall against extreme policies being pushed at the national level.**

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89415203/487227174/1174061679?refcode=header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjA5YTMwNTAtMWQ0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hI9cldXcB3eBouW1mwRor2F5EZaRpz7URUL-SfZWpBA=) | Peter, it’s been a wild last two weeks, and as of today, we have two weeks left until our primary election here in the open, toss-up seat in Michigan’s 8th District. I hope you’ve been able to come up for air during the last two weeks. The political news has jumped from shocking to depressing to inspiring to... we have a primary election in just 2 more weeks in our race, and the “most important election of our lifetimes” rapidly approaching on November 5th. One thing is clear to me at the moment: The pathway to winning the presidency in 2024 runs through Michigan, and right through our congressional district. In fact, Saginaw County (which makes up most of our district) has decisively voted for the winner (Obama, Trump, Biden) in the last three presidential elections. **The path to the presidency runs through our district. ** **If you want to help us defeat Trump here in Michigan’s 8th District, an open toss-up seat, and make sure Democrats can flip the House blue in November in case he wins, donate to our campaign right now – I am the only candidate running who will be able to persuade young voters and voter of color to turn out in our August 6th primary in just 2 more weeks and again in November to defeat President Trump. Rush a donation of $5 right now if you can help us make that happen → [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pugh](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89415204/487227175/-1272854636?refcode=072324TwoWeeksFR&refcode2=f09a3050-1d49-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjA5YTMwNTAtMWQ0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hI9cldXcB3eBouW1mwRor2F5EZaRpz7URUL-SfZWpBA=)** We also know that Kamala Harris’ campaign will need to communicate with the types of voters our campaign is speaking with every day: young voters, voters of color, Spanish-speaking voters, “suburban women” – you name it, Michigan’s 8th District has got it. To be frank, we haven’t seen my primary opponent’s campaigns out in the field at all, (as we expected) talking to marginalized communities, or at the doors. They’re thinking they can waltz their way to victory by spending as much money as they can on out-of-touch ads made by Washington D.C. consultants. We know that real people in Michigan’s 8th District are worried about what a Trump-Vance presidency would mean for their own freedoms, economic prospects, and quality of life, and we need your help to make sure I am the Democrat on the ballot in November who can help Kamala harris win this district and win Michigan, the right way. I really do believe our organizing here could be the difference between another Trump presidency or not. So, can you pitch in with only 2 weeks left until our primary election to help us continue to organize, fight, and win against my two establishment-backed, centrist opponents? Donate here: **[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/pugh](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89415205/487227176/-1272854636?refcode=072324TwoWeeksFR&refcode2=f09a3050-1d49-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwODciLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZjA5YTMwNTAtMWQ0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=hI9cldXcB3eBouW1mwRor2F5EZaRpz7URUL-SfZWpBA=)** Sincerely,
Dr. Pamela Pugh

clean_body: = | Peter, it’s been a wild last two weeks, and as of today, we have two weeks left until our primary election here in the open, toss-up seat in Michigan’s 8th District. I hope you’ve been able to come up for air during the last two weeks. The political news has jumped from shocking to depressing to inspiring to... we have a primary election in just 2 more weeks in our race, and the “most important election of our lifetimes” rapidly approaching on November 5th. One thing is clear to me at the moment: The pathway to winning the presidency in 2024 runs through Michigan, and right through our congressional district. In fact, Saginaw County (which makes up most of our district) has decisively voted for the winner (Obama, Trump, Biden) in the last three presidential elections. The path to the presidency runs through our district. If you want to help us defeat Trump here in Michigan’s 8th District, an open toss-up seat, and make sure Democrats can flip the House blue in November in case he wins, donate to our campaign right now – I am the only candidate running who will be able to persuade young voters and voter of color to turn out in our August 6th primary in just 2 more weeks and again in November to defeat President Trump. Rush a donation of $5 right now if you can help us make that happen → = We also know that Kamala Harris’ campaign will need to communicate with the types of voters our campaign is speaking with every day: young voters, voters of color, Spanish-speaking voters, “suburban women” – you name it, Michigan’s 8th District has got it. To be frank, we haven’t seen my primary opponent’s campaigns out in the field at all, (as we expected) talking to marginalized communities, or at the doors. They’re thinking they can waltz their way to victory by spending as much money as they can on out-of-touch ads made by Washington D.C. consultants. We know that real people in Michigan’s 8th District are worried about what a Trump-Vance presidency would mean for their own freedoms, economic prospects, and quality of life, and we need your help to make sure I am the Democrat on the ballot in November who can help Kamala harris win this district and win Michigan, the right way. I really do believe our organizing here could be the difference between another Trump presidency or not. So, can you pitch in with only 2 weeks left until our primary election to help us continue to organize, fight, and win against my two establishment-backed, centrist opponents? Donate here: = Sincerely, Dr. Pamela Pugh | I’m Dr. Pamela Pugh, and I’m a Saginaw native running for Congress in Michigan's 8th District. As a public servant, I currently serve as the President of the Michigan State Board of Education, a statewide elected position. I believe in standing up for the people and fighting for our democracy, our children, and our future. I've lived in Michigan's 8th District for my entire life and it will be the honor of a lifetime to represent my community in the House of Representatives. | | | **Tackle Rising Egg Prices and Fight Inflation – Support Our Campaign****!**
---

Dear Peter,
As we face rising egg prices and the broader challenges of inflation, it’s clear that hardworking families in Washington’s 8th Congressional District are feeling the pinch. The cost of living is increasing, making it harder to afford everyday essentials. Our agricultural sector, especially our local farmers, is also struggling under the weight of economic pressures.
Our campaign is dedicated to tackling these issues head-on. We believe in fighting inflation through sound fiscal policies, reducing regulatory burdens, and supporting our agricultural community. By doing so, we can help lower costs and ensure that our farmers can thrive, providing us with affordable, high-quality produce.

---
| | | |
---
|
Your support is vital in this fight. Your contribution will enable us to advocate for the policies needed to combat inflation and support our local agriculture.
Whether it’s $20, $50, or any amount, your donation will make a significant impact..

subject: my election is *NOW*
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the Joe Kent Victory Fund_
body:

name: John James
subject: The American Dream Story
disclaimer_text: Paid for by John James for Michigan
body:
| | | Friend,

**My family's story is the American Dream story.** Many years ago, there was a little boy in Starkville, Mississippi who lived across the street from Mississippi State but couldn’t go there because he’s black. _Despite growing up in the Jim Crow South, he refused to let vulnerability become victimhood._ He paid his way through college, served honorably in Vietnam, and started a trucking company with one truck, one trailer and no excuses – hauling BEER back and forth between Detroit and Milwaukee. I grew up in awe of that story. Because it was my Dad’s story. He and my mother raised me – never telling me that this is a racist country. Even though they endured racism—it didn’t define the nation they loved. They taught me I could do anything I set my mind to. They taught me service before self. I went to West Point, became a Ranger-qualified Apache pilot, and flew 750 combat hours in Operation Iraqi Freedom. By the grace of God, I came home and helped grow my family’s business. **Now I have the honor of representing Michigan’s 10th Congressional District.** As a dad of three boys, my biggest concern right now— my biggest fear— is that children today will think that the American Dream is just a myth. **[Will you join me in restoring the American Dream for our children?](http://links.jjforcongress.com/u/click?_t=f784024d18db4d2d88c26e9627b85cc7&_m=d445aa0aec904c76bdb4e3e060432f8b&_e=0lPem0WWj3W9FdM_2rp3zr3BlFe-1ejPKtvPaE1m17o8XFMkW39tQz5DfHV4ghq4-8Y571dKmHRIDXvcc0i4fA2noRv3LzJM7MQuP6_NJQfu7Q0ILw2eHhCw770Nv1gb8kQTfTBzxZfjWP1mV65DffDGkNhRoc4GVoh5P3nkxn_5qSHg8lbbkQwSGaYTcVnePpB-DgUkfPYFZjIAQ7tEiBZH47XoNpCdIukiQXbMgs-JXUNpCn8TFkvrfCxNuDmRYQTFcmrLRu76jZdhHpcHMGC-_fcgIBVmS25PAxiGjwLY5_ews-f238SZGQ3LUpnKqdo0MTEaAI6auyuUXBkH_qMffPs85e9cNSojWgY2rG8%3D)** ****

name: Gabby Giffords
subject: Thank you to my friend, Joe Biden
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Giffords PAC; not authorized by any candidate or candidate's committee
body:
#

Friends -
This past weekend, my good friend President Joe Biden announced his decision to no longer run for reelection.
We all owe President Joe Biden a debt of gratitude for his steady leadership when our country needed it most. In three and a half short years, he ended a pandemic, rescued the economy, fought climate change, and passed the most consequential gun violence prevention bill in decades. And through it all, he maintained his trademark decency, optimism, and empathy.
I will be forever grateful to President Biden for his compassion and personal friendship to me as I was recovering. He held my hand and gave me his 'word as a Biden' that he and Jill would always be there for me—and they were. He was by my side when I returned to cast my first vote following the shooting, and I was proud to stand by his side throughout his presidency, where he did more to fight gun violence than any president in history. His accomplishments will save lives for years to come. I am proud of my friend.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240723-2-60&t=1&akid=8555%2E3935704%2Ecv4hHf)
Shortly after President Biden made his announcement, he endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to be the new Democratic presidential nominee.
I have known Kamala Harris for many years, and I can think of no better candidate who is ready to finish the job and end gun violence in our nation. It’s a job she has already started as our vice president. Without Vice President Harris, we could never have gotten the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act_ passed in 2022. She worked with President Biden to establish the first-ever federal Office of Gun Violence Prevention in 2023, which she now oversees.
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240723-2-60&t=2&akid=8555%2E3935704%2Ecv4hHf)
Vice President Harris’ strong and caring leadership will provide a steady hand to build upon this administration’s ceaseless work to save lives from gun violence. She will make a great president and will continue to be an influential partner for our movement.
But I need your help. GIFFORDS PAC can’t have the resources to help elect Kamala Harris without people like you chipping in to emails like these.
[**So please, can I ask you to make a donation of $5, $10, or anything you can afford today? We must all work together to ensure Vice President Harris wins this November.**](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240723-2-60&t=3&akid=8555%2E3935704%2Ecv4hHf)

Jul23, 2024
You gotta love the Dems. Their hypocrisy knows no bounds. They are ruthless in their pursuit of power at any cost.

With brutal efficiency, President Joe Biden - who has given the Democrats fifty years of exemplary service - was stabbed in the back and deposited somewhere in a back alley.
The Dems and their media cheerleaders lied out of their teeth as they ridiculed the so-called Fox News MAGA cult for saying Biden was demented. But when the debate with Trump exposed the truth: Sayonara Biden. And absolutely no apologies from the liars.

Then is forty eights hours, billionaires and Hollywood picked the next candidate - Kamala Harris. The conventional wisdom is that she is locked for the nomination.

Perhaps.

But President Obama has not signed on off her yet. The Democratic Convention is not until August 19. And if polls show her doing poorly, she will be dumped in the back alley too and replaced.

The irony of this is that the Dems who are always saying "Democracy dies on darkness" and that Trump is threat to the Republic actually believe democracy is a joke and that their peon voters should have no say in who their candidate is.

As Mike Goldstein points out in detail below, Big Money talks and everyone else walks.
### The Democrats Abandon their voters for the love of money
**[DR. MICHAEL GOLDSTEIN](https://substack.com/@drmichaelgoldsteinct)**
**With the successful push to remove Biden from the presidential election,** **the Democrats have Failed Democracy and the American Public Once Again.**
Yesterday, President Biden released a letter to the American public to announce that he was withdrawing from the presidential race this November. It is ironic that it was on **National Ice Cream Day** , but all kidding aside, this is a serious interference in our political system by "Americans" and democrat politicians who are supposed to represent the people and defend the Constitution.
The large move over the last week to remove Biden, including by Jim Himes, is based on personal greed and concern for his ability to be re-elected if Biden is on the top of the ticket. After last week's RNC, the Democrats have been running scared and this is their counter to a unified Republican Party. _**This is unity we have not seen since Reagan.**_
Since the presidential debate several weeks ago, the Democrats have been restricted by their donors who no longer want to support Joe Biden. As they say, money talks. **Well what about those without money and their only currency is their voice at the ballot box?**
There are **14 million people** that voted for Biden in the presidential preference earlier this year. What about them? **A** _**re their voices worth less as they are not big donors?**_ In a primary, usually the most engaged voters come out and they did to cast their vote. So in an era of election integrity concerns, this is voter interference by the democrats in plain sight. It is not Russian interference but homegrown interference by the political elites.
Since Biden's announcement, the funds have been flowing very nicely. In the first 24 hours since Biden melted away, the Harris campaign and the DNC raised 81 million dollars. I’m ready to elect Kamala Harris. Are you?
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20240723-1&t=1&akid=975%2E587540%2ExpQO2v)
Peter,
Together, we’ve raised more than **$330,000** — a third of a million dollars — for the Kamala Harris campaign since President Biden left the presidential race Sunday.
And that’s just what this team accomplished. **After 24 hours, Kamala Harris had the BEST online grassroots fundraising day in this history of American politics.**
**[Can you help us keep up the momentum? Pitch in $5 now to help us elect Kamala Harris and elect young, progressive leaders in competitive races>>>](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240723-1?refcode=em20240723-1&amount=5&refcode2=975_587540_xpQO2v&akid=975%2E587540%2ExpQO2v)**
I fully believe that the November election will come down to the youth vote. If young people get to the polls, we _CAN_ elect Kamala Harris, keep the Senate and take back the House, and elect Democrats in state legislatures across the country.
That’s why this tweet from pop star Charli XCX is such a big deal 👇🏼👇🏼👇🏼
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240723-1?refcode=em20240723-1&refcode2=975_587540_xpQO2v&akid=975%2E587540%2ExpQO2v)
**Gen Z is embracing Kamala Harris as “brat,”** inspired by the new Charli XCX album. For those who don’t know, “brat” and “brat summer” are about living your best life — which is EXACTLY what we’ll be doing if Democrats win big this year.
Millions of people viewed videos of Kamala’s memorable quote from her mother, **“You think you just fell out of a coconut tree? You exist in the context of all in which you live and what came before you,”** backed by Charli’s pop anthems. 🥥
Kamala is embracing Gen Z right back, even changing her campaign’s Twitter profile to the bright green associated with the “brat” album and all its memes.
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240723-1?refcode=em20240723-1&refcode2=975_587540_xpQO2v&akid=975%2E587540%2ExpQO2v)
I don’t know about you, but I am extremely happy to have a Democratic candidate at the top of the ticket who isn’t afraid to talk to young voters. Using memes and music, the Harris campaign has already opened the door to communicate with the younger generations about climate change, gun reform, abortion rights, and more.
But this new energy at the presidential level isn’t the only thing I’m excited about. Our Leaders-endorsed candidates — all of whom have now backed Harris — are giving young voters even more reasons to show up and vote blue this November.
We’re supporting incredible candidates like Molly Cook, who we helped become the youngest ever and first openly-LGBTQ+ state senator in Texas history. We’re working to elect folks like Sarah McBride, a proven legislator from Delaware who will become the first trans person elected to Congress this fall. And we’re backing badass young leaders, like Ashwin Ramaswami in Georgia and Nate Douglas in Florida, who are giving a voice to the issues Gen Z cares about most.
**[I’m ready to elect Kamala Harris — and all of our inspiring endorsed candidates across the country — this November. Are you willing to help make it happen? Donate $5 right now to support Kamala and Leaders We Deserve>>> ](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240723-1?refcode=em20240723-1&amount=5&refcode2=975_587540_xpQO2v&akid=975%2E587540%2ExpQO2v)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-20240723-1?amount=5&refcode=em20240723-1-975&refcode2=975_587540_xpQO2v&akid=975%2E587540%2ExpQO2v)**
Thank you for your support,
— David Hogg

| | I know it’s been a volatile few weeks. But out of the emotional roller coaster of national politics has emerged the hope of the first woman President! Women make up 51.6 percent of the US population (and 52% of CA-03) but _less than 30%_ of any elected body — from Congress to state legislatures around the country. The first woman ran for President in 1872, and after 150 years of hammering, we may be able to finally break that glass ceiling. **And we are going to break it up and down the ballot!** As a woman, the 2016 election was profoundly devastating. It felt like the country had collectively posted a giant “No Women Allowed” sign on the White House and instead elected a man who bragged about sexual assault. We have seen and felt the devastating impact of that election, which took women’s rights back fifty years. But in the aftermath of the 2016 election, I also remember bearing witness to the incredible power of women. In November 2016, after my initial wave of grief subsided, I went to the Women’s March in D.C., and amid the sea of pink knit hats, I realized I wasn’t alone. _I realized that women are a powerful and unstoppable force for good._ **From women’s equality, to childcare, to reproductive freedom to housing, I realized that the issues we face will not change unless women step into elected office.** Women worked in 2018, and flipped the House with an _unprecedented_ slate of women candidates running for Congress. Women came out and knocked doors, made calls, invested in the races, demanding that our voices be heard — _and we got it._ But this election, electing women has felt like an afterthought. Out of the ten seats that the Democratic Party identified as the “battlefield” in California to take the House, _I am the only woman running to flip a seat._ In a year where women’s reproductive rights are on the line, **I am the only woman in a state of 40 million people bringing the case for women directly to the anti-choice incumbent.** Incredibly, in my district, we have capable women running _all the way down the ballot_ , from State Assembly to School Board. Now, with a woman at the top of the ticket, women in our community can actually have our voices heard and our needs represented — from the White House to Congress and beyond. This moment is too powerful to stand on the sidelines. name: Wes Moore
subject: The stakes are higher than ever
body:
Friend,

The stakes of the November elections are now raised. This moment calls for all of us to come together to support Kamala Harris so we can save our democracy. Because here’s who we are up against: Donald Trump.

Donald Trump still falsely claims the 2020 election was “stolen” from him. He brags about an attack on our nation’s democracy. He has been found guilty of 34 felony charges. And now, he’s running again for President to continue his career built on fraud and lies — only for his own political gain.

Donald Trump failed us, repeatedly, which set our country back significantly. He put his own interests over the country’s, and his own petty grievances over people’s freedoms. If Trump is elected, he’ll take away our freedoms — abortion rights, health care, the freedom to vote.

I’ll work every day to make sure he doesn’t get that chance again.

This moment calls for us to do all we can to make sure Kamala Harris wins in November. We must do what we can to prevent another Trump presidency. So today, please support our efforts to stop Donald Trump with a donation to support Kamala Harris for President and my campaign. We must ensure we fight to protect the future of our democracy, and we need to hit the ground running today. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240723-1?refcode=em20240723-1]

Make a split contribution » [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/wes-em-20240723-1?refcode=em20240723-1]

Thank you.

Elevate,

Wes

clean_body: It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. And I am honored to have his support and endorsement. | = Peter, I am running to be President of the United States. It has been the honor of a lifetime to serve alongside our Commander-in-Chief, my friend, President Joe Biden — one of the finest public servants we will ever know. I am honored to have his support and endorsement. And I am eager to run on the record of what Joe and I have accomplished together. We built our country back after our predecessor left it in shambles — making historic progress in reducing prescription drug costs, upgrading our nation's infrastructure, fighting climate change, and more. We are stronger today because we took action — together — to invest in America's future. I am excited to continue to work toward our vision for a better future for all. But, Peter, we also need to elect Democratic pro-choice women to continue to deliver progress for the American people. = | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = I am honored to have the President's endorsement and my intention is to earn and win this nomination. In the coming days, as I hit the campaign trail to meet with Americans and lay out the choice in front of voters in the fall, I cannot imagine two more starkly different visions for where we want our country to go. We can choose the dark path of Project 2025, with less freedom and more division. Or we can choose to pull together and do the work — For the People. These are not ordinary times. And this will not be an ordinary election. But this is our America. And I need you with me in this fight. So, I have to ask: = Together, I know we can win this election and save democracy. | **Folks, we reached out to you** with an urgent plea to thank President Biden for all of his service to our country... but according to our records, **_you still have not added your name._**

We’re giving you one more chance! _President Biden deserves all of our gratitude, and we’re sending this tonight at midnight:_

There are 3,205 spots left: [**Read below and sign the letter »**](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72816?t=6&akid=15719%2E878179%2EeGiL9c) | [3,205 SPOTS LEFT: PLEASE GIVE $3 TO SIGN THIS LETTER BEFORE WE CLOSE IT AT END-OF-DAY TODAY »](https://act.protectvoting.org/go/72816?t=7&akid=15719%2E878179%2EeGiL9c)
---
Dear President Biden,

I have one thing to say to you: **Thank you.**

You have accomplished so much, and saved our country from the nightmare that Donald Trump left behind.

I remember how excited I was when you won in 2020.

I have had your back since you became President, and I am so proud of everything you've done for working families in our country.

You capped prices on prescription drugs.

You protected good-paying union jobs.

You passed historic legislation addressing climate change.

You have done everything in your power to strengthen our Democracy.

I have zero doubt in my mind: _You will go down as a truly GREAT American President._

**I respect your decision to step aside from the race, and I truly thank you for putting the country and our Democracy first — _that is something that Trump and the Republicans will NEVER do._**

[**I'm signing this letter and sending a small donation of $3 with VPP now to show that I'm still fighting — for our country and for your legacy, Mr. President. | Dear Supporter,
Please join me on July 29th at 6 PM ET for my virtual address to the 9th District about our healthcare crisis. I'll be live on YouTube, Facebook, X, Instagram, and my website to discuss the urgent need for better healthcare and Morgan Griffith's failure to act.
My goal is to "sound the alarm bells" on the severe challenges that residents of the 9th district face in accessing quality healthcare. With hospitals and clinics located far from many communities and the quality of care often falling short, this situation is dire.
So please plan to get together, share this with friends, and join me as we address this critical crisis. Tune in on July 29th at 6:00 PM ET on your preferred platform to hear this live.
[www.bakerforva9th.com/live](https://bakerforva9th.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=50da08ea7a2ab9a8c73259dcd&id=bf740e4975&e=8cac9e7f7d)
In solidarity,Karen Baker

Our Sustainer Drive ends tomorrow! Will you join today and help us sail smoothly into November? [**We need your help now to reach our goal of 50 sustainers before it’s too late, before we hit rough water!**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89419508/487242673/-1156590367?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVlYjE0ZWZmLTI2NDktZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WM3H_jy65XWZALcE8N2iG2ngTB55lLwK6QCdP53RkCg=&emci=deeddaff-4445-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=5eb14eff-2649-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) Will you join us to smoothly sail into November? With sincere gratitude,
April Christenson, OLCV Development Director [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89419509/487242674/59267164?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVlYjE0ZWZmLTI2NDktZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WM3H_jy65XWZALcE8N2iG2ngTB55lLwK6QCdP53RkCg=&emci=deeddaff-4445-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=5eb14eff-2649-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) Dear Peter, [](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89419510/487242675/-1156590367?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVlYjE0ZWZmLTI2NDktZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WM3H_jy65XWZALcE8N2iG2ngTB55lLwK6QCdP53RkCg=&emci=deeddaff-4445-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=5eb14eff-2649-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230)We know you don’t need us to remind you of the stakes and potential outcome of this upcoming November election. Regardless of the result, we need to make sure that we elect lawmakers that prioritize a climate safe, just, and healthy future for Oregon. With the potential rough water ahead, we need all the support we can get to ensure smooth sailing into November and beyond! [**During this month’s Sustainer Drive, OLCV’s goal is to obtain 50 new monthly donors (at any amount) who will help us fight for Oregon’s future this November.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89419511/487242676/-1156590367?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVlYjE0ZWZmLTI2NDktZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WM3H_jy65XWZALcE8N2iG2ngTB55lLwK6QCdP53RkCg=&emci=deeddaff-4445-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=5eb14eff-2649-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) By joining OLCV’s Sustainer Circle, you are investing in a healthy and equitable climate future, and you will receive exclusive benefits just for sustaining donors. Monthly donors are crucial for us to make the best use of our donations this upcoming election, but there are many reasons our members commit to giving monthly. **Let’s hear directly from Donna Maebori, a member of the Sustainer Circle since 2021, about why she supports OLCV:** _Since the 1990s I had become politically active every now and then, mainly attending rallies and marches. In 2004 I learned, somehow, about canvassing for John Kerry for president and went to my first-ever campaign experience, which was followed by several more times of door knocking. The people managing it were really friendly and efficient. Over time I learned they were from OLCV. In 2016 after a certain election, I knew I wanted to be consistently active politically. Thinking back to my experience with OLCV, remembering it was good, I volunteered and have been on the Washington County Leadership Team ever since. Without a single exception, OLCV’s friendliness and efficiency is always present. OLCV is organized, effective, clear on its goals and purpose with good hearted people doing the work. Generally, the League is considered the political arm of the environmental movement. With government policy able to produce large societal changes, getting persons into office who live out environmental justice principles is absolutely vital to a viable future for the earth and all her inhabitants. Each year it becomes easier to donate, having developed deep confidence in the quality and care given to this important work by everyone involved. In fact, it is a joy to give to OLCV._ Our Sustainer Circle members are some of the biggest supporters of our work, who allow us to achieve **big wins** during the election seasons. A monthly donation to OLCV does not have to be a large amount to make a big impact on the future for Oregon. [**Will you help us smoothly sail into the November election by becoming a Sustainer Circle member today?**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/89419512/487242677/-1156590367?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9BVi9BVkxDVi8xLzcwODc3IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjVlYjE0ZWZmLTI2NDktZWYxMS04NmMzLTYwNDViZGQ5ZTA5NiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=WM3H_jy65XWZALcE8N2iG2ngTB55lLwK6QCdP53RkCg=&emci=deeddaff-4445-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&emdi=5eb14eff-2649-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&ceid=2107230) Sincerely,

clean_body: | | | Hi Peter, There are only 104 days left until the November General Election and as you know there's a lot at stake. We need to elect pro-climate and pro-environment candidates up and down the ballot to ensure that no matter what we are able to continue making progress in Oregon. Sustaining donors are crucial to our work electing climate champions because their reliable funding saves us time and resources spent on fundraising, time that can be spent reaching more environmental voters. Our Sustainer Drive ends tomorrow! Will you join today and help us sail smoothly into November? Will you join us to smoothly sail into November? With sincere gratitude, April Christenson, OLCV Development Director Dear Peter, know you don’t need us to remind you of the stakes and potential outcome of this upcoming November election. Regardless of the result, we need to make sure that we elect lawmakers that prioritize a climate safe, just, and healthy future for Oregon. With the potential rough water ahead, we need all the support we can get to ensure smooth sailing into November and beyond! By joining OLCV’s Sustainer Circle, you are investing in a healthy and equitable climate future, and you will receive exclusive benefits just for sustaining donors. Monthly donors are crucial for us to make the best use of our donations this upcoming election, but there are many reasons our members commit to giving monthly. Let’s hear directly from Donna Maebori, a member of the Sustainer Circle since 2021, about why she supports OLCV: Since the 1990s I had become politically active every now and then, mainly attending rallies and marches. In 2004 I learned, somehow, about canvassing for John Kerry for president and went to my first-ever campaign experience, which was followed by several more times of door knocking. The people managing it were really friendly and efficient. Over time I learned they were from OLCV. In 2016 after a certain election, I knew I wanted to be consistently active politically. Thinking back to my experience with OLCV, remembering it was good, I volunteered and have been on the Washington County Leadership Team ever since. Without a single exception, OLCV’s friendliness and efficiency is always present. OLCV is organized, effective, clear on its goals and purpose with good hearted people doing the work. Generally, the League is considered the political arm of the environmental movement. With government policy able to produce large societal changes, getting persons into office who live out environmental justice principles is absolutely vital to a viable future for the earth and all her inhabitants. Each year it becomes easier to donate, having developed deep confidence in the quality and care given to this important work by everyone involved. In fact, it is a joy to give to OLCV. Our Sustainer Circle members are some of the biggest supporters of our work, who allow us to achieve big wins during the election seasons. A monthly donation to OLCV does not have to be a large amount to make a big impact on the future for Oregon. I'm Tim Sheehy. Those are also my pronouns. _**SHEE – He.**_

I'm a former Navy SEAL. My wife is a Marine. I led Americans in the battle to defend our country. Then, we came home to live the American Dream in Montana.

We started an aerial firefighting business in our barn. We created hundreds of jobs and protected our public lands and Montanans from devastating wildfires.

I fight fires, so take it from me: the world is on fire under Joe Biden and Kamala Harris.

subject: Did you hear what President Trump told me?

body:
| | | _“Sarah—you’re smart, you’re beautiful, you’re tough. They attack you because you’re good at your job.”_ _ – President Trump_
---
| | [](http://links.shsforgov.com/u/click?_t=1a739425fcea4563aabd0234355111c0&_m=3b7f10e7a90445498c2f94ba1968a9c1&_e=8ZYEBAJNGym1jBNgZQsnz2QAL7cJ2pDj0ZuJ_OLnFa0zonjZukFLER6-nElgI80rxokwx-YQBYUAJFe5JQsavKUG51odMCnf8g4MzG7KwzECFErCAu4ATzL1exCy38p-UmZ1AHLOiwBuK3vcqFpT8IiuH22lStXoA1rHOrvC99GeSSgN0jO8R6Ve5duANYkiTSY4r0ndxOOCgRfKLk55cEuF4OZLKqlGT5dMn3gWhYkT8Ka-lOhcj8a0sJkwtSiwBl93je-5SlZcRn9ErVFLXG24zBJ1iJmt4_v7egkr1f03X2Q4BBBF_FdbEaIOnwL2cfkAOShq_iKDL7fqWNvB1Aj6SxfmiRHd1xACX4Lrcu_iHWO7R8q04O5O-j-GJlVg)

Peter, When I took the stage at the Republican National Convention a few days ago, I wanted the world to know the Donald Trump I know and respect. When the President hired me, I was the first mom and only the third woman to serve as White House Press Secretary. I endured relentless attacks from the Left. I was insulted as a guest at the White House Correspondents Dinner... My family was denied service and kicked out of a restaurant... A parent at my son’s preschool spit on my car... It was President Trump who defended me. And when an MSNBC host, the author of several books on empowering women, said I was unfit to be a mother... And another MSNBC host said I was “vile,” “not even human,” and should be choked... MSNBC again did nothing... _**It was President Trump who pulled me aside, looked me in the eye, and said, **_**“Sarah—you’re smart, you’re beautiful, you’re tough. They attack you because you’re good at your job.”**__ **As Governor, the attacks have continued as I’ve banned CRT in classrooms, defended women’s sports, implemented universal school choice, cracked down on crime, and kicked China off our farmland.** **But I’ve taken President Trump’s words to heart and I’m not backing down.** Will you stand with me? I need your help to keep fighting back and winning in 2024.
