Dear Patriot,

_When New Yorkers hired me to represent them for the second time, I made a promise to the American people._

I promised to work tirelessly to undo the harmful policies plaguing New York and implement new ones to create a safer city full of opportunity.

**[With your help,](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=6c182999fe164eb29ff0b4af91885772&_e=OSH0lwKTLm1FT7Nzpf2NuLwHQIsJiHqquzvw3hX1Pek8nC2wKl1XvpjwkKqkwhGm0DZtEXSVmtnUyj_nBhT--CzwajDuvCHzdYci9QZdJh67cZyZ9tpj4wk7yyOIzEDHCRvDeeZDDQUlQK14MDuBa9Trd0n9JoyIER4JNsYAkOOt4mHcn2PKQUaxN80n9psVD6RUw08kbS218YdMOzS-JNzA8AHhvJ3WeWGX1GaS6FG04fb0mn1tJqt8-LPshb5UUM_67PVB0ZT26qD1I1FjmefXlSlUBrf2CS2Lh3nuT2S6yN-84cfNOsPOY2LpzhXtUOxHqvo7LfOKFMnxniKlqQ%3D%3D)** we have made great strides towards completing this goal. Restoring New York to its glory days is no easy feat, but:

********
* **We led the initiative to reopen New York City 's schools during the pandemic and keep specialized high schools open.

**
* **We 've equipped nearly every school with a trained police officer and security equipment to protect our students.

**
* **We 're the leading plaintiffs in the lawsuit to stop New York City from allowing non-citizens to vote in our municipal elections.

**
* **We 've opposed sanctuary city policies while helping law-abiding New Yorkers become American citizens.

**
* **We defeated Joe Biden 's $3.5 trillion socialist Build Back Better socialist spending plan.**

* **We are the leading voices in the fight against the Biden Administration 's plan to close the Brooklyn Veterans Affairs hospital. **

| [ **STAND WITH CONGRESSWOMAN MALLIOTAKIS** ](http://links.nicolemalliotakis.com/u/click?_t=759a85d1cba743719e64e2569e23c9b8&_m=6c182999fe164eb29ff0b4af91885772&_e=OSH0lwKTLm1FT7Nzpf2NuLwHQIsJiHqquzvw3hX1Pek8nC2wKl1XvpjwkKqkwhGm0DZtEXSVmtnUyj_nBhT--CzwajDuvCHzdYci9QZdJh67cZyZ9tpj4wk7yyOIzEDHCRvDeeZDDQUlQK14MDuBa9Trd0n9JoyIER4JNsYAkOOt4mHcn2PKQUaxN80n9psV-U6Q-SDiOaIaB1C6kKqsMvBRGAOLCd-KH9X2NcuJcWgByrAkKR1nI3kuwxLaKTM8WxCuht2jrl_ySXK24ztvBdx0ucTrPR4S9iZxL8Wg24oIXO1kPpLnCEz8FPBR4g3m37_0C2JCp0ANt2pagH8s2g%3D%3D)

Let’s review the bidding on the events of the last couple of weeks.
**FIRST:** CNN moved our race UP their list of the “Top 10 Senate Seats Most Likely to Flip in 2024” — making it clear Michigan will be closer than ever.
**THEN:** The Cook Political Report, one of the most respected nonpartisan ratings organizations, moved our Senate race from “Lean Dem” to a pure “Toss-Up.”
**AND NOW:** President Biden suspended his bid for president and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris, which is a historic moment, but also one that creates a lot of uncertainty moving forward.
Because if anybody tells you that they know exactly what comes next, they’re probably kidding themselves. The fundamentals in our race in a swing state remain consistent.
And that means we need to be prepared.
So our plan is this: we will be executing the campaign operation and grassroots organization that we know works in Michigan. That means traveling the state to meet as many voters as possible, getting volunteers out to knock doors, and continuing our aggressive TV and digital advertising campaigns.
But all of those things take resources. If everyone reading this chipped in just a few dollars to this email, we’d raise enough to blow past our goals. But not everybody donates.
That’s why it’s important that the people who understand the gravity of this moment in our nation’s history and how close this election is do step up and make a donation.

Hi Peter — I couldn’t be more proud of Andrei's work over the past year: walking literally over 1,000 miles criss-crossing the district and meeting voters at their doors, inspiring people with a vision for change at campaign events and on the debate stage, and fighting for our shared values as Arizonans. **That’s why I proudly cast my vote for Andrei in Arizona’s Democratic Primary.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89421568/487249648/-529272306?refcode=AU_AHC_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20240723_PM1_V1_S3&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDUwMDAiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNWRmYjRiYTYtMmM0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=F18xQlgE43lkkJzOEuvrR4Ga-mDZ1UqlK9KAvOm2TOM=) Knowing Andrei for nearly a quarter of a century and having been married to him for 18 years, I’ve seen Andrei’s values and abilities in action and am confident he will make a real difference for us in the United States Congress. I know you often hear about his professional achievements, but that’s not the only side to him. Andrei is the kind of dad and husband who cooks dinner for us most nights, no matter what else is going on or how busy he is — and he’d much rather stay home to watch a movie with us than go to a fancy dinner. The only reason he decided to take on this campaign for Congress is because he believes that our democracy, our freedoms, and our planet are on the line. He refuses to stand by as the next generation – our children’s generation – grows up with fewer rights and opportunities than we did. As July 30 draws closer, Andrei needs the help of this team now more than ever to win this primary and advance to the general election to take on David Schweikert. **That’s why I want to emphasize today: If you have been waiting to make your first contribution to fuel this campaign, your donation could not come at a more important time.** Reaching as many voters as possible over these final days will require a huge effort, and Andrei is relying on support from folks like you to power us to victory. I know you often hear about his professional achievements, but that’s not the only side to him. I'm writing to let you know about something I think you'll find useful in your learning. Reason and speech are gifts from God that enable us to think about God and to worship Him.[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c2M9MDA0NzdOMDI0MkwxNURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXRoZW9sb2d5X2R2ZCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRS1GRk81MjAyMiJ9/Jy3P_ID-VQAFFK-zcEMZCg) One of the chief aims of education at Hillsdale College is to understand what kind of being we are, as well as our purpose. That, in turn, makes it possible to begin to understand our relationship to God.

The study of God, also known as "theology," has had a profound impact on Western civilization, stretching back thousands of years to the ancient Hebrews. And that's what Hillsdale's **" Theology 101" **online course is about--the development of theology from the Old Testament through the twentieth century.

**" Theology 101"** has been a popular course, so I'm pleased to let you know that it is [**now available for you to own on DVD**](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c2M9MDA0NzdOMDI0MkwxNURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXRoZW9sb2d5X2R2ZCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRS1GRk81MjAyMiJ9/R6GKfvR3NbpnV1Rhbnz8Mg). You can add it to your home library or give it as a gift to a friend or relative.

We do have a limited number of sets in stock, though--and they go fast--so don't delay in getting your copy of **" Theology 101"** on DVD. Secure yours right now at: **[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/support-hillsdales-online-courses-theology-101-dvd](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._c2M9MDA0NzdOMDI0MkwxNURPREVFUyZ1dG1fc291cmNlPXByb3NwZWN0aW5nJnV0bV9tZWRpdW09ZW1haWwmdXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXRoZW9sb2d5X2R2ZCZ1dG1fY29udGVudD1BRS1GRk81MjAyMiJ9/_eNanYh8DgD2QMlXY9l53A)** Best regards,

Kyle Murnen, '09
Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

body:
Yesterday I Tweeted the following:I agree with Congressman Lynch, Comer, and Raskin. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://us2.campaign-archive.com/?e=5a45ee1154&u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=7b216a7671)

| Peter,

Yesterday I Tweeted the following:

_**I agree with Congressman Lynch, Comer, and Raskin. The failure to protect President Donald J. Trump is unacceptable, and Director Cheatle should immediately resign. Her job was to protect the President, instead she focused on bringing a woke ideology to the Secret Service and neglected to do her real job of “ensuring the safety and security of national leaders and presidential candidates.”**_

Thankfully, today, Secret Service Director Cheatle stepped down.

While that doesn't solve a lot of problems, at least this could be the beginning of the process to return the Secret Service back to its essential purpose.[](https://mdpetitions.us2.list-manage.com/track/click?u=fac7efbc0801875f99034b204&id=ac348428f3&e=5a45ee1154)

Did you know that this Thursday night, July 25, East meets West?

The Congressman from the Eastern Shore, Congressman Andy Harris, currently Maryland's only Republican Congressman, will join me in Walkersville to help us win the Congressional seat in Western Maryland.
**Please join us!**

Interested in hearing what he has to say? We are, too.

If you can come out to meet Andy Harris, we would love to see you. We'll also be talking about our Voter-Outreach plan, and how you can get involved! If you are able to contribute towards the Voter-Outreach plan, we’d love your help. Let’s keep the momentum going. Our country is worth the work!

body:
We've sent a number of fundraising emails since President Biden announced he would no longer be seeking reelection
---
We've sent a number of fundraising emails since President Biden announced he would no longer be seeking reelection, so we thought it important to take a moment to explain where we're at, but also to talk about why these messages are so important. First, it has been an unprecedented month in American politics and it has never been more important for Democrats to remain united in the cause of saving our democracy and advancing an agenda that improves the lives of working people in this country. As you read this, almost every poll shows the presidential race will be close, the Senate is completely up for grabs and the House of Representatives is as well. At this point, just about anything can happen on election night. At the same time, the Trump campaign and the RNC have raised extraordinary sums of money, Republican super PACs are running ads in almost every contested state, and we're sure the worst attacks are yet to come. Back to these messages and why they are so important. You know by now that the DNC is the one organization best positioned to move resources where they need them when they are needed. It is what we do. But what you may not know is that there is no greater single source of donations making that possible than the response to emails like this. So while you may not have opened this email expecting to donate, given the current reality and how effectively we can put your contribution to work, that is what we are asking you to do: [**Can Democrats running for office everywhere count on you to contribute $7 to the Democratic National Committee today? | | In June, I reintroduced legislation to reauthorize the Northwest Straits Commission. The Northwest Straits Commission is a community-led effort to restore marine habitats in the Northwest Straits region and address local threats to marine environments with projects like restoring shellfish populations, protecting vulnerable ecosystems, and promoting growth for native water and shore-based plants. **The Northwest Straits Initiative is a grassroots effort that draws its strength from community cooperation**. By bringing together a diverse group of local leaders and community stakeholders, the Initiative has long been a catalyst for well-executed projects that restore marine habitat, protect Washington state's environment, and create more jobs in Northwest Washington. A healthy environment is vital to Washingtonians' way of life and the regional economy — and that is why mitigating climate change through projects like the Northwest Straits Initiative must be a top priority. I look forward to working with members of the Washington delegation to pass this legislation to help the Commission continue its important work. By bringing together a diverse group of local leaders and community stakeholders, the Initiative has long been a catalyst for well-executed projects that restore marine habitat, protect Washington state's environment, and create more jobs in Northwest Washington. A healthy environment is vital to Washingtonians' way of life and the regional economy — and that is why mitigating climate change through projects like the Northwest Straits Initiative must be a top priority. I look forward to working with members of the Washington delegation to pass this legislation to help the Commission continue its important work. This campaign is powered by the people because that’s exactly who I’ll work for in the U.S. Senate
#
Hey Peter, it’s Lucas Kunce.
I wanted to take some time today to tell you a little more about the campaign we’re building to defeat Josh Hawley here in Missouri — and why it’s already the boldest grassroots movement our state has ever seen.
**Will you please let me explain?**
**[CHIP IN NOW →](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/60310?refcode=em20240723-7154&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=7154%2E614464%2EczBiRO)**
For decades, lying politicians have let massive corporations strip our communities for parts — and Missouri has had a front row seat.
I can’t accept a status quo where politicians who take massive donations from Big Ag tell us it’s normal for billionaires in China and Brazil to buy up our farmland and put hard-working family farmers out of business. And I won’t stand for another twenty years of members of Congress who’ve never worn a uniform sacrificing American lives and tax dollars on forever wars, while refusing to invest into the everyday people who make our country strong.
Out-of-touch elites like Josh Hawley have spent decades wasting our money on tax breaks and subsidies for Wall Street, Big Pharma, Big Tech, and just about everything else that’s gutting our country.
They’re willing to lie, cheat, and steal from the American people to protect the corporate PACs and mega-donors who own their careers. And they’ll even raise their fist to look strong before they start running from threats to our democracy.
**We don’t need any more frauds in Congress.** That’s why I’m running for U.S. Senate. It’s why I’m not taking a single cent from corporate PACs. **[And it’s why today, I’m asking you to make your first donation of $10 or whatever you think is best toward my campaign today. Can I count on you to help us stay on track to hit our July fundraising goall, defeat Josh Hawley, and take this seat back for working people?](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/60310?refcode=em20240723-7154&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=7154%2E614464%2EczBiRO)**

Our mission of taking power back for everyday people has earned our movement national media attention. And our commitment to running this campaign the right way, without a cent from corporate PACs, has given us the ability to run the boldest campaign in Missouri history — taking on corrupt political elites like Hawley without hesitation about some mega-donor being upset.
More than just fighting to codify protections for abortion access —**I’m running to end the filibuster so we can actually get it done.**
More than just banning insider trading among members of Congress and their families — **I’m running to put them in jail if they steal from us.**
More than just breaking up Big Pharma — **I’m running to prosecute the insulin cartels who are killing people.**
And more than just rejecting corporate PAC money —**I’m running to abolish corporate PACs altogether.**
This campaign is powered by the people because that’s exactly who I’ll work for in the U.S. Senate — I'll be accountable to real, everyday Americans, not some corporate executive or political machine. We’re throwing out their rulebook and building a grassroots movement to fundamentally change who has power in our country. **And I want you to join our team:**
**[So if you’re ready to help us take back power for everyday people in Missouri and across the country, please add a donation of $10, $25, or whatever you can toward my campaign today.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/60310?refcode=em20240723-7154&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=10&akid=7154%2E614464%2EczBiRO)

For too long, our country’s corrupt politicians have bought their way into power and maintained a broken status quo. That cycle stops with our movement.
Thanks for being part of it,
Lucas Kunce

We built our country back after our predecessor left it in shambles — making historic progress in reducing prescription drug costs, upgrading our nation’s infrastructure, fighting climate change, and more. We are stronger today because we took action — together — to invest in America’s future.
I am excited to continue to work toward our vision for a better future for all. Fellow Patriot, We're in a moment of national reflection. And for many Americans, it's a question of how we reset and reshape our culture, institutions, and daily lives--_for the better_. **Fellow Patriot, over the past year, I wrote my new book,****_Right Wing Revolution,_****as a guide for a return to an America where ...**
* We are united with a national spirit of love of country and belief in American Greatness.

* We have a free society, secure borders, and respect for our Constitution.

* We have rapidly increasing church attendance and a nationwide spiritual renewal.

* We trust our neighbors, feel safe in our communities, and don't have to lock our doors at night.

* We bring up the next generation to love our country, to live with integrity and strong morals, and to champion a bright future for all Americans.

_[**Can I send you a FREE copy of**** _Right Wing Revolution_****to read today? All I ask for in return is a gift of ANY amount to support Turning Point USA --and our critically important work to make kids LOVE AMERICA again.**](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=4da8273b2a4f4666aec4ed29219f8f1a&_e=PXCzlxMWWu4daSZrQTuNQVcqieonUh89tfHxdosv4Y1bfGFyFHocdsZi7TibCf64yolC6eZ2AOr9zMhegqvyORtxmCsWqNV08IKhgIjiSf2Itn_-gLaG15H2dGm8-cIbPUWpddzOt7FtmSJzuR6XCvpRxAw8ZUFlBlMHHsQVV7WOrzru6VI4XpqPj-0ULtwqE6V6Z5PrOcT5Pb80Hu8nWYXrxdvaCIt90IzBdT0H7iGSnp4mHvnp81zVtVqXOhGY8uBLKh77prjRw8qmQW-I97fu-Hf2op0DLK-nSDMgZeYA_CaKHsBQSxYUbYzqXELz)_

* It's NOT a history of political tactics and the back-and-forth between Left and Right.

* It's NOT a list of only political goals or policy to-dos, although I do discuss key issue areas that are important to every American.

* It's NOT a call for __ our leaders or lawmakers to make a difference - instead, its focus is on __ how _all Americans_ can improve our country and our culture, starting with a focus on improving _ourselves_.

Thursday - 3:30pm -OR- Saturday - 10:00am Get Equipped to Reach the Voters We Need! name: Elissa Slotkin
subject: What Joe Biden’s decision means for our country
disclaimer_text: Paid for by VPP
body:
| Friends,

As you have no doubt heard by now, President Biden has made the choice to suspend his presidential campaign.

Few public servants have given more to our country than Joe Biden. His record of accomplishment as a Senator, Vice President, and as President of the United States is unmatched. Over the last four years I’ve been proud to partner with his administration to take on Big Pharma, bring down the cost of prescription drugs, and to secure the biggest federal investment in Michigan’s infrastructure since the 1950s, to say nothing of delivering the biggest expansion of veterans healthcare benefits in decades.

I cannot imagine the difficulty of this decision, and he should be applauded not just for his accomplishments in office – including leading our country through the COVID crisis – but also for putting the future of this country and our democracy first. For that, we all owe him a debt of gratitude.

This is an unprecedented moment in our history, and I am sure that you, like so many Americans, are feeling a sense of uncertainty about what comes next. Which is why I wanted to take a moment to talk about what it means for our country – and the November election.

First, one thing that hasn't changed: The November election will be an inflection point in our democracy where Americans will be faced with the choice of deciding what kind of country we want to be.

And we know Michigan will determine control of the White House and the Senate. Period. Full stop.

But when seismic shifts of this nature happen, they tend to generate an extraordinary amount of energy and action. So I am certain that as you read this, Republicans are emboldened in a way that will benefit our potential opponent.

Our job, today, is to make sure we don't pause and watch the world go by. We have to not only match their enthusiasm, but exceed it.

We have a big task ahead of us: Hold the White House, defend the Senate, and keep Michigan blue. But I cannot do that alone. For that, I need your help. So today -- especially today -- I am asking you to do something important that will help us win this Senate race:

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: I am no stranger to the historic fight Kamala Harris has in front of her
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
I wanted to share some thoughts about the news of the past few days, and about the fight our movement has ahead of us over the course of the next three months.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=1244%2E791427%2ED7rXIE)
Friends -
I wanted to reach out this afternoon to share some thoughts about the news of the past few days, and about the fight our movement has ahead of us over the course of the next three months.
I want to make perfectly clear, right off the bat: President Biden's decision to stand down his re-election campaign was his to make. It was a move that took an incredible amount of humility, and I am grateful to the President for his years of service to our country.
I am also grateful for his speedy endorsement of Vice President Kamala Harris, who I am thrilled to fully support as our Democratic nominee and excited to work alongside to defeat Donald Trump in November.
As a co-sponsor of Medicare for All and a Green New Deal during her time in the Senate, I am hopeful that together we can focus on building a progressive platform that centers our movement's fight for justice and puts the needs of working people first. This includes getting straight to work advancing critical issues the Vice President has shown incredible leadership on, like protecting the right to abortion, canceling student debt, and guaranteeing paid family and medical leave for all.
Additionally, I am eager to work directly with her in enacting a permanent ceasefire and an end to Israel's genocide in Gaza — a conflict which she herself has accurately described as the "humanitarian catastrophe" that it is.
I am optimistic that together we can usher in a new era of American foreign policy — one where the United States uses its power to push for peace and justice in Palestine and across the world, rather than enabling and directly financing horrific violence and death.
The reality of this election is that defeating Donald Trump and the MAGA movement once and for all is going to take all of us working as hard as we can over the next 104 days.
**That's why I am committed to doing everything possible — as a member of Congress, as a progressive, as an organizer in my community, as a mother, and as a woman — to see that Kamala wins in November.**
In closing, I want to share with you a vivid memory I hold from the days following the Biden/Harris campaign's victory over Donald Trump in November 2020.
In her first address to the nation as vice president-elect, Kamala thanked Black women especially, saying that we are _"too often overlooked,"_ but so often prove to be _"the backbone of our democracy."_
She added, _"While I may be the first woman in this office, I will not be the last — because every little girl watching tonight sees that this is a country of possibilities.”_
I was watching that speech at home in Minnesota with my then-8-year-old daughter Ilwad. After hearing the Vice President speak, the first thing she said to me was, _**"She looks like me, Hooyo."_**
Ilwad, inspired by the Vice President and the powerful idea that she could accomplish anything and everything she set her mind to, went on to run for Vice President — and became President — of her middle school.
[](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-july24.nFotnz&refcode=em240723-1&t=2&akid=1244%2E791427%2ED7rXIE)
Although the Donald Trumps and JD Vances of the world would prefer you think otherwise, representation is powerful. Women, especially women of color and children of immigrants, have waited generations to see themselves reflected in their government.
As the first African refugee and one of the first two Muslim women elected to Congress — and the first Black woman elected to represent Minnesota on the federal level — I am no stranger to the historic fight Kamala has in front of her.
This election is an incredible opportunity to create the America I dreamed about as a refugee, a country where anything is possible.
Thank you for being a part of making that happen, and thank you for always being by my side in our movement's struggle for justice.
In solidarity,
Ilhan
* * *

👋🗣️ **Wait! Before you go...**
Ilhan's primary in Minnesota is just 21 days away, and it's going to take an incredible amount of resources to get out the vote and fight back against the right-wing here in the home stretch.
We're powering this campaign the right way, through lots and lots of small-dollar, grassroots contributions. So please:
**[Can you add your first $3 donation to stand with Ilhan today? Every dollar will go directly toward sending our movement back to Congress.**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-july24.nFotnz&refcode=em240723-1&t=3&akid=1244%2E791427%2ED7rXIE)
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-july24.nFotnz&refcode=em240723-1&t=4&akid=1244%2E791427%2ED7rXIE)**

This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a very important way we communicate with supporters like you, but if you want to, you can **[unsubscribe here](https://act.ilhanomar.com/unsubscribe/unsubscribe/?source=em-footer&t=5&akid=1244%2E791427%2ED7rXIE)**. Submit this form to [**update your contact information**](https://act.ilhanomar.com/signup/update-contact-info/source=em-footer?t=7&akid=1244%2E791427%2ED7rXIE)
Ilhan is counting on our people-powered grassroots movement to fund this campaign. If you can, stand with us by **[making a contribution today](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/io-em-footer/?refcode=em-footer&t=8&refcode2=1244_791427_D7rXIE&akid=1244%2E791427%2ED7rXIE)**.

name: Team AOC
subject: Rise above the noise
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
As an elected official who is a woman of color, Alexandria has seen and heard a lot. And we know that Vice President Kamala Harris has as well.
#
As an elected official who is a woman of color, Alexandria has seen and heard a lot. And we know that Vice President Kamala Harris has as well.
It’s going to be crucial that we brace ourselves for some unfair, misogynistic, and racial undertones, overtones, explicit attacks and implicit attacks that she may be subjected to.
The far-right has a history of weaponizing this hateful and divisive language against us and people who look like us. But **we’ve seen this playbook before and now we must rise above the noise.**
We must come together to denounce the far-right’s harmful rhetoric, swiftly defeat Donald Trump, and end his threat to our American democracy.
Kamala Haris is more than up to the task and ready to be President. It’s now on us to rally behind her to elect her come November.
The work we put in today will determine our success—so let’s hit the ground running. body:
[1]Justice Democrats

Peter, we have
just two weeks left to fight back against the onslaught of right-wing
megadonor money flooding into MO-01, and protect progressive incumbent
Rep. Cori Bush. [ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240723-cb.YEAnFD&refcode=em20240723-35812&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1001&akid=35812%2E1203867%2EnSy8B4 ]Can we count on you to help us by splitting a donation
to Cori’s campaign and Justice Democrats right now?

We first recruited Cori, then a nurse and community activist, to run for
this House seat in 2018. In 2020, she narrowly defeated a 10-term,
out-of-touch incumbent with the support of this grassroots movement. Since
then, she’s fiercely fought for an eviction moratorium and housing
justice, abortion rights, a living wage for all workers, Medicare for All,
a Green New Deal, and a permanent ceasefire in Gaza.

Cori is one of the most progressive members of Congress, and that’s made
her a top target of conservatives, corporate interests, and the
anti-Palestinian lobby. As a result, dark money super PACs have dropped
more than $7 million to support her primary election opponent: a former
prosecutor who claims to be progressive but worked for an anti-abortion
Republican.

In fact, AIPAC’s super PAC just dropped an additional $1.1 million on air
time in MO-01.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240723-cb.YEAnFD&refcode=em20240723-35812&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1002&akid=35812%2E1203867%2EnSy8B4 ]Tweet from Jacob Rubashkin: Not to be lost in all this - AIPAC’s super
PAC continues to spend heavily against Rep. Cori Bush in the MO-01
Democratic primary. The group just booked another $1.1 million in
television ads for the week leading up to the primary.

Justice Democrats is fighting back with our own TV ads, mailers, and staff
on the ground in St. Louis to help get out the vote for Cori in these
final two weeks. But just like Cori, we don’t take a cent from
corporations, so we have a fraction of the resources that her opponent
has.

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240723-cb.YEAnFD&refcode=em20240723-35812&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=35812%2E1203867%2EnSy8B4 ]Time is running out to defend this seat and re-elect
Cori, Peter. Can you please
fuel our fight by splitting a grassroots donation to Justice Democrats and
Cori’s campaign today?

[ https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jdem-20240723-cb.YEAnFD&refcode=em20240723-35812&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1022&akid=35812%2E1203867%2EnSy8B4 ]Contribute $5

After losing Jamaal Bowman’s House seat to a conservative shill in June,
we can’t afford to lose another one of our few progressive champions in
Congress. Let’s do what it takes to keep Cori in office fighting for the
people.

In solidarity,

Justice Democrats

name: Sarah McBride
subject: Thank you, President Biden
body:
Sign my card thanking President Biden.
#
President Biden is the definition of a true patriot, and he has led the most accomplished administration we've seen in my lifetime.
[**Can you sign my virtual card to thank President Joe Biden for his lifelong service and everything he’s done for our country?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/ms_em_20240723_bidenthankyoucard/?source=em20240723-1-861&&akid=861%2E21716%2E7nq6hh)
[](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/ms_em_20240723_bidenthankyoucard/?source=em20240723-1&akid=861%2E21716%2E7nq6hh)
I’ve been lucky to see President Biden champion working families and equity over my whole life — as my Senator, Vice President, and over the last three and a half years as President.
Under his leadership, we’ve achieved historic employment statistics, addressed climate change with meaningful solutions, and bolstered economic opportunities across the nation.
**He’s proven that we can do big things together that make a real difference in the lives of Americans, from Wilmington to Scranton and beyond — and through it all, he’s shown how decent, kind and selfless he is.**
It's easy to be cynical, but President Biden has never done that. Now more than ever, we need to channel his hope and determination to continue the work of saving our democracy by electing VP Kamala Harris, winning back the U.S. House, and electing Democrats up and down the ticket this November.
[**Will you join me in thanking President Biden for his patriotism to our country and our democracy by signing my card today?**](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/ms_em_20240723_bidenthankyoucard/?source=em20240723-1&akid=861%2E21716%2E7nq6hh)
**[Sign the card »](https://act.sarahmcbride.com/sign/ms_em_20240723_bidenthankyoucard/?source=em20240723-1&akid=861%2E21716%2E7nq6hh)**
Thank you!
Sarah McBride

Friend, Over the weekend, President Joe Biden withdrew from the 2024 presidential race and endorsed Vice President Kamala Harris to take his place as the Democratic nominee. **We are in unprecedented times. But the demands of our constituents and people across the country remain the same: They want a President and government that is focused on saving lives, giving people the ability to thrive, and valuing the humanity of one another over bombs and genocide.** Kamala Harris and other potential presidential candidates must reconnect with our Democratic base in order to defeat Donald Trump and the dangerous implications of Project 2025. The people who make up our Democratic base have been clear: They want to see a permanent ceasefire, an end to the funding of genocide in Gaza, and an arms embargo to stop the Israeli government’s war crimes. They want to see fair and humane immigration policies, not ones that vilify immigrants. They want to see a clear path to ending fossil fuel subsidies that continue to poison our air and water. They want to see an end to our inhumane healthcare system and an end to the attempts to dismantle our public education system. They want us to fight against corporate greed, strengthen unions, and lift families out of the cycle of poverty. Fellow American,

Thank you for opening this email. In a world where noise from both sides of the aisle often drowns out the voices of hard working Americans like you and I, your attention is incredibly valuable.

Did you know that only a small percentage of supporters open these emails, and even fewer take action? Yet, it's Americans like you and me, who understand the challenges our communities face, who possess the power to effect change in our country.

Please take the time to read this email to the end. Your engagement could be pivotal. And if, after reading, you're unable to contribute financially, please know that your moral support is equally cherished.

I am dedicated to ensuring that everyday Americans like us uphold our conservative values.

**[Can you imagine if everyone who opened this email gave just $1?](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=3856910871f046b4988ebdbbd21cdd86&_e=b20kz6DQNTBUaTeYpWyL7ADlW6Fv_exZvFbaPTv-2dAU6PaT37MrpjFq-RV3BmJLUbGf6KXEqfTqoTJWZ0dsqw-81TSBKGygFAMc4-CtW7WuMnDvTQPqOprIHWRG--G6q-_4a-xFV-WRx1L2NtXyeHoYSiOQuUg5NGqcAeTt1JZCcZ5-6bQ1oR4w1sgGiHCnW-KumOrNv7YRlrdBH-hvVscMpqxWxRQXxWTBxjXKTSP1ki6tb8TpUCcbZYpDZSpNXma-9ZZmjeB4Q4anLnRtwzX6BuDtry8Gli1pbZCC3DpZ_MHFFf7tUoJ0DPbtc31RU8b04XSUR0rd9Nwlc5S0dw%3D%3D)** With your support, we can exceed all of our goals and create tangible change.

After growing up in a military family, I've dedicated myself to serving our country. First at West Point; then, while in combat deployment in Iraq, and during two deployments to Saudi Arabia where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer; and now, as a Congressman representing the great state of Texas.

[](http://links.wesleyhunttx.com/u/click?_t=6aa969a792e549699e2a6024aa3e4ace&_m=3856910871f046b4988ebdbbd21cdd86&_e=b20kz6DQNTBUaTeYpWyL7ADlW6Fv_exZvFbaPTv-2dAU6PaT37MrpjFq-RV3BmJLUbGf6KXEqfTqoTJWZ0dsqw-81TSBKGygFAMc4-CtW7WuMnDvTQPqOprIHWRG--G6HNu07sc_uvlcxPe_VldO-_oIPJPgANKwFkB8fuDSdgEy2dJ6T-IcTyWu-ngxImiLecYJCrzF9gh1rNxCtEjevJ2AXLS_5mvPYffEVQMJylV1Smn5tw1nfApc2MIsoNgWcVt6QszaJXUCTRcJBqBKdUbedLdvrAMp59-G4p65TGJ2xunpbploUhdZn7Do1t72)

clean_body: I understand some might ignore this message - I hope it's not you. | Fellow American, Thank you for opening this email. In a world where noise from both sides of the aisle often drowns out the voices of hard working Americans like you and I, your attention is incredibly valuable. Did you know that only a small percentage of supporters open these emails, and even fewer take action? Yet, it's Americans like you and me, who understand the challenges our communities face, who possess the power to effect change in our country. Please take the time to read this email to the end. Your engagement could be pivotal. And if, after reading, you're unable to contribute financially, please know that your moral support is equally cherished. I am dedicated to ensuring that everyday Americans like us uphold our conservative values. With your support, we can exceed all of our goals and create tangible change. After growing up in a military family, I've dedicated myself to serving our country. First at West Point; then, while in combat deployment in Iraq, and during two deployments to Saudi Arabia where I served as a Diplomatic Liaison Officer; and now, as a Congressman representing the great state of Texas. | The Left hopes we'll lose faith - in ourselves and in the future of our region. But I refuse to give up, and I know you won't either. I understand that some may ignore this message. However, for those who grasp the urgency of our cause, your support is priceless. Sincerely, Wesley Hunt Changing Washington won 't be easy, but graduating from West Point and serving in the United States Army, being deployed to combat zones, and flying Apache helicopters over Iraq has prepared me for tough fights and big challenges. I truly believe nothing is more worth fighting for than our great country and our way of life in the Houston area.****** Paid for by Hunt for Congress. History will remember President Biden as a lifelong public servant.

This proves what we’ve always known about Joe Biden. He’s a selfless leader who put the greater good of this country above himself.

Over the past four years, he has led the charge for unparalleled progress for the American people. President Biden ushered us out of a global pandemic and has rebuilt our economy to the best it has ever been. Vulnerable communities nationwide are reaping the benefits from his investments in infrastructure, efforts to expand affordable health care, and more.

I thank him for his service, for his commitment to Democracy, for this act of patriotism to step aside, putting the need to defend democracy ahead of his own personal ambition.

It’s a stunning act of selflessness that is so often lacking in today’s politics.

Thank you for everything you have done for our country, President Biden.
In solidarity,

Bonnie Watson Coleman
---

---

We are so proud to stand with Kamala Harris.
#

**Friend, we all know Donald Trump:**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240723-3-30&t=1&akid=8561%2E3935704%2EMSV2rR)
Donald Trump has proven time and time again that he will put the gun lobby’s agenda over the safety of the American people. In his first term, gun homicides spiked by 34 percent while he “did nothing.” We need to work together to make sure he doesn’t get a second term.
**Now take a look at President Biden:**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240723-3-30&t=2&akid=8561%2E3935704%2EMSV2rR)
President Joe Biden has been the strongest gun safety president in history, and we’re so grateful for all that he has done for our movement for gun safety. According to new FBI data, violent crime has decreased by 15% so far this year under President Biden’s leadership. No doubt, that is because of his commitment to enacting lifesaving gun safety legislation—like the _Bipartisan Safer Communities Act._
**Now, here is Vice President Kamala Harris, our next president of the United States:**
[](https://go.giffords.org/go/14457?c0=giffords-em-july24.-nTEO4&refcode=em240723-3-30&t=3&akid=8561%2E3935704%2EMSV2rR)
After President Joe Biden announced this weekend that he was no longer seeking reelection, he endorsed Vice President Harris to become the new Democratic presidential nominee. We agree with President Biden that there is no better choice than Vice President Harris.
Over the last three and a half years, Vice President Harris has stood by President Biden’s side in all of his landmark actions to make our country safer from gun violence. Kamala Harris is ready to carry on Joe Biden’s legacy and will prioritize our movement for gun safety.
We are so proud to stand with Kamala Harris. Now, it’s up to us to make sure her campaign gets off to a strong start. The foundation she builds now is critical to her ability to defeat Donald Trump this November.

subject: Can you pitch in to help fuel our campaign and win our fights for working people?

body:
It might seem overwhelming, but I find it invigorating.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=2284%2E4032634%2EpeqCkx)
---
The way I see it, we have to multitask this year. I’m running for re-election in Massachusetts. At the same time, I’m doing everything I can to elect Vice President Kamala Harris, support Democrats up and down the ballot, and build momentum for our plans to put Washington on the side of working families. That way, we’ll be in the best possible position to deliver meaningful change in 2025 and beyond. But I can’t do all this alone — and I know I’m fighting alongside a powerful grassroots team. [**If it makes sense for you right now, please make a donation of $5 or any amount to support our re-election campaign and help pass bold reforms that put power in the hands of working people.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2447?amount=5&t=8&akid=2284%2E4032634%2EpeqCkx)

By holding the White House, flipping the House, and protecting our Democratic majority in the Senate, we can make real change, including...
* Ensuring the right to an abortion nationwide — and preventing MAGA Republicans from passing a national ban that would reach Massachusetts.
* Putting quality, affordable child care within reach for every working family.
* Taxing the rich to fund opportunity for all — with a two-cent wealth tax on fortunes greater than $50 million.
* Tackling the housing affordability crisis.
* Continuing to fight climate change.
* Rooting corruption out of Washington — including with my plan to make Supreme Court justices follow a binding code of ethics.

So this year, I’ll keep working to build momentum for those plans, and to deliver all the results I can for working people in the meantime. For example: just months ago, I jumped into the fight to make sure airlines would have to issue automatic refunds for canceled or severely delayed flights — and we won that fight. We’ve also got to take this re-election campaign extremely seriously. A Super PAC that’s targeting me recently disclosed three massive donations totaling $2 million — over half a million more than we raised in the most recent fundraising quarter. They are hell-bent on defeating me, which would virtually guarantee Republican control of the U.S. Senate. And I will fight my heart out to elect Vice President Kamala Harris. We’ve got to have her back as she launches her campaign for president. There’s plenty of work that lies ahead. It might seem overwhelming. But I find it invigorating — because we know what must be done, and I know this team can do it. [**So what do you say — can you pitch in to help fuel this campaign and win our fights for working people?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/2447?t=14&akid=2284%2E4032634%2EpeqCkx) Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

At the same time, I’m doing everything I can to elect Vice President Kamala Harris, support Democrats up and down the ballot, and build momentum for our plans to put Washington on the side of working families. That way, we’ll be in the best possible position to deliver meaningful change in 2025 and beyond. But I can’t do all this alone — and I know I’m fighting alongside a powerful grassroots team. Putting quality, affordable child care within reach for every working family. Taxing the rich to fund opportunity for all — with a two-cent wealth tax on fortunes greater than $50 million. We’ve also got to take this re-election campaign extremely seriously. A Super PAC that’s targeting me recently disclosed three massive donations totaling $2 million — over half a million more than we raised in the most recent fundraising quarter. | | By now I'm sure you've seen the news that President Joe Biden has made the decision to withdraw his candidacy for President of the United States. I've been proud to work with President Biden on a record number of Democratic successes these past three-and-a-half years. From the bipartisan infrastructure bill to the CHIPS Act to the historic Inflation Reduction Act, under President Biden's leadership, Democrats have gained enormous ground in the fight to hold Big Pharma accountable and set us on course to a clean energy future. | | | [ ](https://www.jillstein2024.com/?e=e813143e1dc0d3b0ffcb007ffe357333&utm_source=jillsteinforpresident&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=kamala_email_two&n=1)
---
Peter, Earlier today we sent you an email about Kamala. We want to follow up with some opposition research about the candidate the anti-democratic party appears to be coronating who has zero delegates. First, let’s look closely at her record as Attorney General, California’s Top Cop: Her office fought tooth and nail against an order to decrease the inmate population after the Supreme Court ruled that the severe overpopulation of their prisons amounted to cruel and unusual punishment. Her AG office’s attorneys explicitly argued that prisoners were needed to prop up the state’s firefighters needed to combat the wildfire crisis – these inmates were making _one dollar an hour_ for this dangerous work!
---
---
Kamala jailed the parents of young people who were skipping classes. _And laughed about it._ In 2014, Kamala refused to investigate a series of police shootings in San Francisco, where she had previously been District Attorney, ignoring pleas to do so following the police murder of Michael Brown. Now let’s look at the Gaza genocide and where she really stands: **_her presidential campaign coffers include access to $5,395,227 of contributions from AIPAC._** She has stood by as the Biden administration has provided approximately 25 million dollars a day in military aid to Israel that has enabled them to carry out this genocide against the people of Gaza.

She co-sponsored a resolution condemning Obama for his failure to veto a U.N. resolution denouncing illegal Israeli settlements in the West Bank. She waxed poetic about the Israeli Supreme Court’s architectural design, saying “ _The beauty of the architecture and spirit of design left a lasting impression...The Court, like Israel, is a beautiful home to democracy and justice in a region where radicalism and authoritarianism all too often shape government.”_ This is just the tip of the iceberg. Between her political history and her dismal polling, she is clearly a terrible candidate. But the billionaires love her. She has raised tens of millions since Biden’s endorsement of her on X (formerly Twitter). Jill Stein doesn’t have billionaires, superPACs, or lobbyists. This is intentional. Jill wants to represent YOU: not big donors, AIPAC, or Wall Street. # Melton for Iowa 2024
---
---
| Hello Peter,

This is Ryan Melton, Democrat running for the U.S. House in Iowa's 4th Congressional District. During my 2024 campaign, I'll send you a weekly email to keep you in the loop while not overwhelming your inbox. Typically, the newsletter will be a review from the week prior: Where we went, what issues of note were on the minds of those I met with, where we'll be in the next week, etc.
Where I went on the campaign trail last week: Last week, I hit the county fair circuit yet again, speaking with folks at Democratic Party fair booths in Crawford, Audubon, Pocahontas, Boone, Winnebago, Cherokee, and Palo Alto counties.
The pressing issue on the campaign trail last week: When I finished an interview yesterday regarding my take on Pres. Biden stepping down, the journalist chatted with me a bit longer off the record about a few things. He said he was intrigued by my replying to folks on social media, especially Republicans and other non-Democrats. He hasn't seen any other candidate do that. He complimented me for being civil in the process, and said per his work and travels throughout the state, the division between Republicans and Democrats isn't as deep as the powers that be want us to think it is. I advised that even though I'm a Democrat through and through, I've met a lot of lovely Republicans who I share common ground with in a number of ways. My wife was a Republican when we started dating. My grandfather, a dyed in the wool Mormon Republican, is one of my biggest supporters, and said he loved one of my favorites Bernie Sanders until he found out he was a "commie" (Oh boy, Grandpa).
Anyway, this truth that once we get to talking to each other, Democrats and Republicans agree on a lot more than we don't, was reaffirmed yet again this week. I love going to county fairs because I get to chat with a lot of non-Democrats there. I was on a nice streak this week of chatting with non-Democrats, be they Libertarians, Independents, or Republicans, at these fairs, with confirmations from them that they support me.
Why? Number one was a palpable anger I sensed from a few Republicans regarding the attacks on public education and our AEA system in the state. I talk quite a bit about the hollowing out of our district, and the acceleration that will happen as more small towns lose their schools. The reddest of Republicans in small town Iowa know that if you lose your school, you'll probably lose your town soon after.
Another Republican said she'd be voting for me because she was sick of Feenstra being owned by corporate donors, and she found it refreshing that I reject corporate PAC money.
Another Republican told me they were excited to see I prioritize addressing water quality and cancer incidence rate. They expressed their dismay that so few candidates and elected officials dare broach the subject out of fear they'll have to have tough conversations or tick off their donors, even though we are the only state in the country with a rising cancer incidence rate.
An Independent and a Libertarian also talked to me about the hollowing out of rural Iowa, how it feels almost by design to drive a certain kind of voter out, as it seems the Republican Party leadership in this state would rather disinvest and hollow out the state to consolidate their political power than invest, attract young people here, and grow.
There is much more common ground than the powers that be want us to think. The powerful thrive on division, on us remaining in our own silos. If you get out of your comfort zone and talk to those you don't normally talk to, you'll see people are people, pain is pain, and that we all want most of the same things, regardless of political affiliation.

body:
# [](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/188?t=1&akid=1685%2E135344%2ExOa4ol)

Friend --
Since the start of this campaign, I have been telling my staff to expect “black swans.”
If you’re not familiar with the term, it’s a shorthand used in the intelligence community for a significant event that’s impossible to predict ahead of time. These are moments and events that have important consequences and can cause you to shift your entire strategy. They are low probability, high impact events that force you to think on your feet.
What IS predictable -- especially in this era of American politics -- is that there will be moments that surprise us.
And although I have been warning my team about black swans for a year now, I couldn’t have anticipated that there would be three of them in just a few weeks: the events at President Trump’s Pennsylvania rally, President Biden’s decision to step down, and now Vice President Harris’ ascension to be the nominee.
But here’s the thing: there will be more black swans between now and November 5th.
Through it all, Team Slotkin prides ourselves on being “Steady Eddies.” There is so much that we cannot control, but amid the chaos and breaking news, we remain focused on our goal: keeping Michigan and this Senate seat blue.
So no matter what you see in the headlines or on social media, you can count on this team to stay focused on the work: knocking doors, sharing our message on TV and advertisements, traveling the state to meet new voters, and all of the million other things that go into a successful race for U.S. Senate in a state like Michigan.
[**That will redound not only to our benefit, but also to that of other Democrats up and down the ballot, including Vice President Harris. So if you would like to help us keep moving forward and ramp up our efforts, I hope you’ll consider making a donation to my campaign.**](https://act.elissaslotkin.org/go/9?c0=ebs-em-july24.5Fk0a0&refcode=em240723-4-900&t=2&akid=1685%2E135344%2ExOa4ol)

#
---
| | Hi Peter, Welcome to my team’s monthly newsletter of what I’ve been up to this month, so you can be in the loop about the great work happening. I know life can be busy, and your inbox can get filled up with political emails, so I appreciate any time you can dedicate to reading this newsletter each month. Thanks! — TK
---
* * *
**We marched in Portland Pride! 🏳️🌈**
There’s lots of work to be done around the country in order to ensure true equality for everyone, but we’ll never stop fighting to make sure Oregon is a safe and inclusive place for everyone.
* * *
**Tina and Aimee Visit the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs and the Confederated Tribes of Coos, Lower Umpqua And Siuslaw**
Governor Kotek and First Lady Aimee Kotek Wilson visited with the Confederated Tribes of Warm Springs, as well as the Confederated Tribes of Coos, Lower Umpqua and Siuslaw. This is part of Governor Kotek’s commitment to visit all of Oregon’s nine federally recognized sovereign Tribal nations in 2024.

Primary day is almost here – and your support has been the backbone of this campaign. Peter,

We’re just **two weeks out** from our primary election, and the _clock is ticking_. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/89433864/487292309/1027045913?refcode=em24_240723_2weeks_fndd_gq_act___wb_ettx&utm_campaign=em24_240723_2weeks_fndd_gq_act___wb_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=6091969a-4d49-ef11-86c3-6045bdd9e096&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTkvMS8xMDYzODkiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNjA5MTk2OWEtNGQ0OS1lZjExLTg2YzMtNjA0NWJkZDllMDk2IiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=r3tNmkoPEPdSI9j5tVsrD9JR5ozhEjIP6ijrk1-vXm0=) I’m steadfast in my commitment to defending our democracy, protecting our fundamental rights, and delivering real results for every St. Louisan. But what we do in these final fourteen days until Election Day could be make or break for this campaign, **and I need your help to keep up the momentum.**

My vision for our district is simple: We need to create an economy that works for everyone, ensure women have the right to choose what they do with their bodies, protect our natural resources, improve our education and health systems, and ensure that EVERYONE has a fair shot – regardless of their race, gender, age, or economic status.

Peter – this isn’t just about winning an election – **it’s about making a real difference for our community.** With election day just around the corner, we need to ensure we have the resources to reach every voter and build a winning campaign. But in order to do that, we simply can’t afford to fall behind on our fundraising before the polls open on August 6.
